name: H&M
description:
Tap in to our fashion feed, anytime, anywhere, and all in one spot — the H&M app. 
Get instant updates, track your orders, use your own photos to find similar items in stock, and get inspired by our users all over the world! 

Imagine yourself browsing our feed and experiencing it live all at the same time.
Sounds exciting? Keep reading!

What if you found an item in our app and wanted you to know if it’s available in any of our stores? We have the answer to that — use our FIND IN STORE feature! This feature will show you all available sizes and colours and where we currently have them in stock.

Our app also comes handy when you’re already inside one of our stores.
Let’s say you can’t find your size or would like to know if an item is available in more sizes and colours? Scan the price tag — our SCAN & FIND feature will let you know!

Seen something you like and got inspired by? VISUAL SEARCH lets you explore what we have to offer by using your own photos or screen shots. It recognizes patterns, colors, styles, and gives you a list of matching or similar items in stock.

Save the items you love the most in your own list of favourites — just tap the HEART ICON. 

Turn the H&M app into your own shopping tool — activate IN-STORE MODE when you visit one of our stores. See which of your favourite-marked items are available in the store you’re in, or nearby.

Keep up to date with the fashion world by activating PUSH NOTIFICATIONS! You’ll be the first to know when a designer collection drops and you’ll instantly be notified when we have special offers and events!

Don’t miss out — download the H&M app now!

When you download the H&M app, we will process your data in accordance with our Privacy Notice. For more details on this, please go to hm.com.

name: RailOne
description:
RailOne: Your All-in-One App by Indian Railways
RailOne is a comprehensive app developed by Indian Railways, designed to consolidate all public-facing services into a single, user-friendly platform. By integrating multiple functionalities into one app, RailOne simplifies the travel experience with a seamless single sign-on (SSO) system. Whether you’re planning a trip, booking tickets, or seeking additional services during your journey, RailOne is your ultimate travel companion. 

Key Features:
Plan and Book Tickets: Effortlessly plan journeys, search for trains, and book reserved or unreserved tickets through the app. This consolidation reduces the need for multiple platforms, streamlining the booking process.
- My- Bookings: This functionality enables the users to check the details and history information of both booked and canceled tickets (unreserved and reserved) at the same platform. User interface presents the filtering  functionality as per user’s preference based on duration and transaction type.
-You: This functionality enables users to view profile details and edit if needed. Also shows status of profile completion. Gives access for changing password, enabling/disabling biometric. Users can also verify email, edit their name (can be done only once) and delete account. These options are available under My Account Tab. User can also Add money to his R-wallet.
Real-time Train Tracking: Track your train in real-time with live updates on delays, expected arrival times, and other critical information, keeping you informed and helping you adjust your plans.

Coach Position Finder: Locate your coach’s position on the platform easily, making the boarding process smoother and more convenient.

Order Food on the Go: Place food orders from partner vendors while on board, ensuring fresh and timely meals during your journey.

Rail Madad: Use the Rail Madad feature to raise and track complaints or feedback directly with Indian Railways for quick resolution.

Refund Requests: Simplify the process of requesting refunds for canceled or missed journeys through the app.

Multilingual Support: Access the app in multiple languages, catering to India’s diverse population and enhancing accessibility.

R-Wallet Integration: Utilize R-Wallet, a digital wallet integrated into the app, for secure and convenient payments for various services.

The app is developed by CRIS (Centre for Railway Information Systems), an organization under the Ministry of Railways. CRIS combines skilled IT professionals with experienced railway personnel to design, develop, and maintain critical software systems for Indian Railways. Key systems developed by CRIS include:

Reserved Ticketing System: Efficiently manages millions of long-distance seat bookings.
Unreserved Ticketing System: Facilitates easy ticketing for short-distance journeys.
Train Search and Tracking: Offers real-time train search and tracking features.
Coach Position Finder: Enhances the boarding process by helping passengers find their coach.
Rail Madad: Manages grievances and feedback effectively.
Food Ordering System: Allows passengers to order food from partner vendors.
Refund Systems: Processes refunds smoothly for booking errors and cancellations.
CRIS continues to lead in innovation, developing integrated solutions that make travel more efficient. The partnership between CRIS and Indian Railways has been instrumental in modernizing railway infrastructure and enhancing passenger services through advanced technology. RailOne embodies this digital evolution, making train travel smarter, more comfortable, and more accessible. With ongoing developments in RailOne and CRIS’s IT systems, Indian Railways aims to provide an exceptional travel experience, leveraging technology to simplify every aspect of your journey.

name: Telegram Messenger
description:
Pure instant messaging — simple, fast, secure, and synced across all your devices. One of the top 5 most downloaded apps in the world with over 1 billion active users.

FAST: Telegram is the fastest messaging app on the market, connecting people via a unique, distributed network of data centers around the globe.

SYNCED: You can access your messages from all your phones, tablets and computers at once. Telegram apps are standalone, so you don’t need to keep your phone connected. Start typing on one device and finish the message from another. Never lose your data again.

UNLIMITED: You can send media and files, without any limits on their type and size. Your entire chat history will require no disk space on your device, and will be securely stored in the Telegram cloud for as long as you need it. 

SECURE: We made it our mission to provide the best security combined with ease of use. Everything on Telegram, including chats, groups, media, etc. is encrypted using a combination of 256-bit symmetric AES encryption, 2048-bit RSA encryption, and Diffie–Hellman secure key exchange. 

100% FREE & OPEN: Telegram has a fully documented and free API for developers, open source apps and verifiable builds to prove the app you download is built from the exact same source code that is published. 

POWERFUL: You can create group chats with up to 200,000 members, share large videos, documents of any type (.DOCX, .MP3, .ZIP, etc.) up to 2 GB each, and even set up bots for specific tasks. Telegram is the perfect tool for hosting online communities and coordinating teamwork.

RELIABLE: Built to deliver your messages using as little data as possible, Telegram is the most reliable messaging system ever made. It works even on the weakest mobile connections. 

FUN: Telegram has powerful photo and video editing tools, animated stickers and emoji, fully customizable themes to change the appearance of your app, and an open sticker/GIF platform to cater to all your expressive needs.

SIMPLE: While providing an unprecedented array of features, we take great care to keep the interface clean. Telegram is so simple you already know how to use it.

PRIVATE: We take your privacy seriously and will never give any third parties access to your data. You can delete any message you ever sent or received for both sides, at any time and without a trace. Telegram will never use your data to show you ads.

For those interested in maximum privacy, Telegram offers Secret Chats. Secret Chat messages can be programmed to self-destruct automatically from both participating devices. This way you can send all types of disappearing content — messages, photos, videos, and even files. Secret Chats use End-to-End Encryption to ensure that a message can only be read by its intended recipient.

We keep expanding the boundaries of what you can do with a messaging app. Don’t wait years for older messengers to catch up with Telegram — join the revolution today.

name: Capability Passport
description:
Your marksheet shows what you studied.
Your Capability Passport shows what you can do.

Capability Passport is your verified capability identity — issued through your university, carried by you semester after semester, and designed to grow with you over time.

What Your Capability Passport Includes
CID — Capability Identity
Your unique ID within the Capability Passport system, issued through your institution and linked to your capability journey.

CRI Score — Career Readiness Index
A structured score reflecting your capability and readiness — not just marks. Updated every semester.

Your Rank
See how you compare with students in your university and across the network.

Capability Breakdown
52 skills. 13 competencies.
Know your strengths. Know your gaps. Know what to build next.

University-Issued Certificate
Verified and issued through your institution. Download it. Share it. Use it.

How It Works
Your university conducts PLAT
(Progressive Learning and Ability Test)

You complete the assessment in your classroom

Your Capability Passport is generated with your CID, CRI score, rank, and certificate — within 48 hours

It updates each semester as your capability grows

Why It Matters
Employers do not hire marks alone.
They look for capability, consistency, and growth.

A student who improves from CRI 55 to 72 over 3 semesters tells a stronger story than a student with a static score.

A trajectory tells a stronger story than a number.

Your Capability Passport is that trajectory.
Verified. Ranked. Carried by you.

Growing network of affiliated colleges

It allows file synchronization with your Computer(iTunes),iCloud Drive.
- Connect your device to iTunes and select your device. Select "File Sharing" on the left side menu of iTunes and look for "MXPlayer" to transfer files.

Features:

name: Minecraft: Dream it, Build it!
description:
Dive into an open world of building, crafting and survival. Gather resources, survive the night, and build whatever you can imagine one block at a time. Explore and craft your way through a completely open world where you can play with friends, build a city, start a farm, mine deep into the ground, face mysterious enemies, or just experiment to the limits of your imagination! 
 
The possibilities are endless. Embark on an epic adventure and play with friends, building from the ground up. Build and expand in Creative mode, where you can craft from unlimited resources. Survive the night, face intense battles, craft tools, and fend off danger in Survival mode. With seamless cross-platform and multiplayer gameplay on Minecraft: Bedrock Edition, you can adventure solo or with friends, and discover an infinite, randomly generated world filled with blocks to mine, biomes to explore, and mobs to befriend (or battle)!  
 
In Minecraft, the world is yours to shape! 
 
CREATE YOUR WORLD 
• Build anything from the ground up 
• Craft from special resources and tools to create brand new structures and landscapes 
• Explore an endless open world full of different biomes and creatures 
• Minecraft Marketplace – Get creator-made add-ons, thrilling worlds, and stylish cosmetics on Minecraft Marketplace 
• Connect with millions of players on community servers, or subscribe to Realms Plus to cross-play with up to 10 friends on your own private server 
• Slash commands – Tweak how the game plays: you can change the weather, summon mobs, change the time of day, and more 
• Add-ons – Customize your experience even further with add-ons! If you're more tech-inclined, you can modify your game to create new resource packs 
 
MULTIPLAYER ONLINE GAMES 
• Join free massive multiplayer servers and play with thousands of others 
• Multiplayer servers allow you to play with up to 4 players online with a free Xbox Live account 
• Build, battle and explore other realms. With Realms and Realms Plus, you can play with up to 10 friends cross-platform, anytime, anywhere on Realms, your own private server that we host for you 
• With Realms Plus, get instant access to over 150 Marketplace items with new additions each month. Share with friends on your own private Realms server*  
• Connect and play with players across the world, wherever they are, and join in on MMO battles for survival in other worlds 
• Discover gigantic community-run worlds, compete in unique mini-games and socialize in lobbies full of fellow Minecrafters 
 
SUPPORT: https://www.minecraft.net/help 
LEARN MORE: https://www.minecraft.net/

name: Grand Theft Auto: Vice City
description:
Welcome back to Vice City. Welcome back to the 1980s.

From the decade of big hair, excess and pastel suits comes a story of one man's rise to the top of the criminal pile. Vice City, a huge urban sprawl ranging from the beach to the swamps and the glitz to the ghetto, was one of the most varied, complete and alive digital cities ever created. Combining open-world gameplay with a character driven narrative, you arrive in a town brimming with delights and degradation and given the opportunity to take it over as you choose. 

To celebrate its 10 year anniversary, Rockstar Games brings Grand Theft Auto: Vice City to mobile devices with high-resolution graphics, updated controls and a host of new features including: 

• Beautifully updated graphics, character models and lighting effects 
• New, precisely tailored firing and targeting options 
• Custom controls with a fully customizable layout 
• iCloud save game support 
• Massive campaign with countless hours of gameplay 
• Support for Retina display devices 
• Custom iTunes Playlist* 

*To listen to your custom playlist, simply create a playlist titled “VICECITY”, launch the game, and select the radio station “Tape Deck” 

Universal App:
Grand Theft Auto: Vice City is supported on iPhone 4, iPhone 4S, iPhone 5, all iPad models and 4th and 5th generation iPod Touch.

For optimal performance, we recommend re-booting your device after downloading and closing other applications when playing Grand Theft Auto: Vice City. 

Languages Supported: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Korean, Russian, and Japanese. 

Mobile Version developed by War Drum Studios
www.wardrumstudios.com

name: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas
description:
***PLEASE NOTE: This game is officially supported on the following devices only: iPhone 4s, 5, 5s, 5c, 6, 6s, 6 Plus, SE, 7, 7 Plus, iPod Touch 6th Gen, iPad Mini 1, 2, 3 & 4, iPad 2, 3rd Gen, 4th Gen, iPad Air 1 & 2, and iPad Pro.***


Five years ago, Carl Johnson escaped from the pressures of life in Los Santos, San Andreas, a city tearing itself apart with gang trouble, drugs and corruption. Where filmstars and millionaires do their best to avoid the dealers and gangbangers.

Now, it’s the early 90’s. Carl’s got to go home. His mother has been murdered, his family has fallen apart and his childhood friends are all heading towards disaster.

On his return to the neighborhood, a couple of corrupt cops frame him for homicide. CJ is forced on a journey that takes him across the entire state of San Andreas, to save his family and to take control of the streets.

Rockstar Games brings its biggest release to mobile yet with a vast open-world covering the state of San Andreas and its three major cities – Los Santos, San Fierro and Las Venturas – with enhanced visual fidelity and over 70 hours of gameplay.

Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas features:  
• Remastered, high-resolution graphics built specifically for mobile including lighting enhancements, an enriched color palette and improved character models. 
• Enhanced for the iPhone 5 series and iPad 4th Gen and above with dynamic detailed shadows and real-time environmental reflections.
• Physical controller support for all Made for iOS controllers.
• Cloud save support for playing across all your iOS devices for Rockstar Social Club Members.
• Dual analog stick controls for full camera and movement control.
• Three different control schemes and customizable controls with contextual options to display buttons only when you need them.

Languages Supported: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Russian and Japanese. 

*To listen to your custom playlist, simply create a playlist titled “GTASA”, launch the game, and select the radio station “MIXTAPE”.

name: Farming Simulator 26 Mobile
description:
Choose what kind of farmer you want to be! Operate realistic tractors, harvesters, field sprayers, and other machines. Start logging with heavy forestry equipment, or tend to adorable farm animals like cows, sheep, chickens, goats, and their offspring.

• Tons of possibilities on two new maps
• 15 different field crops, plus trees
• 120+ authentic, GPS-enabled machines
• Farm challenges that keep you on your toes
• Production chains, logistics, and more

Operate more than 120 authentic machines by Case IH, CLAAS, DEUTZ-FAHR, Fendt, John Deere, KRONE, Massey Ferguson, New Holland, Valtra & many other acclaimed manufacturers from around the world.

There’s a lot more to do after plowing, removing weeds, harvesting crops, or collecting eggs from chicken coops: Produce valuable goods made from your harvest to expand your flourishing business with new factories and production chains! 

Don’t worry, there is always time to relax and walk around your vast arable land while visuals change through the atmospheric seasons. New and improved in-game tutorials show you the ways of the farm if you’re new to country life.

name: Barmen: Bar Manager
description: Run your own bar and become a master bartender by crafting a wide variety of cocktails! Choose the right glass, pour the perfect ingredients, and complete every customer order with precision. Unlock new recipes, improve your skills, and test your speed in a fast-paced bar environment. With intuitive controls, satisfying drink-making mechanics, and rewarding progression, every shift brings you one step closer to becoming the ultimate bartender.

name: Farming Simulator 23 Mobile
description:
Grow crops, grow your agricultural empire! Become a modern farmer to operate more than 100 authentic machines by Case IH, CLAAS, DEUTZ-FAHR, Fendt, John Deere, KRONE, Massey Ferguson, New Holland, Valtra & many other acclaimed manufacturers from around the world - offering a wide range of farming activities. 

Choose what kind of farmer you want to be in Farming Simulator 23 (FS23) as the acclaimed agricultural sim by GIANTS Software offers a brand-new experience with many new features for your mobile device!

Operate realistic tractors, harvesters, field sprayers, and more
Cultivate fields with a variety of crops, or harvest grapes and olives on the hillside
Start logging with heavy forestry equipment 
Establish production chains and use powerful trucks for transport
Tend to farm animals like cows, sheep, and now: chickens!
Enjoy tons of possibilities on two new maps, including collectibles
New gameplay features also introduce plowing and weeding
A tutorial mode, AI helper & a new autoload feature for logs/pallets assist you on your farm 

There’s a lot more to do after plowing, removing weeds, harvesting crops, or collecting eggs from chicken coops: Produce valuable goods made from your harvest to expand your flourishing business with new factories and production chains! 

Don’t worry - there is always time to relax and walk around your vast arable land while visuals change through the atmospheric seasons. If more than 100 machines are not enough, you can grow your fleet of agricultural vehicles through official extra content.

New and improved in-game tutorials show you the ways of the farm if you’re new to country life. Start farming wherever you go and let the good times grow!

name: GTA: San Andreas – Definitive
description:
Five years ago, Carl ‘CJ’ Johnson escaped the haze of Los Santos, San Andreas...a city tearing itself apart with gang trouble, drugs, and corruption. Now, it's the early 90s. CJ’s got to go home - his mother has been murdered, his family has fallen apart, and his childhood friends are all heading towards disaster. On his return to the neighborhood, a couple of cops frame him for homicide, forcing CJ on a journey that takes him across the entire state of San Andreas, to save his family and to take control of the streets in the next iteration of the series that changed everything.

name: Oversummer Survival
description:
Oversummer Survival is a card-based survival game where every day on a remote tropical island is a fight to stay alive.

After your cargo plane crashes into the ocean, you somehow survive and wash ashore on an unknown island. There is no sign of civilization, no way to call for help, and no telling how long you will be stranded. With only what you can find around you, you must learn to survive.

Find food, collect materials, hunt animals and catch fish. Build a shelter, craft useful tools and find a way to turn unsafe water into something you can drink. Every decision costs precious time and resources, and even a small mistake can put your survival at risk.

In Oversummer Survival, your journey is shaped by the cards you’re dealt. Each day brings new opportunities and new dangers. Hunt for food, search for water, endure scorching heat, survive tropical storms and deal with whatever the island throws your way.

No two attempts are quite the same. Randomly generated cards force you to adapt, take risks and make the most of what you have.

The longer you survive, the more you leave behind for your next attempt. Unlock badges based on how many days you manage to stay alive and use their bonuses in future runs. Start with extra food, additional materials, increased luck and other advantages that may help you survive just a little longer.

How many days can you survive before the island finally gets the better of you?

name: Overwinter Survival
description:
Overwinter Survival is a card-based survival game in which you are stranded on the glaciers of Greenland.

The cold and loneliness ensnare you after your plane breaks down for an unknown reason, leaving you crashed on Greenland's glaciers and seeking shelter at a nearby cabin. Now you must hunt, craft tools and items, and keep your stove fueled to survive in the cold.

In Overwinter Survival, you must use the cards you're dealt to stay alive. You can only use one card per round. With Lady Luck at the helm, no two journeys will be the same.

Fish in the glaciers, hunt with your spear and craft an axe at your workshop to become a lumberjack. To get out of this frozen hell and see your family once again, you must stay alive and repair your plane. 

Experience a unique journey each time you play with randomly generated card decks and test your survival skills while pushing your luck amidst the frozen glaciers.

name: Absolum
description:
A magical cataclysm left magic mistrusted by the common folk and Sun King Azra took advantage of this panic, enslaving wizards through his Crimson Order and conquering more and more lands. With the help of high enchantress Uchawi, a small group of rebels rises from the shadows.

Fight as the outcast heroes of Talamh in a fierce battle to retake magic from Sun King Azra’s grasp in Absolum, an original roguelite beat ‘em up by Dotemu.

FEATURES

​Join the rebellion! With the help of the high enchantress Uchawi, wield forbidden magic to free the lands of Talamh from the iron grip of Sun King Azra.

Four heroes, each with their own fighting style: start playing as the calm but deadly Galandra or as Karl, the last free dwarf of Talamh, and discover the prodigious Brome and the enigmatic Cider as they join your journey.

Craft new strategies and get more powerful every run to defeat Azra’s elite guard through a gameplay that blends the best of arcade beat’em up action with modern roguelite mechanics.

From the majestic mines of Grandery to the lush forests of Jaroba, delve into an original fantasy world that comes alive through gorgeous art, masterful animation and a magnificent soundtrack by composer Gareth Coker (Ori, Halo Infinite, Prince of Persia), featuring collaborations with other legendary composers.

​Lead the uprising against Azra's regime as a lone hero, or team up with an ally through the two-player online coop mode. Combine your elemental powers and synchronize your attacks into incredible chained combos!

CAREFULLY REDESIGNED FOR MOBILE
- Revamped interface – exclusive mobile UI with complete touch control
- Game Center achievements
- Cloud Save – Share your progress between iOS devices
- Compatible with MFi controllers
- iPhone 17 Optimization (including Pro Max)

name: Geometry Dash
description:
Jump and fly your way through danger in this rhythm-based action platformer! 

"Frustratingly wonderful" - Kotaku

"Geometry Dash provides all of the challenge expected from an “impossible” game while also making it more accessible to newcomers."
- 148Apps

"Geometry Dash is a fast-paced platformer that will leave you screaming in frustration, but you’ll keep coming back for more."
- AppAdvice

Prepare for a near impossible challenge in the world of Geometry Dash. Push your skills to the limit as you jump, fly and flip your way through dangerous passages and spiky obstacles. 

Simple one touch game play with lots of levels that will keep you entertained for hours! 

Game Features 
• Rhythm-based Action Platforming! 
• Lots of levels with unique soundtracks! 
• Build and share your own levels using the level editor! 
• Unlock new icons and colors to customize your character! 
• Fly rockets, flip gravity and much more! 
• Use practice mode to sharpen your skills! 
• Game Center achievements with rewards!
• Challenge yourself with the near impossible!

For more info visit GeometryDash.com

name: Monument Valley
description:
** Apple Game of the Year 2014 **
** Winner of Apple Design Award 2014 **

In Monument Valley you will manipulate impossible architecture and guide a silent princess through a stunningly beautiful world.

Monument Valley is a surreal exploration through fantastical architecture and impossible geometry. Guide the silent princess Ida through mysterious monuments, uncovering hidden paths, unfolding optical illusions and outsmarting the enigmatic Crow People.

"Forgotten Shores": Eight new chapters of adventure and illusion available now as a separate purchase.

Buy or download Monument Valley now and you’ll also get our fully animated iMessage sticker pack, including 5 stickers exclusive to players! Only available on iOS10 and above.

=======

"This might be the most beautiful iPad game of 2014"  - Wired

"Brilliant design... stayed with me like a dream I didn't want to forget"  9/10 - Polygon

"The most sublime hour my iPad has ever given me... and the value of such a thing is incalculable" - Kotaku

"Monument Valley stuns with it's serenity... each screen is a work of art" - Huffington Post

"Almost impossibly gorgeous... a feast for your senses" 5/5 - Touch Arcade

=======

BEAUTIFUL

Inspired by minimalist 3D design, optical illusions and palaces and temples from around the world, every monument is a unique, hand-crafted world to explore.

EASY TO USE

Twist and drag to reshape the world and help Ida to explore.  Designed to be easy for everyone to pick up, enjoy and complete.

SOUND

Audio reacts to your manipulation of the world to provide a surreal and beautiful soundscape.  Best experienced with headphones.

iCloud

Synchronize your game across all your devices.

** Monument Valley is designed for iPhone 4 and above.  It is NOT compatible with iPod Touch 4th Generation.

name: Incredibox
description:
Incredibox lets you create your own music with the help of a merry crew of beatboxers. Choose your musical style to start laying down, recording and sharing your mix. Get your groove on with hip-hop beats, electro waves, pop voices, jazzy swing, Brazilian rhythms and much more. As well, discover a selection of mods created by the community. Plenty to keep you mixing for hours, with no ads or microtransactions.

Part game, part tool, Incredibox is above all an audio and visual experience that has quickly become a hit with people of all ages. The right mix of music, graphics, animation and interactivity makes Incredibox ideal for everyone. And because it makes learning fun and entertaining, Incredibox is now being used by schools all over the world.

How to play? Easy! Drag and drop icons onto the avatars to make them sing and start to compose your own music. Find the right sound combos to unlock animated choruses that will enhance your tune.

Once your composition sounds great, just save it and share it to get as many votes as possible. If you get enough votes, you may go down in Incredibox history by joining the Top 50 chart! Ready to show your stuff?

You can also download your mix as an MP3 from the app and listen to it over and over again!

Too lazy to create your own mix? No problem, just let the automatic mode play for you!

Pump it up and chill ;)

****************
Incredibox, the brainchild of Lyon, France-based studio So Far So Good, was created in 2009. Starting out as a webpage, it was then released as a mobile and tablet app and became an instant hit. It has won several awards and appeared in various international media, including: BBC, Adobe, FWA, Gizmodo, Slate, Konbini, Softonic, Kotaku, Cosmopolitan, PocketGamer, AppAdvice, AppSpy, Vice, Ultralinx and many others. The online demo has attracted more than 100 million visitors since its creation.

name: Minesweeper: Daily
description:
Minesweeper, the way it should be: pure logic, zero distractions, and a fresh board waiting for you every single day.

Five classic difficulties, unlimited custom boards, and a new Daily Challenge that pits you against the same minefield as players around the world. Three visual themes. One purchase. No ads, no subscriptions, no tracking.

THE DAILY CHALLENGE
Every day brings one shared board, generated from the date. Same layout for everyone, resets at midnight. You get 3 scored attempts a day and the best time counts; a failed attempt never reveals the remaining mines, and the center 3×3 area is always mine-free. Race the daily leaderboard, build your streak, and unlock the Unbroken Streak achievement at 7, 30, and 100 days.

FIVE CLASSIC DIFFICULTIES + CUSTOM
Beginner 9×9 (10 mines) · Intermediate 9×12 (20) · Expert 9×16 (30) · Ultra 12×21 (50) · Hell 16×30 (99) · Custom up to 36×64 with any mine count. Boards are sized for comfortable thumb reach, with pinch-to-zoom on the biggest fields.

PLAY IT YOUR WAY
Drag the theme slider to switch between iOS, Candy, and Neon — the board re-skins live as you drag. Background music and game effects have independent toggles.

FEATURES
• First-tap safety on classic and custom boards (the Daily starts you from a mine-free center)
• Chord tap — tap a satisfied number to clear its neighbors
• Long-press or flag mode to mark mines
• Hint button when you're truly stuck
• Cascading reveals, explosion shake, and flag-drop animations
• Pause & resume automatically in the background
• Haptic feedback on flag, win, and loss
• Best times, daily records, and streaks tracked locally
• 16 interface languages
• iPhone (portrait) and iPad (portrait & landscape)

OPTIONAL GAME CENTER
Six leaderboards (five difficulties plus a daily board) and seven achievements. Entirely optional — the game is complete without it.

ONE PURCHASE, NOTHING ELSE
No ads. No in-app purchases. No subscriptions. No analytics, no third-party tracking. Play fully offline; the only optional network feature is Apple Game Center.

Rediscover the puzzle that taught the world to think in numbers.

name: Pou 3D
description:
Do you have what it takes to take care of your very own alien pet?! Feed it, clean it, play with it and watch it grow up while leveling up and unlocking different outfits to satisfy your unique taste. How will you customize your Pou? 

Feed and take care of Pou, and watch it grow! Play games and collect coins! Customize Pou's appearance! Try out new outfits, hats and other accessories! Customize your house and garden! Unlock achievements and special items! Visit and play with your friends!

We are preparing to add so many features, items and games! We're also always listening to your suggestions to improve the app and add new stuff! 

If you find any issue, just contact us and we will help you! (We can't reply to comments)

https://help.pou3d.me

name: Apollo Justice Ace Attorney
description:
Court Is Back In Session

Star as rookie defense attorney, Apollo Justice, as he visits crime scenes, questions key witnesses and collects vital evidence before stepping into the courtroom to prove his clients’ innocence.

Features:
· All-new high-resolution graphics
· A new touch screen interface
· Interactive forensic testing mini-games that allow players to reveal hidden clues by dusting for prints, testing for traces of blood, and other exciting techniques.
· Two distinct gameplay segments:
o Investigation phase – survey crime scenes, interview witnesses and gather forensic evidence that will be used in court
o Trial phase – present findings from the investigation to support your case, listen to testimonies and examine witnesses
· An eclectic cast of characters:
o Apollo Justice: Stepping into the shoes of Phoenix Wright, the new rookie attorney leads the series into an exciting next chapter
o Klavier Gavin: Lead prosecutor, Apollo’s nemesis and rock star legend
o Kristoph Gavin: the coolest defense attorney on the judicial circuit, and Apollo’s mentor.
o Trucy: A mysterious magician and Apollo’s assistant

The initial purchase price includes half of episode one. The remaining episodes can be acquired through in-app purchases

Recommended Devices:

https://www.capcom-games.com/product/en-us/apollojustice-aceattorney-app/?t=openv

Please be aware that we can neither guarantee the app's performance nor offer refunds if you use a device or OS not supported by the app.

PLEASE NOTE: “Apollo Justice: Ace Attorney” offers some optional in game content that requires payment. You can turn off the payment feature by disabling in-app purchases in your device’s settings.

name: Fish in a Watch
description:
Eat or be eaten as you play as a fish stuck inside an Apple Watch (or an iPhone)!

The Apple Watch game works best for Apple Watch Series 4 and up. Works OK on Series 3.

Steer your fish fin by turning the Apple Watch crown back and forth. Or swipe on your phone.

Avoid being eaten by bigger fish and get bigger by eating smaller fish. And there might just be a jellyfish or two lurking in the deep.

name: FRAMED
description:
FRAMED is a multi-award winning noir-puzzle game where you re-arrange panels of an animated comic book to change the outcome of the story.

AWARD-WINNING DESIGN

Featuring a fusion of all-new game mechanics & fiendish puzzles, FRAMED has received many design awards as well as being an 'Excellence in Design' finalist  in the IGF 2015.

EFFORTLESSLY ELEGANT

Simply grab comic panels and swap them with a touch of your finger!

BEAUTIFUL ART & RICH ANIMATION

Hand-crafted, award-winning art and animation brings the noir world of FRAMED to life.

ORIGINAL JAZZ MUSIC SOUNDTRACK

An evocative music score featuring live jazz performances fused with modern themes and beats sets the mood.

A BRAND NEW EXPERIENCE AWAITS

name: Fieldrunners
description:
OVERVIEW

The invasion begins!  Pint sized soldiers are storming your country - do you have what it takes to defeat them?   Customize your strategic defenses using a wide selection of powerful weapons.  Control the battlefield with a vast array of tactics against countless waves of unique land and air invaders! Countless hours of entertainment and replayable challenges!  Enjoy a growing experience through DLC maps! 

Do you have what it takes to stop the fieldrunners and rise to the top as the ultimate tower defense champion? 

KEY FEATURES

• Retina display support for gorgeous artwork!
• Addictive gameplay for hours of action!
• Over 800 waves across 8 unique battlefields!
• 11 devastating weapons for ultimate defenses!
• Stunning visuals in a hyper detailed world!
• Epic amounts of achievements!
• Full Game Center integration!

Experience the award winning tower defense game like never before thanks to full Retina display support!  Stop the invading fieldrunners by creating mazes out of powerful weapons in this classic strategy game.  Control the battlefield using limitless strategies and a diverse selection of upgrade-able towers!

• Facebook: facebook.com/fieldrunners

• Forums: subatomicstudios.com/forum

THANK YOU

Everyone here at Subatomic Studios thanks you for playing our first game! Please rate Fieldrunners to show your support.

name: Religion Inc. God Simulator
description:
You’re reading this. But why?

Are you looking for a game, or has the game found you?

Religion Inc. is a god simulator and strategy sandbox about creating religions, exploring beliefs, and watching civilizations develop.

People have always asked questions about life and the world around them. They have turned to faith, philosophy, and tradition in search of understanding and meaning. Religious teachings grow from these ideas, traditions, and ways of seeing the world.

What if you were to found a new religion? How might human history unfold if a new teaching began with you?

You are the creator.
You are the source.
You are the inspiration.

And if you’re reading this, you’re already in the game!

CREATE YOUR OWN RELIGION

It all begins with the first follower.

Consider the cultures of different regions, respond to story events, and adapt your strategy as the world changes. Civilizations develop, and people’s traditions, views, and beliefs change with them.

Will your teachings change the world? Or will the world change your teachings?

EXPLORE, EXPERIMENT, CREATE

Every religion is a new path.

What will your faith become? Which ideas will you choose? What story will you tell?

description:
*THIS IS OFFICIAL LUDO KING® GAME

1 Billion Downloads!

* New Quick Ludo Mode available
* Voice Chat available

Ludo King is the modern version of the royal game of Parchisi, a game played between Indian kings and queens in ancient times. Roll the dice to play and move your tokens to reach the center of the board. Beat the other players to become the Ludo King. Play this dice game Ludo King. Best casual game in board games.

Ludo has different names in different regions and countries like Fia, Fia-spel (Fia the game), Le Jeu de Dada (The Game of Dada), Non t'arrabbiare, Fia med knuff (Fia with push), Cờ cá ngựa, Uckers, Griniaris, Petits Chevaux (Little Horses), Ki nevet a végén, برسي (Barjis/Barjees). People also misspell Ludo as Loodo, Lido, Lado, Ledo, Leedo, Laado, or Lodo. 

Ludo's versions are Trouble, Sorry, Aeroplane chess, Chopat, Chaupur, Pachisi or Parcheesi.

Features of Ludo King:
•	No internet connection required! Play against the computer.
•	Play with your family and friends through Local and Online Multiplayer.
•	Play with 2 to 6 Players in Local Multiplayer Mode.
•	Invite and challenge your Facebook Friends in a Private Game Room and beat them to become Ludo King.
•	Play with world players and make them your buddies.
•	Private Chat with your Facebook friends & Buddies.
•	Play Snake and Ladders on 7 different gameboards.
•	Simple rules which can be followed by players of all ages.

Play the game of Kings with your family and friends. While the gameplay might seem simple at first, the game is immensely enjoyable and challenging. It’s fun for the whole family; You’ll be playing this one for hours. Try to beat your opponents and compete for the highest scores on the leaderboards.

How to play Ludo King:
The objective of the game is pretty straightforward; each player gets 4 tokens, these tokens must make a full turn of the board and then make it to the finish line. Whoever gets all four tokens to the end first is the winner. However, each move can only be made based on the number decided by casting a six-sided die, and each token can only move out of their home by casting a six. Additionally, the competition factor of the games is upped by the fact that while moving if another player’s token lands on the same square as your token, then your token will automatically be sent back home and you’ll need to roll a six again.

Another nostalgic game similar in structure is Snakes and Ladders. Ludo King now incorporates this classic game as a whole new level. The objective of the game is simple: you start on 1 and you have to be the first one to make it to 100. However, you can only move the same number of tiles as the number you roll on a die. As the name suggests, the board is also littered with snakes and ladders. If you land on the same tile as the beginning of a ladder, then you can take the ladder as a shortcut and move on up. But if you land on the mouth of a snake, then down you go to its tail. A game of ups and down, Snakes and Ladders has been a favorite for generations; and now you can play it too, with Ludo King.

name: Kulfi: Games for Couples
description:
You talk to them every day. And still, by 10pm, you're both just trading reels and typing "kya kar rahe ho" for the ninth time. You're not fighting. You're not bored of each other. You're just out of things to do.

Nobody warns you about this part of loving someone in India. A lot of us don't share a city, forget a room. The whole relationship lives inside a phone. Two grey ticks, a few voice notes, one call before bed. So much love stuck inside a very small screen.

Three of us built Kulfi, and we were all in the same spot. Long-term partners we love, who make our day. But once the day's been talked through, it all starts to repeat. What we missed wasn't the conversation, it was their presence. We didn't want to sit alone at night scrolling Instagram. We wanted to be in the same room as them, even when we couldn't. Half our video calls were just silence, nothing left to say. And it wasn't only us. Almost everyone we knew was in the same quiet.

Here's the only promise we care about: no couple on Kulfi should have a boring conversation again. We take that dead late-night chat and turn it into banter, teasing, a bit of fighting, and a lot of "wait, that's not fair."

Kulfi doesn't work like anything you've played. The games run across two phones, yours and theirs, at once. Some split the controls between you, so it's one game, one boat, each holding one half. Mess up your side and you both go down together.

Here's the part we love most. It's made for when you're already on a call. Put Kulfi on while you're on a video or audio call at night, and play straight through it. You're on the call anyway. This is what you do during it.

One house rule. No singles allowed. You invite your partner, send them a code, they punch it in, and you're paired. Till then, the games stay locked. Sounds a bit harsh, but that's the point. Kulfi is a two-person club, and if you're inside it, you've already got the one thing it asks for.

And you won't run dry. We add fresh games every single week. That's a founder promise, not a marketing line. We're trying to keep our own partners entertained, so trust me, the new stuff keeps coming.

Here's some of what's inside:

Pirate Escape
One boat, two captains. One wrong tap and you're both underwater. Stay in sync, or sink.

Snatch the Fries
The plate's between you and there was never enough. Grab fast. Love is conditional now.

Yeet the Spider
Aim, hold your nerve, fling it before the music stops. Don't ask, just throw.

Basketball Rivalry
Twenty seconds on the clock, zero mercy. Outscore them, or hear about it all night.

Four in a Row
Looks innocent. Ends relationships. Drop your coin, block theirs, act like you planned it.

Never Have I Ever
The cards ask, you answer honestly. Some answers you'll wish you could take back.

Who's More Likely To
You each lock in a guess. Then the reveal. Then the argument that lasts an hour.

Pillow Talk
The soft one. A quiet prompt, a real answer, the kind of 2am talk you don't get over text.


Underneath all of it, there's Roadtrip. The more you play, the more miles you and your partner rack up, and your little car moves further across the map. You unlock new cities, crack clues for what's next, and slowly take the road trip you keep saying you'll go on someday. Every other Kulfi couple is on that road too. You can't always meet. You can still go somewhere together.
One honest thing. Nearly every app you live on, Instagram, Snapchat, WhatsApp, was built somewhere else. India has over 200 million couples, and Kulfi is the couples app built in India, for India. We want it in the hands of every couple in the country.

So that's our ask. We built this to solve our own problem and sweated every detail. Download it, play it, and tell us honestly what's broken and what you loved. And please, spread the word. We're a young company, every download counts, and the fastest way Kulfi reaches the couple who needs it is you.

See you on the road,
The founders of Kulfi

name: Salvage Empire: Build & Battle
description:
Free to download and play, with optional in-game purchases, including random items.

From one rusty tow truck to the biggest salvage yard in the desert.

Nobody out here hands you anything. You roll into town with a tow truck, a toolbox, and the deed to a dirt lot full of dead cars, while every rival crew already owns a yard. This is a game about building a salvage business from scratch: tow the wrecks, pull the parts, rebuild what's worth saving, and sell everything from a single tire to a running ride. Put the profits back in until that lot is the yard everyone for a hundred miles knows by name.

TOW THE WRECKS

Day one: one tow truck, one wrench, and a yard full of rust. Haul in totaled sedans, dead pickups, and crashed muscle cars, and when a rare one goes up for auction, make sure it comes home with you. Every wreck is worth something to somebody.

PULL, SORT, SELL

Pull the engines, tires, gears, and chrome. Sort the parts into piles across the lot, crush the leftovers into scrap, and sell everything from a single spark plug to a fully rebuilt engine. Each sale pays for a bigger yard, a stronger crane, and one more bay in the garage.

BUILD YOUR YARD

Upgrade a tin shed into a working garage. Open an engine shop, a tire shop, and a gear workshop, then unlock bigger lots, stronger cranes, and better tools. The bigger the yard, the more wrecks it can take in, and the more parts and rides roll out the other end.

EXPAND YOUR FLEET

Not every wreck gets sold for parts. Rebuild the toughest frames into running rides, from rat rods and pickups to station wagons and dune buggies, and put them to work. Send the fleet out to haul in wrecks from across the desert, run parts to buyers in the next town over, and back up your crew when a rival shows up at the gate. The bigger the fleet, the harder you are to push around.

RECRUIT YOUR CREW

Hire mechanics, drivers, welders, and the odd fast-talking auctioneer, each with their own skills, attitude, and story. Train them, promote the best, and send them to run the shops, lead the fleet, and stand their ground when a rival crew comes calling. A crew is only as tough as the boss who runs it.

CRUSH THE COMPETITION

Rival crews want what you've built, and sooner or later they come rolling up to your gate. Hold your ground, crew against crew, then beat them where it counts: outbid them at auction, out-haul them on the road, and out-build them at home until their yards run dry. Take over their yards, hang your sign on the gate, and send them packing. Team up with allied crews to hold what's yours, and win the map one yard at a time. Keep winning, and every ride in the desert runs on your parts.

Build the crew. Crush the competition. Own the desert. Your tow truck is parked at the gate, keys in the ignition. Download now and go haul in your first wreck.

name: Bus Crowd - Traffic Jam
description:
Welcome to Bus Crowd, a colorful bus puzzle game built around traffic jam strategy, passenger matching, and smart parking choices. 

A crowded station is full of waiting passengers, and buses with different colors and seat capacities are ready to roll. Check the crowd, choose the right vehicle, then move it into an available parking slot for boarding. Fill every seat to release that slot, avoid a parking jam, and keep each Bus Crowd under control.

How to Play
- Match Colors and Seats: Empty buses enter the boarding slots to pick up waiting passengers of the same color. Each vehicle has its own capacity, so compare the crowd before making a move.
- Follow the Arrows: Move buses from the station into parking slots. Each vehicle can only drive in its arrow direction, so blocked paths need careful observation.
- Fill Buses to Open Slots: A full vehicle departs and opens its parking space for another move. Avoid leaving buses that are not fully filled in the slots for too long.
- Solve the Jam with Strategy: Use color sort logic, bus sort thinking, and car parking style planning to handle every traffic puzzle. 
- Use Boosters When Stuck: Helpful boosters can adjust buses, guide passengers, or open paths when a tricky jam blocks your progress. 

Game Features
- Bus Jam Puzzle Fun: Mix color matching, passenger boarding, parking slots, and traffic jam choices in a challenge that feels easy to start and satisfying to solve.
- Bus Out Challenge: Study the arrows, send the right vehicles out of crowded layouts, and enjoy the moment when a blocked station finally starts moving.
- Bus Escape Moments: Fill buses, open lanes, and create clever escape style solutions as each full vehicle leaves the station.
- Traffic Escape Challenge: Handle car jam inspired layouts, parking jam pressure, and bus rush moments with careful observation instead of random moves.
- Brain Teaser Levels: Count seats, compare passengers, and use smart strategy to solve each puzzle with a real sense of progress.
- Passenger Matching Flow: Watch large crowds stream into colorful buses, see vehicles depart one by one, and turn chaos into a smooth boarding flow.
- Diverse Boosters: Use different tools for buses and passengers, then decide which option gives the best value when the station gets tricky.
- Bright 3D Station Scenes: Enjoy vivid buses, lively passengers, smooth boarding animations, and relaxing traffic flow.

Bus Crowd is a colorful puzzle where every move counts. Match passengers with the right buses, open parking spaces, and keep traffic flowing through increasingly clever challenges. Perfect for fans of bus games, parking games, and traffic jam puzzles. Download Bus Crowd and clear the way!

name: Food Hunt: Pixel Puzzle
description:
Every level is a pixel art masterpiece. Your ants will devour it - one color at a time.

Food Hunt is a satisfying color sort puzzle where the puzzle board IS the art. Each level presents a hand-crafted pixel art image built entirely from colored blocks. Sort your ants by color, send them in, and watch them eat the picture clean - block by block, until the board is empty and the level is cleared.

HOW TO PLAY
The board is filled with a pixel art image - built entirely from colored blocks. Below the board: your holding slots and block stacks waiting to be tapped.

Tap a block stack to load your ants. They march up and devour every matching colored block in the image. Clear all colors - wipe the board completely - and you win.

But choose your order carefully:

- Holding slots are limited - wrong tap order fills them fast
- Stuck slots = ants can't move = game over
- Plan which color to clear first
- Eat every last block - board empty - level clear!

THE PIXEL ART IS THE PUZZLE
Forget collecting rewards after you win. In Food Hunt, the pixel art image is the challenge itself.

Every level is a different image, built from hundreds of colored blocks. Watch your ants devour it layer by layer, color by color, until nothing remains.

You don't unlock the art. You clear it. And that's exactly what makes it satisfying.

FEATURES
-  200+ color sort puzzle levels -  new images, new challenges
-  Cute ants with ASMR-quality chomping animations
-  Simple one-tap controls - play with one hand
-  No timer, no pressure - relax at your own pace
- Levels designed to surprise - no two boards look the same
- 2× speed mode for snappier ant action

EASY TO LEARN. HARD TO STOP.
Early levels are breezy. Later levels pack in more colors, tighter slots, and bigger images that demand real planning.

Which color do you clear first? When do you free a slot before it jams? Every tap matters.

A true logic brain teaser - wrapped in pixel art you'll actually enjoy destroying.

WHY YOU CHOOSE FOOD HUNT?
Most color sort games show you an empty grid and ask you to fill it. Food Hunt flips it - every board starts full, alive with pixel art, and your only goal is to wipe it clean.
Same satisfying sort. A completely different feeling. 

Download Food Hunt - the color sort puzzle where the art is the game.

name: Arrow Puzzle - Arrows Game
description:
Arrow Puzzle is a relaxing logic game that turns simple taps into a rewarding challenge. Your goal is straightforward: find a free path, tap arrows in the right order, and enjoy as the maze slowly turns into a clear, empty board. Follow the arrows to escape the puzzle and find a soothing flow that keeps your mind engaged and relaxed.

Looking for a gentle workout for your brain without any pressure attached? This comforting arrow game lets you tap away the stress, gives you a focused break from the noise, and helps you train your logic and spatial thinking as you build a calming daily ritual. Each cleared board in the arrow game is a small mental reset—a satisfying win for your mind.

How to Play Arrow Puzzle:

- In this tap away puzzle game, your goal is to clear the grid—a maze of arrows all pointing in different directions.
- Escape the arrow puzzle grid by finding a free path. An arrow moves only when its way ahead is clear and no other arrows are blocking its path. Take a moment to think first.
- Tap arrows away one by one to help them leave the grid and open up more space for the others.
- Avoid blocked arrows. If you tap an arrow whose path is blocked, you lose a life. Lives are limited on each level, but you can always rethink your plan and try again at your own pace.
- If you get stuck, use helpful hints to highlight an arrow that can safely escape the maze.
- Plan the order of your taps, help every arrow escape, and enjoy the moment when the last arrow leaves and everything falls into place.

Why You'll Love Arrow Puzzle:

• A minimalist arrow game with simple rules and deep strategy—easy to start, satisfying to master.
• Hundreds of handcrafted tap away style puzzles that grow in challenge as you play.
• Daily Challenges—play every day, complete monthly challenges, and collect unique trophies.
• Helpful hints when you need a small nudge to release an arrow and keep the flow going.
• No timer, no pressure—a relaxing escape and a true delight for your mind.
• Clean, calming visuals and smooth animations that keep the focus on puzzle-solving in this tap game.

Play Arrow Puzzle, clear the grid of arrows, and enjoy a rare balance of sharp focus and deep relaxation.

Nuts Factory Features
- Level Up the Challenge: Levels grow progressively harder, starting simple and gradually becoming a true test of strategy and patience. Every step is more exciting than the last!

name: Chromagraph Camera
description:
Replace your phone camera’s default processing with bespoke, curated color and texture rendering designed by cinematographer Steve Yedlin and used on the Knives Out films.

Chromagraph starts from raw image data and builds the image its own way: not a filter laid over the usual look processing, but a different process from the start.

(Chromagraph is a stills-only camera; it does not shoot video. Note that on some devices such as the iPhone 11, not all cameras support raw capture and will not be usable in Chromagraph)

SHOOT FIRST, SEE THE LOOK AFTER
As with a film camera, you frame through the viewfinder and see the finished look only after the image is processed. Take the picture, then open the gallery to see it with the Chromagraph look applied.

ADJUST WITHOUT LOSING THE LOOK
Intuitive yet powerful tools for color, tone, and texture give you real control while keeping every image true to the look that’s the core of the app.

A GALLERY THAT KEEPS THE ORIGINALS
Store full-quality raw files and view them in the app with the look applied live, along with any adjustments you make. Export smaller files to share with friends or save to your photo library, or turn on auto-export in Preferences to send every photo to your library right away as a JPEG or HEIC with the look applied.

NOT A FILTER
A filter sits on top of the processing your phone has already done. Chromagraph skips that processing and uses its own methods for the curated look preferred by director Rian Johnson and cinematographer Steve Yedlin.

name: AnkiMobile Flashcards
description:
Your decks, wherever you go! AnkiMobile is the official Anki app for iPhone and iPad, the flashcard app that more than 15 million learners worldwide have loved and trusted for over 20 years, made by the team behind Anki and AnkiWeb. Your purchase directly supports the open-source project that keeps Anki desktop free for everyone. Sync is included at no extra cost: no subscription, no sync fees. 

What you get:
 - Free sync with AnkiWeb. Keep your decks and study progress in sync across iPhone, iPad, Mac, Windows, Linux, and the web. Add cards on your computer, study them on your phone.
 - The same SM-2 and FSRS scheduling as desktop Anki, so you review material right as you're about to forget it.
 - A flexible interface designed for smooth and efficient study.
 - Detailed graphs and statistics about your progress.
 - Support for large collections, including 100,000+ cards.
 - Offline study. Media (images and audio) is stored on your device.
 - Powerful search for building filtered decks, e.g. "tagged high priority, answered in the last ten days, and not containing these words".
 - MathJax equations and LaTeX rendering.
 - Apple Pencil support for adding hand-drawn images to cards.

Good to know: AnkiMobile works alongside the desktop version of Anki. Some tasks might require the desktop version, and add-ons are not supported on mobile yet.
Sync is optional. You can also import and export data over USB or AirDrop.

Buy once and use AnkiMobile on all your devices with the same Apple ID. Family Sharing is also supported. Educational institutions can find bulk discounts information through Apple's Volume Purchase Program.

Need help? The manual and support resources are at https://docs.ankiweb.net/ankimobile/support. If you have questions or want to report an issue, contact us through our support site.

name: TypeDraw
description:
Pay-per-book: Your first notebook with unlimited pages is included with your initial purchase, and you can add up to four more books for a one-time fee of $1.99 each. All features included, forever. No subscriptions, ever. That is a promise. 

TypeDraw brings the joy and simplicity of a paper notebook into the digital world, with smart tools to find your notes whenever you need them and endless ways to make it yours. All topped off with stunning cover art options made by real humans and endless ways to personalise your notebook.

No account required. Your notes stay local and private on your device, or sync through your own iCloud account if you choose. Your data stays yours, and you can even lock your book. Export a single page or your whole book as a PDF and send it to your files, your agents or your mother.

- Opens to what matters in the moment: a fresh page, your most recent note, or a note from that restaurant you’re finally visiting again after years. To enter swipe the book cover or jump straight into what you need with a beautiful Home Screen widget. 

- Type, draw and write anywhere, just as you would in a real notebook. Link Notes, add photos, PDFs, timestamps, checklists, titles, bullet points and more to your notes. Turn the pages with a curl or a tap, sketch with your fingers, or use Apple Pencil on iPad and iPhone Duo. It adapts to how you want to use it: whether you prefer typing, drawing or using Apple’s Scribble feature, TypeDraw adjusts to you, not the other way around.

- Enjoy a free canvas where text and drawings belong together. Highlight or underline text, and your strokes automatically convert to responsive “Smart Marks” that adapt when you edit words, change line breaks or adjust the layout. 

- Make it yours! Pick lined, grid, blank or dotted paper and explore 12 handwritten typefaces from Shaped Fonts, choose from all preinstalled iOS system fonts or even upload your own. And if that’s not enough, turn your handwriting into a font you can type with in just minutes. Choose your page colour, ink colour, font size and text colour for all pages or just one specific page, and go wild. Ooh, and wait until you’ve seen our gorgeous Dark Mode.

- Choose from beautiful cover artworks from our own TypeDraw collection or explore premium art from illustrators like Gabor Estefan and make your notebook something truly satisfying to look at every time you open it. Take that, generative AI!

- Add up to four additional notebooks to your setup. Each requires a small one-time in-app purchase so we can keep the app subscription-free. Switch between books by long-pressing the cover, selecting one in Settings or, on iPhone Duo and iPad, swiping in the desk view.

- Keep an overview with a table of contents you can sort by page number, time or location… so the notes nearest to you are always easy to find. All notes are searchable, too, and you can reorder them with a simple drag and drop.

- Have fun and don’t take life too seriously!

iTablaPro is the first electronic tabla and tanpura that actually sounds like the real thing, ideal for Indian Classical musicians and students. It includes support for all common taals used in Hindustani music, making it the perfect companion for daily riyaz (practice). And the beautiful Tanpura and Swar Mandal create an instant concert atmosphere!
________________________________________

√ SIX fantastic instruments in one app: Tabla, two 5-string Tanpuras, a Sur-Peti (Shruti-Box), Swar Mandal, plus Manjira all controlled by a single set of pitch controls
√ Uses sound samples from actual highest-quality instruments for the most realistic sound
√ 47 taals: Ada Chautaal(14), Ardha Jai(6.5), Ardha Jhaptaal(5), Ardha Shikhar(8.5), Ashta Jhaptaal(8.5), Bhajani(8), Chachar(16), Chartal-ki-Sawari(11), Chautaal(12), Dadra(6), Dakshinatya Rupak(6), Deepchandi(14), Dhamar(14), Ektaal(12), Farodust/Firdost(14), Gajamukha(16), Jai Taal(13), Jat(8), Jhampak(5), Jhaptaal(10), Jhoomra(14), Kalawati(9.5), Keherva(8), Matta Taal(9), Moghuli(7), Neel Taal (7.5), Pancham Sawari(15), Pashto(7), Pauri/Paudi(4), Punjabi / Sitarkhani(16), Rudra Taal(11), Rupak(7),Saatva(7), Sadra(10), Sardha Rupak(10.5), Sasthi(6), Shashanka(5.5), Shikhar(17),Shiva Taal(9), Soolfaak(10), Soolfakhta(5), Sooltaal(10), Sunand(9.5), Teentaal(16), Teevra(7), Tilwada(16), Yamuna(5)
√ Multiple styles for most taals or use the EXPERT MODE for a more interactive experience
√ INTEGRATED AUTO-TUNER: Auto-Tune iTablaPro to your instrument such as harmonium, or use it to tune other instruments
√ MANJIRA: Manjira auto-play support for taals used in bhajans such as Bhajani, Keherva and Dadra
√ CORE MIDI support: The app syncs with all CORE MIDI apps incl. iLehra to sync taal & tempo. Turn on "Wi-Fi Sync" in the app Settings > Misc section
√ AUDIOBUS support: Now you can stream live audio directly to other Audiobus-compatible apps! See http://audiob.us for more information.
√ RECORDING (Optional) add-on now with RECORDING: Hear yourself in the speakers to the background of iTablaPro using the iPhone or headset microphone and record everything (requires external speakers with wired connection or headphones). Additional purchase required.
√ METRONOME: Includes metronome with the most common time signatures!
√ TAP TEMPO: Just tap out a beat on the lower display and watch the app sync the tempo!
√ MIXER: Full-featured mixer to adjust volume & panning of each instrument independently.
√ 7-BAND EQUALIZER: Customizable 7-band equalizer with presets
√ PRESETS: Save your frequently-used combinations as named presets. Includes presets for the 100+ most popular raags. And now you can also export/import presets via email or iTunes File Sharing.
√ BACKGROUND PLAY: Start playing the music and switch to another app or play along with iPod music
√ Includes an option for "Sur" tabla for a more bass tabla sound suitable for vocal music
√ Extremely accurate tempo from 10bpm to 700bpm (depending on the taal)
√ Wide range of pitch from lower A (A2) through upper E (E4) for one and a half octaves of tuning
√ Each taal has different thekas for slow, medium & fast tempos for more natural-sounding accompaniment

NOTE: The tabla's bayaan sound is very bass-intensive and cannot be full heard through the iPhone/iPod/iPad internal speaker. For best effect, use a speaker dock, external speakers, or high-quality headphones.

name: Jump Desktop (RDP, VNC, Fluid)
description:
Leave your laptop behind. Enjoy the freedom to work from anywhere.   

Jump Desktop is a remote desktop application that lets you securely connect to any computer in the world. Compatible with both RDP and VNC, Jump Desktop is secure, reliable and very easy to set up. Jump Desktop also supports our own, high performance, next generation remote desktop protocol called Fluid Remote Desktop. 

Easy setup and reliable:
Jump Desktop is very easy to setup; anyone can do it! Just visit: https://jumpdesktop.com on your PC or Mac, click the ‘Automatic Setup’ link and follow step-by-step instructions. You’ll be up and running in no time. Also - not subscriptions!

Secure:
Jump encrypts the connection between computers to ensure privacy and security. Automatic connections are always encrypted by default. Supports NLA, TLS/SSL encryption for RDP. SSH Tunnelling and SSL/TLS encryption for VNC. Fluid Remote Desktop uses DTLS for secure connections.

Powerful features:
* Works with almost any computer and operating system.
* Supports physical mice! On iOS 13 and iPadOS, Jump Desktop supports the accessibility mouse with some limitations. Jump Desktop also supports special physical mice with no limitations. For more information visit https://jumpdesktop.com/mice. 
* Fluid Remote Desktop protocol supports high performance remote desktop and audio.
* Easy and secure setup: Automatically configure your PC or Mac for remote access using Wi-Fi/3G/LTE without worrying about your router settings. Setup as many computers as you like – there are no limits! 
* Built for iPad Pro, iPad, iPhone and iPod
* iPad Pro features: Full support for split-screen multitasking and Apple Pencil. 
* Open multiple simultaneous connections
* Live connection previews
* Protect your server settings using Touch ID
* Connection syncing via iCloud connection syncing
* Advanced Bluetooth keyboard: The best bluetooth keyboard support on the App Store. Shortcuts, function keys and arrow keys - everything works. Also includes macros for keys no available on bluetooth keyboards (i.e function keys)
* SSH tunneling with password and public key authentication supported
* Supports large custom screen resolutions and VGA/HDMI out 
* Full mouse support via touch gestures: left, right and middle button clicks, dragging, scrolling, precision pointer movement
* Multiple gesture support - includes the ability to draw or write using your finger
* Copy/paste: Transfer text to or from your computer using the pasteboard
* HDMI/VGA external monitor support: View your desktop on an external monitor using a cable or AirPlay. Jump Desktop will let you utilize you external display as a true monitor (not as a mirror like other apps on the store). 
* Multi-core rendering engine makes Jump Desktop one of the fastest RDP and VNC engines on the planet
* Full support for Linea and Infinea barcode and MSR scanners. Includes support for E2E encryption.

RDP features:
* Supports RD Gateway
* Supports custom resolutions. Set any resolution you want including Retina resolutions.
* Dynamic RDP resolution updates on Windows 8.1+
* Remote printing: Send print outs from your computer to your iPad/iPhone device (exclusive RDP print redirection feature on the App Store!)
* Folder sharing
* Audio streaming
* Console sessions
* International keyboard layouts
* Multiple monitor support on Windows 7+
* Multi-touch redirection support on Windows 8+

Fluid Features:
* Super high performance, adaptive remote desktop
* Audio streaming 
* Strong encryption built into the protocol
* Connect from anywhere, even restricted networks without requiring networking knowledge
* Clipboard sharing

VNC features:
* Tested with Mac OS X, TightVNC, RealVNC, UltraVNC, Linux (Ubuntu Remote Desktop)
* Secure: Supports SSH tunneling as well as SSL encryption
* Black & white, gray scale, 8, 16 and 24-bit color to help optimize bandwidth
* Multiple monitor support
* Macs: Support locking the Mac's screen and syncing the pasteboard

name: Le Conjugueur

Why choose Le Conjugueur?

name: BeMu - Local MP3
description:
Your music should stay yours. BeMu is a one-time purchase with no in-app ads and no subscriptions. Play local audio files offline, organize your library, and control playback from your iPhone, iPad, Home Screen, Apple Watch, or CarPlay.

EVERY FEATURE IS INCLUDED
There are no feature tiers or recurring payments. Buy the app once and use the complete player.

KEY FEATURES
- Live radio: Find stations by name, country, or genre with Radio Browser, add them to your library, and listen live. Internet connection required. Broadcasts may include ads.
- Podcasts: Add shows from recommendations or an RSS feed URL, stream episodes or download them for offline listening, and resume where you left off. Downloads stay on this device. Internet is required for discovery, streaming, and downloading.
- Offline local playback: Enjoy MP3, M4A, WAV, FLAC, ALAC, and other supported audio formats.
- Library and playlists: Browse all songs, artists, albums, genres, favorites, and your own playlists.
- Home Screen widgets: See what is playing, control playback, or quickly start your library and playlists.
- Apple Watch controls: View and control playback on your iPhone from your wrist, including volume, favorites, repeat modes, and playlists.
- CarPlay support: Browse playlists and control playback safely from your car display.
- Synced lyrics: View LRC lyrics or lyrics embedded in ID3 tags while listening.
- A–B repeat: Select a section on the waveform and repeat it for practice or close listening.
- Flexible playback: Adjust speed and pitch independently, use repeat and shuffle, or set a sleep timer.
- Equalizer: Choose a preset or create a custom sound profile.
- Metadata editing: Update MP3 title, artist, album, track number, genre, and artwork in the app.
- Playlist tools: Add covers, manage the queue, mark favorites, and copy songs between playlists.

Built for people who want a focused local music player without accounts, in-app ads, or subscriptions.

DISCOVER POPULAR CONTENT
View country popularity lists from Apple Music, Apple Podcasts, and Radio Browser. Music chart entries play only when a matching playable song exists in your local library; no music files are supplied. Browse curated podcast/radio catalogs, search external directories, or add a public RSS/stream URL. Suggest missing programs for administrator review. BeMu does not upload your listening history for rankings.

LISTEN TOGETHER WITH SHAREPLAY
Choose and arrange music or podcast episodes, invite others, and listen together. Music file sharing requires consent; received files are temporary and are not added to the library. Data charges may apply, and participants may keep copies. Each podcast participant plays from the publisher or their own downloads. A compatible app version and an available SharePlay connection are required.

OPTIONAL ICLOUD SYNC
Enable music, radio, and podcast sync separately on each device using the same iCloud account. Sync playlists and song information, saved stations, subscriptions, and podcast progress. Music files remain in their original location by default; connect originals on each device. Separately enabled music copies use additional iCloud storage and transfer over Wi-Fi. Podcast downloads are device-local and do not sync.

name: Just Press Record
description:
Just Press Record is the ultimate audio recorder bringing one tap recording, transcription and iCloud syncing to all your devices. You can edit your audio and transcriptions right inside the app and even start a new recording completely hands-free with Siri!

Life is full of moments we would rather not forget - like your child’s first words, an important meeting or spontaneous idea. Capture these moments effortlessly on iPhone, iPad, Mac or for ultimate convenience, Apple Watch.

RECORD
• One tap to start, stop, pause and resume recording.
• Start and stop recording from the Lock Screen, Control Centre, the Action Button, Shortcuts, Siri, the Widget, a 3D Touch Quick Action or via the URL scheme.
• Unlimited recording time.
• Record discretely in the background.
• Choose to record from the built-in mic, AirPods or external microphones.
• Record independently on Apple Watch and sync later.

PLAY
• Seek backwards and forwards during playback.
• Adjustable playback speed.

TRANSCRIBE
• Turn speech into searchable text.
• Support for over 30 languages, independent of your device's language setting.
• Synchronized text highlighting and audio playback.
• Format as you record with punctuation commands.

EDIT
• Audio - visualise your audio in the waveform view and cut out the parts you don’t need.
• Text - make corrections and add new text to your transcriptions.

SHARE
• Share audio and text to other apps.
• Share easily to social media as a video clip.
• Share to iTunes on Mac or PC via USB cable.
• Print a hard copy of your transcripts.
• Share audio files from other apps to Just Press Record. 

ORGANISATION
• View recent recordings or browse your library by date and time.
• Search by filename or transcription content.
• Dedicated tab for quick access to recordings made on Apple Watch.
• Rename recordings.
• Slide Over and Split View support on iPad.
• Add a badge to the app icon showing the number of unplayed recordings.

STORAGE
• Choose to store recordings in iCloud Drive or locally on-device.
• Recordings stored in iCloud Drive automatically sync across all your devices.
• Recordings stored locally benefit from Files app integration and automatic iTunes File Sharing.
• Transcriptions are stored within the audio file.

PRO-AUDIO
• Support for stereo recording from the built-in microphone on supported devices.
• Support for high quality external microphones connected via the Lightning Port.
• Customisable Audio Settings to enhance your recording experience.
• File types include WAV, AIF or standard iTunes M4A (ACC).
• High quality audio up to 96kHz / 24-bit.

ACCESSIBILITY
• VoiceOver support throughout the app.
• Magic Tap gesture to start / stop a recording.

APPLE WATCH
Just Press Record includes an Apple Watch app that gives you the freedom to record anywhere, even when your iPhone is not around.

• Start recording with a single tap on the Complication.
• Record discretely in the background.
• Unlimited recording time.
• Recordings automatically transfer to iPhone for transcription and iCloud syncing.
• Listen to recent recordings through the built-in speaker or AirPods.
• Adjust volume with the Digital Crown.
• Pause recording with a downward swipe.
• Accessibility support with VoiceOver, reduced motion and support for the extra large Complication template.

IMPORTANT:
• Just Press Record does not record phone calls or audio from other apps.
• Transcription requires a good, clean audio signal.  Avoid recording in noisy environments and ensure the microphone is positioned close to the source.
• URL scheme implemented by Just Press Record can be found on our FAQ page.
