name: Streaks
description:
STREAKS. The habit tracker that helps you build good habits and break bad ones.
Apple Design Award winner.

Choose up to 24 habits you want to keep, and build a streak of days in a row. Streaks works on iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Mac and Apple Vision Pro, and keeps everything in sync with iCloud.

BUILD HABITS YOUR WAY

* Track a habit every day, on specific days, a few times a week, or every few days
* Set goals over a week, fortnight, month or year, such as 10,000 steps a day or 3 workouts a week
* Break bad habits with negative tasks: quit smoking, drink less coffee, spend less time on your phone
* Time habits such as meditation, reading or brushing your teeth, with a Live Activity on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island
* Record a note for any day
* Reminders arrive around when you usually complete a habit, only if it isn't done yet

AUTOMATIC WITH APPLE HEALTH AND SCREEN TIME

* Streaks completes habits for you from more than 80 types of Apple Health data, including steps, workouts, sleep, water, mindful minutes and calories
* Log water, mindful minutes or toothbrushing in Streaks and it's saved to the Health app too
* Screen Time habits track how long you spend in apps, so you can cut back on your phone

“I was smoking 15 cigarettes each day. Streaks helped me to quit smoking by reducing and then eliminating my daily use.” - Ben, Adelaide.

ON EVERY APPLE DEVICE

* Interactive widgets for your Home Screen and Lock Screen let you complete habits without opening the app
* A full Apple Watch app, with complications for every watch face
* Siri and Shortcuts support
* Share a habit with a friend or family member who also uses Streaks, so they can encourage you and keep you accountable

MAKE IT YOURS

* Over 30 colour themes, including animated themes and seasonal looks
* Over 800 habit icons
* The Gold theme celebrates the days you complete every habit
* Statistics for your current and best streaks, completion rates and history

“I've now reduced my coffee intake by 70% with Streaks, something I struggled with for 5 years. It's a life changing app to me.” - Otávio, Chicago.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Do I need an account?
No. There's no sign-up or login. Your habits are stored on your device and synced through your own iCloud account, not on our servers.

Which devices does Streaks work on?
iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Mac and Apple Vision Pro. The apps sync with each other through iCloud.

Can I share Streaks with my family?
Yes. Streaks supports Family Sharing.

Does Streaks have ads or tracking?
No. Streaks has no ads and doesn't track you.

Does it work offline?
Yes. You can complete habits without a connection, and they sync the next time you're online.

How many habits can I track?
Up to 24, across four pages of six.

Can I track a habit weekly, or a few times a week?
Yes. A habit can repeat daily, on chosen days, a number of times per week, fortnight, month or year, or every few days.

Does it work with Apple Health?
Yes. Streaks reads and writes Health data with your permission, so habits like steps, workouts, sleep and water complete automatically.

Is there a version for kids?
Yes. Little Streaks is a separate app with routines and rewards for children.

Questions, suggestions or other feedback? Please email support@streaks.app.

If you like Streaks, please leave us a review! Your reviews enable us to keep improving and updating the app.

ABOUT HEALTH DATA

On supported devices, Streaks reads and writes data in the Health app with your permission, to determine completion of your tasks and to save what you log. All data is accessed in full accordance with the app review rules set by Apple. Please read our privacy policy at https://streaks.app/privacy for more information on our use of data.

• A fluid, expressive playing surface with finger vibrato, slide, and intelligent pitch rounding

• AUv3 plug-in support with parameter automation
• iCloud preset synchronization
• MIDI/MPE In/Out support

The GeoSWAM and Naada instruments can be performed from the GeoShred keyboard, MPE controllers, conventional MIDI controllers, and wind controllers.

Praise for the GeoShred Family of Apps

name: HealthFit
description:
Turn your Apple Watch into a complete training platform.

HealthFit transforms the workout and health data stored in Apple Health into advanced fitness metrics, training insights, and seamless workout syncing—with no account required.

Whether you're training for your next race, improving your fitness, or simply staying active, HealthFit helps you understand your progress, optimize your training, and achieve your goals.

TRAIN SMARTER

Go beyond basic workout summaries with advanced training analytics designed to help you make better decisions.

HealthFit helps you understand:

• Training Load
• Fitness (CTL), Fatigue (ATL), and Form (TSB)
• Training Load Ratio
• Heart Rate Zones and Training Distribution
• Year Comparisons and Trends
• Explorer Score and Training Heat Maps

These are the kinds of metrics and insights typically reserved for premium coaching platforms.

EVERYTHING IN ONE PLACE

HealthFit combines your workouts, fitness trends, and health metrics in a beautifully designed app.

No more jumping between multiple apps. Track your training load, fitness progression, health metrics, and workout history from a single dashboard.

A BETTER ACTIVITY FEED

Browse all your workouts with maps, photos, and key metrics visible at a glance.

Dive deeper into every activity with advanced analysis including:

• Customizable Heart Rate Zones
• Training Load Tracking
• Equipment Tracking (Shoes, Bikes & More)
• Elevation, Pace, Power & Cadence Analysis
• Detailed Charts & Performance Trends

HealthFit can even automatically associate photos taken during your workouts, bringing your activity history to life.

POWER INSIGHTS

Analyze your running and cycling power with advanced metrics including:

• Estimated Critical Power
• Weighted Average Power
• Mean Maximal Power Curves
• Power Distribution Analysis
• Historical Power Trends

Understand how your power evolves and identify your strengths across different durations.

HEALTH METRICS FOR ATHLETES

HealthFit provides a focused view of the health metrics that matter most, helping you understand how your health, stress, and fitness evolve over time.

• Heart Rate Variability (HRV)
• Resting Heart Rate
• Cardio Fitness (VO₂ Max)
• Sleep Metrics
• Weight, BMI & Body Fat
• Baevsky Stress Index

Everything is presented clearly so you can connect your health trends to your training performance.

BUILT FOR EVERY SPORT

Most fitness apps focus on running and cycling.

HealthFit supports all activity types and automatically adapts its statistics, charts, and analysis to your most frequent activities, whether you specialize in a single sport or enjoy a variety of activities.

AUTOMATIC WORKOUT SYNCING

HealthFit automatically syncs your workouts in the background to all your favorite fitness platforms.

Every workout recorded with Apple Watch is uploaded automatically—no manual exports, no extra steps, no missing activities.

You can even sync your entire workout history.

MULTISPORT SUPPORT

HealthFit fully supports multisport and interval workouts and is one of the few apps capable of exporting multisport activities as true multisession workouts.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS

Privacy is a core principle of HealthFit.

No account required. No login required.

HealthFit works directly with Apple Health and keeps your data on your device—giving you powerful fitness insights without sending your personal data to the cloud.

CONNECTS TO YOUR FAVORITE FITNESS PLATFORMS

Supported services include Strava, TrainingPeaks, Final Surge, Selfloops, Smashrun, Ride with GPS, Cycling Analytics, Today's Plan, Runalyze, Suunto, 2PEAK, Komoot, COROS, Intervals.icu, Nolio, TrainAsONE, Tredict, Stages Link, Map My Tracks, and Xhale.

name: HRV4Training
description:
The only scientifically validated HRV app that works without an external sensor. Measure for one minute in the morning with your phone camera or a chest strap, and get one clear answer on how your body is coping with training and everything else in your life.

VALIDATED
• Camera and chest strap measurements validated against ECG in peer-reviewed studies
• Built by scientists: over a decade of research and published papers on HRV
• Used by athletes, coaches and teams since 2013

HOW IT WORKS
• Measure for one minute after waking up: phone camera or Bluetooth chest strap (we recommend a Polar H10). Oura or Coros night data can be used instead
• See your HRV and resting heart rate against your own normal range, so you know what is typical for you
• One clear answer every morning: proceed as planned, or adjust. A different way to look at your physiology
• Data that matters, that no wearable can track: a 20-second questionnaire on motivation, muscle soreness, fatigue and mental energy, linked to your HRV
• Tag sleep, training, travel, alcohol, sickness, the menstrual cycle and more, and see what moves your HRV

INSIGHTS
• Baseline: your 7-day HRV and resting heart rate against your normal range, to spot meaningful changes
• Long-term HRV trends, not just a number
• Correlations between your physiology and your tags
• Training load: fitness, fatigue and how you respond to training
• VO2max estimates for runners and cyclists, linking Strava or TrainingPeaks, lactate threshold estimation and training zones
• Training polarization, weekly and monthly summaries

FOR COACHES
• HRV4Training Pro: a web dashboard to follow teams and athletes

OTHER FEATURES
• PPG signal shown during camera measurements, to check signal quality
• RR-intervals shown in real time when measuring with a chest strap
• Heart rate, AVNN, SDNN, rMSSD, pNN50, LF and HF
• RR-interval artifact correction
• Population comparisons
• Data export and integrations with Strava, TrainingPeaks, Oura, Coros, Apple Health and others

FROM THE CO-AUTHOR OF
Heart Rate Variability: Science and Strategies for Peak Performance (Human Kinetics, 2026)

PHONE COMPATIBILITY
The app checks right away whether your phone's camera is supported. Most iPhones work very well, but models with flash and camera very far apart (e.g. the iPhone 18 Pro) are not recommended. In these cases we recommend a Polar H10 chest strap, the most accurate sensor for HRV measurement.

YOUR DATA
All data is processed in the app. An account with your email keeps your data backed up and lets you restore it if you change phone.

More on HRV and how to use the app: https://marcoaltini.substack.com

name: Plezy: Media Server Client
description:
Plezy is a modern client for Plex, Jellyfin, and Emby, built for high-quality playback, effortless discovery, and offline access. Connect multiple servers at once and enjoy your media in one clean, native app—no subscription required.

BROWSE & DISCOVER
- Browse libraries, collections, playlists, folders, extras, and personalized recommendations

name: Your Stressy
description:
Stressy turns what your Apple Watch already measures into one number: your reserve, from 0 to 100%.

Sleep fills it. Stress drains it. Calm slows it down. Glance at your wrist or your iPhone and you know how much you have left today.

YOUR MORNING STARTS WITH YOUR NIGHT
Deep sleep refills your reserve fastest. Stressy reads how your heart and HRV recovered overnight against your own usual, so a short or restless night starts you lower and a good one starts you high.

THROUGH THE DAY
Every five minutes, your heart is compared with your own calm. Stress drains the reserve, calm slows the drain, mindful minutes and naps recharge it. Workouts and walks count as effort, never as stress.

SEE EXACTLY WHY
Your whole day in one curve, your stress every five minutes, every activity with what it cost or gave back, and an ⓘ on the key numbers that shows what made today's figure. Every past day is a tap away in a calendar.

YOUR DAY, IN WORDS
Every page opens with an AI Summary of what its numbers mean: your day, your night, your week, workouts, Readiness and more, written by Apple Intelligence, Apple's own on-device model, right on your iPhone: offline, never in the cloud. Pick its voice, from balanced to a savage friend.

LOOK AHEAD
• Readiness: whether today suits hard training. Plan a workout and see tomorrow's wake-up with and without it.
• Bedtime coach: when to be in bed for your sleep goal, on a Liquid Glass dial.

OVERNIGHT VITALS
Last night's heart rate, breathing, wrist temperature, blood oxygen, HRV and time asleep, each against your own usual range, on iPhone, Apple Watch and widgets.

YOUR BODY, AGAINST YOURSELF
• Body Age: how old your fitness and habits look, in years, built the way researchers build biological age.
• Cardio Fitness: your VO₂max, calculated by Stressy from your own runs, walks, hikes and rides, or the 12-minute Fitness Test on Apple Watch.
• HRV and Heart: your 7-day HRV against your own range, resting and walking heart rate, every workout in its zones and how fast your heart comes down after.
Every step of the math is shown, with the studies behind it. Wellness estimates, not medical ones.

YOUR WHOLE DAY
Steps and distance hour by hour, workouts with their route, pace and heart rate zones, and stories of your day, night, steps or a workout to share, made right on your iPhone.

ON YOUR WRIST AND EVERY SCREEN
The living tank on Apple Watch with your day, sleep, vitals and readiness, complications and the Smart Stack, and widgets for your Home Screen and Lock Screen: stress, sleep, steps, readiness, tonight's bedtime, your day in words, and Mosaic, the widget you build yourself.

MADE FOR iPHONE DUO
Open iPhone Duo and your number and your whole day sit side by side. Closed, it works like any iPhone.

DESIGNED FOR iOS 26 AND LATER
A living liquid tank, glass numbers that hold their own liquid, and Liquid Glass throughout. Light and dark appearance, Dynamic Type, VoiceOver and Reduce Motion.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No servers. No analytics. No ads. Your health data is read on your iPhone and Apple Watch and never leaves them. One price, no subscription.

WHAT YOU NEED
An iPhone and an Apple Watch. Stressy reads sleep, heart rate, HRV, resting and walking heart rate, cardio recovery, breathing rate, blood oxygen, wrist temperature, workouts and their routes, distance, active energy, running speed, cycling power, weight, steps and mindful minutes from Apple Health, plus your age and sex. Wear your watch to sleep for the best results; your personal baseline settles in within about a week.

Stressy is a wellness app, not a medical device. Your reserve is an estimate to help you notice how sleep, stress and rest shape your day.

name: Pragmatic Audio PEQ
description:
Pragmatic EQ is a parametric equaliser for iPhone and iPad. On iOS 27 or later, select its virtual audio output in Control Center to stream audio from compatible music players through your EQ.

CORRECT YOUR HEADPHONES
• Browse measurement databases and OPRA community presets to find EQ profiles for your headphones or in-ear monitors.
• Import Filters.txt profiles, including separate left and right filter files.
• Edit individual parametric bands, shape bass and treble, or use a fixed-band editor.
• Save personalised profiles and adjust headroom or set the preamp manually.

HEAR THE DIFFERENCE
• Compare No PEQ and PEQ while music plays, with optional volume matching and blind A/B comparisons.
• Experiment with crossfeed, tube, vinyl and other effects.

SEE WHAT YOU HEAR
• Live visualisations include spectrum bars, EQ graphs, a spectrogram, level meters, VU meters and a colour spiral.
• Visualisations run while their view is active.

CHOOSE YOUR LAYOUT
• Keep the scrollable one-page layout or switch to tabs in Settings.
• A Welcome guide explains how to connect music, load a profile and create your own.
• Choose light, dark or system appearance and your interface language.
• Optional audio recovery reminders help you reopen the app when needed.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, ads or tracking. Audio is processed locally and is not recorded, stored or transmitted. The microphone is never used.

REQUIREMENTS AND PLAYBACK LIMITATIONS
iOS/iPadOS 27 or later is required for the virtual audio output. Open the app, start music in a compatible player, then select Pragmatic EQ in Control Center. Some players and video modes do not support this route. If iOS returns to your previous output, reopen the app and select Pragmatic EQ again.

Pragmatic EQ builds on open source work, including EffectDeck and EffeTune (MIT licence) and the OPRA preset database (CC BY-SA). See About in the app for credits and licences.

name: On Pace: Steps vs Average
description:
Are you walking more or less than usual today? One glance at your wrist answers it.

On Pace draws the comparison you know from the Health app (today so far against your average day) and puts it where you actually look: on your Apple Watch face and on your iPhone Home Screen.

THE GRAPH, ON YOUR WATCH FACE
An orange line for today, a grey line for your average, and the two numbers that matter. It fits the large rectangular slot of Modular and Infograph Modular, and the Smart Stack. Smaller slots show how far along your usual pace you are.

THE SAME NUMBERS AS THE HEALTH APP
The day graph averages the previous four weeks, hour by hour, exactly as Health does. What you see on your wrist matches what you see in Health.

DAY, WEEK, MONTH AND YEAR
This week against your usual week. This month against your usual month. This year against the years before it.

LIKE WITH LIKE
Mondays are not Saturdays. Compare today with the same day of the week, or this November with your other Novembers.

BARS, TOO
Hours of today, the last seven days, the last twelve weeks or months, side by side with their average.

NOT ONLY STEPS
Distance, active energy and flights climbed get the same graphs. If you use a wheelchair, it counts pushes and wheelchair distance instead.

WIDGETS ON IPHONE
Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets with the same comparison.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
On Pace reads your activity from Apple Health, with your permission, and never writes to it. Your data stays on your iPhone and your Apple Watch. No account, no servers, no analytics, no ads.

Apple Watch is optional: the iPhone app and widgets work on their own.

name: My Money - Track Expenses

name: Due - Reminders & Timers
description:
Due remembers all the things that you need so you don't have to.

It reminds you again and again until you act, so it’s impossible to forget anything.

And it's lightning-fast to set and postpone reminders, all thanks to a clever time picker and natural date parsing.


KEY FEATURES

1. Persistent & Effective
Auto Snooze* keeps nudging you about a missed reminder until you mark it done or reschedule it. Choose between every 1, 5, 10, 15, 30 and 60 minutes.

2. Impossible to Miss
Some reminders can't wait. Use Critical Alerts to get through silent mode and Focus. Or use Prominent Alerts†, which ring like an alarm until you act.

3. Fast to Set, Fast to Postpone
Keep the times you use most a tap away. Twelve Quick Access Times—all fully customizable—make setting or postponing reminders a piece of cake.

4. Just Type or Say It
Type or say “Dentist 3p Thu” or “Meeting in 1h 20m”. Due spots the date, and one tap sets it.

5. Powerful Recurring Reminders
From simple daily reminders to the every-3rd-Wednesday-of-the-month kind, Due keeps up with your routine.

6. Countdown Timers
Not every reminder happens at a time of day. Some happen when the laundry cycle is done. That's what timers are for: precise to the second, with Auto Snooze too. Or just say “Hey Siri, start Laundry timer in Due”.

7. On Your Apple Watch
Wear an Apple Watch? Due comes with you. Mark reminders done, snooze them, add new ones, start and stop timers—all from your wrist. It's a companion to Due on iPhone, so keep your iPhone nearby.

8. Widgets, Control Centre & Shortcuts
See what's coming up on your Home Screen and Lock Screen. Start timers and add reminders from Control Centre, and automate the rest with Shortcuts.

9. Everywhere You Are
Your reminders and timers on your iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Mac‡, all kept in sync with iCloud or Dropbox.

10. No Account, Completely Private
There's no account to sign up for. We don't store, and we can't access, your reminders and timers. And you don't need internet to receive reminders.

11. Accessible to Everyone
Due follows the text size you set on your device, on every screen, and offers full VoiceOver support. It's also localized in 17 languages.


* By default, auto snooze repeats 5 times, and can be configured to repeat up to 10 times. Due can auto snooze any overdue items indefinitely when you launch Due or act on any of its notifications.
† Prominent Alerts require iOS 26 or later.
‡ Sync on Mac requires Due for Mac (sold separately).


WHAT'S THAT IN-APP PURCHASE ABOUT?

When you purchase Due today, you will have access to every feature in the app today—no further purchase required.

You will also get every new feature released within a year of your purchase.

The optional Due Upgrade Pass subscription gives you access to new features released after that first year.

And here's the deal: Every feature that you have unlocked will remain available to you, forever—even if you stop subscribing.

Even without a subscription, you'll always receive bug-fix and compatibility updates for free. These updates add support for the latest iPhones, iPads and Apple Watches, and keep Due working well on the latest versions of iOS, iPadOS and watchOS.

Due has a pretty good track record with that.

To illustrate: If you bought Due back in 2010 for your iPhone 3G running iOS 4, that very same app in 2026 is now optimized for iPhone 18 Pro Max running iOS 27. It even works on devices that didn't exist back then, such as the iPhone Duo, the iPad Pro and the Apple Watch.

TERMS & PRIVACY POLICY

Our terms of use and privacy policy are available here: https://www.dueapp.com/terms.html


COMPATIBILITY

Due requires an iPhone or iPad running iOS 18 or later. The Apple Watch app requires watchOS 10 or later, and your paired iPhone nearby.

name: Flipcorder: Retro Camcorder
description:
Flipcorder is your retro camcorder for daily video diaries. Film your day 20 seconds at a time, and tonight relive it as one unedited home movie, like an old camcorder tape. One price, paid once: no subscription, no watermark, no ads, nothing locked.

Record Daily Flips
• Experience the unique daily tape: everything you film lands on today’s dated 30-minute cassette, in order, for a true retro camcorder feel.
• Easily record 20-second “flips” with a simple tap, each stopping and saving automatically with a calm countdown.
• You always have control to record longer flips, but the day's tape is always limited to 30 minutes.

One Unedited Home Movie
• Watch your day as a single, unedited home movie, playing back exactly as you filmed it - authentic video the way it used to be.
• Apply classic VHS looks with bleeding colour, tracking wobble, and a date stamp, or the crisp, clean look of MiniDV.
• Change a tape’s look at any time: the original footage is never touched, so the choice stays yours.
• Tap the picture to watch a tape full screen, and every flip keeps the local time where it was filmed, so the date stamp still reads right after a trip.
• Hop from flip to flip, or wind the cassette round with your finger to find a moment.

Stickers and the Camcorder Bag
• Earn stickers as you film: first flips, full tapes, days on tape and a few hidden surprises. A new one slaps onto the viewfinder, then hops onto today’s cassette, and its tape keeps it.
• Keep them in your camcorder bag, with your Home Video Club card, this week on tape, your spare tapes and your sticker sheet.
• A kind streak counts the days you film. Spare tapes, earned with a full week of flips, cover the odd day off, and Put it in the bag pauses the count while you’re away.
• Share your bag, your week or a new sticker as a little card, tall or square. Cards never show your footage.

A Theme for Every Day
• Today’s blank cassette offers a theme of the day. Tap Take the theme and it becomes the tape’s label, carried on the end card of your saved movie. Theme of the day can be switched off in Settings.

Save and Share Memories
• Save your whole tape to Photos as one movie with a title card, either with the chosen camcorder look rendered in or as clean 1080p video, ready to share. Never a watermark over your footage. Rather just the flips? Turn off Title and end cards in Settings.
• Turn on Remember where flips were filmed, and Photos can show where a saved tape was filmed. The movie file itself never carries the place.
• Turn on gentle reminders if you like: a quiet morning nudge or an afternoon check-in while today’s tape is blank, and an evening note when it’s ready to play.
• Put today’s tape on your Home Screen as a cassette, with one tap to open the camcorder or play your day’s movie, plus Streak, This week and Next sticker widgets for the Home Screen, and Streak on the Lock Screen and in StandBy too.

Built for iPhone Duo
• Unlock exclusive features for iPhone Duo, where the fold acts as the power switch, a camera lens is on the cover, and the subject sees a live retro preview with a REC light on the outer screen.
• Close it to save a flip at once. Or stand it half open on a table like a little laptop: the picture above the fold, the keys below.

In Your Language
• Flipcorder speaks English, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Dutch, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Polish, Japanese, Korean and Traditional Chinese. The camcorder’s own lettering, like REC and PLAY, stays as printed.

Flipcorder is a one-time purchase, with no subscriptions, in-app purchases, ads, watermarks or accounts. There’s no Pro version: everything above is included. Your videos stay on your phone until you save or share them. Anonymous usage stats help make the app better: never your footage or anything you type, and Settings > Share crash reports and usage stats turns them off.

Open Flipcorder tomorrow morning and make your first home movie memory.

With seamless cross-platform and multiplayer gameplay on Minecraft: Bedrock Edition, you can adventure solo or with friends and discover an infinite, randomly generated online world filled with blocks to mine, biomes to explore, and mobs to befriend (or battle) in a universe of crafting!

In Minecraft, the world is yours to shape!

• Discover new flight routes and connect with aviation enthusiasts worldwide.

An internet connection is required for full simulation and multiplayer features.

GET READY TO SOAR THE SKIES!
Buckle up and become a Real Pilot in RFS - Real Flight Simulator!

name: Grand Theft Auto: Vice City
summary: Welcome back to Vice City. Welcome back to the 1980s.
description:
Welcome back to Vice City. Welcome back to the 1980s.

From the decade of big hair, excess and pastel suits comes a story of one man's rise to the top of the criminal pile. Vice City, a huge urban sprawl ranging from the beach to the swamps and the glitz to the ghetto, was one of the most varied, complete and alive digital cities ever created. Combining open-world gameplay with a character driven narrative, you arrive in a town brimming with delights and degradation and given the opportunity to take it over as you choose. 

To celebrate its 10 year anniversary, Rockstar Games brings Grand Theft Auto: Vice City to mobile devices with high-resolution graphics, updated controls and a host of new features including: 

• Beautifully updated graphics, character models and lighting effects 
• New, precisely tailored firing and targeting options 
• Custom controls with a fully customizable layout 
• Massive campaign with countless hours of gameplay
• Compatible with the MoGa Wireless Game Controller and select USB gamepads
• Integrated with Immersion tactile effects  
• Tailor your visual experience with adjustable graphic settings

name: GTA: San Andreas - Definitive
summary: Five years ago, Carl ‘CJ’ Johnson escaped the haze of Los Santos, San Andreas…
description:
Five years ago, Carl ‘CJ’ Johnson escaped the haze of Los Santos, San Andreas...a city tearing itself apart with gang trouble, drugs, and corruption. Now, it's the early 90s. name: Farming Simulator 23 Mobile
summary: Grow your agricultural empire with 100+ authentic machines!
description:
Grow crops, grow your agricultural empire! Become a modern farmer to operate more than 100 authentic machines by Case IH, CLAAS, DEUTZ-FAHR, Fendt, John Deere, KRONE, Massey Ferguson, New Holland, Valtra & many other acclaimed manufacturers from around the world - offering a wide range of farming activities. 

Choose what kind of farmer you want to be in Farming Simulator 23 (FS23) as the acclaimed agricultural sim by GIANTS Software offers a brand-new experience with many new features for your mobile device!

Operate realistic tractors, harvesters, field sprayers, and more
Cultivate fields with a variety of crops, or harvest grapes and olives on the hillside
Start logging with heavy forestry equipment 
Establish production chains and use powerful trucks for transport
Tend to farm animals like cows, sheep, and now: chickens!
Enjoy tons of possibilities on two new maps, including collectibles
New gameplay features also introduce plowing and weeding
A tutorial mode, AI helper & a new autoload feature for logs/pallets assist you on your farm 

There’s a lot more to do after plowing, removing weeds, harvesting crops, or collecting eggs from chicken coops: Produce valuable goods made from your harvest to expand your flourishing business with new factories and production chains! 

Don’t worry - there is always time to relax and walk around your vast arable land while visuals change through the atmospheric seasons. If more than 100 machines are not enough, you can grow your fleet of agricultural vehicles through official extra content.

New and improved in-game tutorials show you the ways of the farm if you’re new to country life. Start farming wherever you go and let the good times grow!

Farming Simulator 23 will be released on May 23, 2023, and is the latest official game in the successful simulation series available for mobile devices.

name: Stardew Valley

**Nominee of Game of the Year 2017 - BAFTA Games Awards**

BUILD THE FARM OF YOUR DREAMS:

“Far more than just a farming game... filled with seemingly endless content and heart.” Giant Bomb

name: Earn to Die
summary: Can you survive the zombie apocalypse? Choose your car and smash those zombies!
description:
Drive your way through a zombie apocalypse!

Are you ready to drive for your life? The hit online game series that has enjoyed OVER 200 MILLION PLAYS has been revamped and re-engineered for your mobile and tablet, bigger and better than ever before!

You're stranded in a desert surrounded by zombies. With only a run-down car and a small amount of cash at your disposal, your mission soon becomes clear – to drive through hordes of zombies in order to escape... alive!


THE BEST OF THE ACTION, DRIVING AND UPGRADE GENRES
Earn to Die sees you not only driving your way through hordes of zombies, but allows you to earn cash to upgrade, unlock and customise new vehicles. Is your vehicle not strong enough? Why not add a gun, or boosters, or even a spiked frame?



Key Features
● A brand new and extended STORY MODE which sees you driving cross-country during a zombie apocalypse
● 8 VEHICLES at your disposal, including a race-car, a truck and even a school bus!
● UPGRADES GALORE! Just unlocking a vehicle isn't enough, customise each vehicle with a range of upgrades
● Zombiesssssssssssss... Plenty of zombies... Be sure to introduce them to your car's front bumper
● A realistic ragdoll physics engine that allows you to crash into zombies and send them flying!
● Awesome animated sequences
● Race for the best time in Championship Mode
● Survived the zombie apocalypse? Smash through pumpkins in Halloween Mode



With over 200 Million Plays to the original online version, be one of the first to download the extended, BIGGER and BETTER version for your Android device.

name: Little Nightmares
summary: Escape your childhood fears.
description:
*Save up to 50%!*

First available on PC and consoles, the horror adventure tale Little Nightmares is available on mobile!
Immerse yourself in Little Nightmares, a dark whimsical tale that will confront you with your childhood fears!
Help Six escape The Maw – a vast, mysterious vessel inhabited by corrupted souls looking for their next meal.
As you progress on your journey, explore the most disturbing dollhouse offering a prison to escape from and a playground full of secrets to discover.
Reconnect with your inner child to unleash your imagination and find the way out!
Little Nightmares features a subtle mix of action and puzzle-platformer mechanics rooted in an eerie artistic direction and creepy sound design.
Sneak your way out of the Maw’s dreary maze and run from its corrupted inhabitants to escape your childhood fears. 

FEATURES

- Tiptoe your way through a dark and thrilling adventure
- Rediscover your childhood fears inside a haunting vessel and escape its eerie inhabitants
- Climb, crawl and hide through nightmarish environments to solve tricky platform puzzles
- Immerse yourself in the Maw through its creepy sound design

Please make sure your device is connected to Wifi to download the game for the first time.

name: Bike Mayhem Mountain Racing
summary: Rip down tons of mountains while busting tricks on your custom bike!
description:
Downhill mountain bike racing like never before. Race down beautiful trails, smashing over rocks and roots, boosting huge jumps, scoring insane trick combos, unlocking better bikes and gear for bragging rights as the King of the Mountain!

The best mobile bike game, Bike Mayhem Extreme Mountain Racing! 

Compete in timed races or freestyle trick events on 19 different mountains and over 100 trails inspired by real world locations.

Unlock over 80 items of gear to add style your rider and tune your bike for speed, agility, strength, and energy for each trail.

Experience realistic physics and plush bike suspension as your bike eats up the rough stuff and softens the landings of big jumps and drops. 
High speeds and big jumps means huge crashes where your rider will ragdoll tumble down the trail. Use your finger to pick up you rider throw him even further.

Share your races with your friends. Challenge them to beat your times! 

Brought to you by the makers of the epically popular Motocross racing game: Moto X Mayhem, which reached #1 Paid App worldwide and was a Top 5 Racing game for over a year! 

FEATURES: 

- 100+ Beautiful mountain trails for all styles of riding
- 80+ Gear items for your rider and MTB bike 
- Frame and wheel upgrades that impact game play
- Epic bike crashes, fun rag doll physics and active bike suspension
- Tricks, bunny hops and flips! 
- Addictive gameplay 
- Powerful online leaderboards

TIPS: 

- If you use check points, you will get a maximum of one star. Stay on your bike to achieve 3 stars! 
- Lean to add flips into your trick combo. 
- Wheelie into and out of a jump to add to your trick combo.
- Hold down the pump/hop button when entering a downhill section to get a boost in speed.
- Wheelies do not drain your energy
- The timer doesn't start until you start to pedal the bike or brake! 
- Use your finger to grab the rider and toss him around the map when you're on or off the bike. 
- Make sure you pick the right frame and wheel combination to get the best score for each trail.
-Use boosters to help you through a difficult trail or to get the top position on the leaderboard.

name: Mini Metro
summary: Design a subway map for a growing city.
description:
Mini Metro, the sublime subway simulator, now on Android. No ads or in-app purchases.

• 2016 BAFTA nominee
• 2016 IGF award winner
• 2016 IGN Mobile Game of the Year finalist
• 2016 Gamespot's Best Mobile Game selection

Mini Metro is a game about designing a subway map for a growing city. Draw lines between stations and start your trains running. As new stations open, redraw your lines to keep them efficient. Decide where to use your limited resources. How long can you keep the city moving?

• Random city growth means each game is unique.
• Over two dozen of real-world cities to test your planning skills.
• A variety of upgrades so you can tailor your network.
• Normal mode for quick scored games, Endless to relax, or Extreme for the ultimate challenge.
• Build your metro exactly how you want to with the all-new Creative mode.
• Compete against the world every day in the Daily Challenge.
• Colorblind and night modes.
• Responsive soundtrack created by your metro system, engineered by Disasterpeace.

Please note that Mini Metro is incompatible with some Bluetooth headphones. If you do not hear audio over Bluetooth, please try disconnecting your headphones and restarting the game.

name: The Sun Origin Post Apocalypse
summary: Post-apocalyptic action-shooter RPG.
description:
Autumn sale: Save 75% on The Sun: Origin!

The Sun: Origin is a post-apocalyptic action-shooter RPG that will challenge you to survive in a harsh and unforgiving world. Explore the wastelands, build your character, and fight for your life against mutants, bandits, and other survivors.

Key Features:

* Explore a vast and dangerous world: The wastelands are full of resources and dangers. Explore every corner of the map to find valuable loot, but be prepared to fight for it.
* Build your character: Choose from a variety of classes and customize your character's skills and abilities. Level up your character and become stronger as you progress through the game.
* Fight for your survival: The wastelands are full of enemies, both human and mutant. Fight for your life against bandits, raiders, and even other survivors.
* Craft your gear: Use the resources you find in the wastelands to craft weapons, armor, and other equipment. Build the best gear you can to survive in this harsh world.

The Sun: Origin is a challenging game, but it is also a rewarding one. If you are up for the challenge, then this game is for you.

Download The Sun: Origin today and experience the post-apocalyptic wasteland for yourself!

name: Driving Zone: Germany Pro
summary: Driving simulator with German cars. Racing car games without ads and limits.
description:
Driving Zone: Germany Pro – the premium version of the popular car game and street racing simulator, without ads or limitations. Experience the thrill of driving legendary German cars with ultra-realistic physics and graphics.

Pro Version Features:
- 20,000 bonus coins.
- Completely ad-free. Enjoy uninterrupted gameplay with no distractions.
- Free driving mode. Your car will never break down, allowing you to enjoy endless driving fun.
- Unified cloud save and progress synchronization with the free version of the game.

Explore a variety of game modes:
- Career Mode: Complete exciting missions like parking challenges, time-based races, overtaking in traffic, and long-distance driving.
- Driving School: Master essential driving skills in a test environment, navigating cones and learning advanced techniques.
- Street Racing: Compete on highways, city streets, or icy winter tracks with dynamic weather changes.
- Drift Mode: Perfect your drifting skills on sharp turns and earn points for style and precision.
- Drag Racing: Compete in high-speed, straight-line races on a 402-meter drag track.
- Replay Mode: Relive your best races and improve your strategy with cinematic replays.

Enhanced Tracks and Features:
The Pro version features many unique tracks, including:
- Bavarian Alps: Drive through challenging mountain roads with breathtaking views.
- Test Track: Learn driving mechanics in a controlled environment.
- Highway and city streets: Enjoy day or night drive on roads with dense traffic.
- Drag Strip: Push your car’s speed to the limit in drag races.

Additional Features:
- High-quality 3D graphics and ultra realistic car physics.
- Prototypes of legendary german cars with customization and tuning options.
- Dynamic day-night cycles and weather changes.
- Multiple camera angles: first-person, interior, cinematic views.
- Automatic cloud save for seamless progress syncing.

Start your engines and embark on the ultimate driving adventure without limits. Customize your car, master challenging tracks, and explore diverse gameplay modes in a premium, distraction-free experience.

Warning! This game is highly realistic, but it is not intended to teach or encourage street racing. Please drive carefully and responsibly in real life. Enjoy virtual driving in dense traffic, but always follow traffic rules and stay safe on real roads.

name: Tomb Raider™
summary: Lara Croft’s complete origin adventure, expertly adapted for Android.
description:
Before there was the Tomb Raider, there was Lara Croft; twenty-one years old and shipwrecked on her first archaeological expedition. To escape the mysterious isle of Yamatai, she must push far beyond her limits, leave innocence behind and be reborn a legend.

Explore Yamatai’s ancient ruins, unlock its riddles and fight for survival against its murderous inhabitants. 

Tomb Raider for Android is the complete adventure, expertly adapted for mobile. Play it your way, whether using intuitive touchscreen controls, mouse & keyboard, or your favourite gamepad.

TOMB RAIDER COMPLETE AND UNCUT
Lara’s first AAA outing on Android arrives without compromise — packed with exploration, intense firefights, puzzles and Challenge Tombs.

OVERCOME THE ODDS
Unlock skills, hunt for materials, and craft equipment to take Lara from desperate survivor to master adventurer.

UNCOVER A LOST KINGDOM
Discover lost relics and ancient scrolls to unravel the mysteries of Yamatai and the cultists who prowl its depths.

INCLUDES BONUS CONTENT
Tomb Raider for Android comes with 12 DLC packs, including Skills, Weapon Upgrades and a variety of skins for Lara, plus a bonus Challenge Tomb.

TAILORED TO ANDROID
Includes gyroscopic motion-aim on supported devices, as well as optimisation presets for improved performance or visuals.

===

Tomb Raider requires Android 13 or later. You need 12.5GB of free space on your device, though we recommend at least double this to avoid initial installation issues.

To avoid disappointment, we aim to block users from purchasing a game if their device is not capable of running it. If you are able to purchase this game on your device then we expect it to run well in most cases.

However, we are aware of rare instances where users are able to purchase the game on unsupported devices. This can occur when a device is not correctly identified by the Google Play Store, and therefore cannot be blocked from purchasing. For full details on the supported chipsets for this game, plus a list of tested and verified devices, we recommend that you visit:

name: Reporter - Scary Horror Game

description:

summary: DIG! FIGHT! EXPLORE! BUILD! Join the community of millions of Terrarians!
description:
The world is at your fingertips as you fight for survival, explore for fortune, and dig for glory. Delve deep into cavernous expanses, test your mettle in combat, or construct your own city!

Terraria offers more than ever - including the brand new 1.4.5 Bigger and Boulder Content! 

Presenting an impressive catalogue of 5,000+ items, 25+ NPCs, and 400+ enemies and blending elements of classic action games with sandbox-style creativity, Terraria is truly a unique adventure!

summary: Max Payne, the award-winning title is now available for Android mobile devices.
description:

A fugitive undercover cop framed for murder, hunted by cops and the mob, Max is a man with his back against the wall, fighting a battle he cannot hope to win. Max Payne is a relentless story-driven game about a man on the edge, fighting to clear his name while struggling to uncover the truth about his slain family amongst a myriad of plot-twists. 

The groundbreaking original cinematic action-shooter, Max Payne introduced the concept of Bullet Time® in videogames. Through its stylish slow-motion gunplay combined with a dark and twisted story, Max Payne redefined the action-shooter genre.

Max Payne Mobile for Android has been fully optimized for the NVIDIA® Tegra® 3 quad-core mobile processor with additional antistrophic texture filtering and enhanced lighting effects providing one of the most visually immersive Max Payne Mobile experiences available.

• Max Payne's signature slow motion gunplay, Bullet Time®

name: Railway Station Master Sim
summary: Run a busy Indian train station: give Line Clear, set routes, clear signals!
description:
Become the Station Master of a busy Indian railway junction. Accept trains from neighboring stations, set routes on a real interlocked control panel, clear the signals and keep every train on time.

This is not a driving game. You run the station: every train that arrives, departs or runs through needs your Line Clear, your route and your signal.

NEW IN 1.0.2
• Hands-on first lesson and a short first shift
• "What now?" hints, Line-ups and star goals
• Train graph after every shift
• New modes: Endless, Free Play, Quick Shift and Rush Hour
• Challenge a friend to the same shift
• Richer station sounds and new realism events
• Spotter's Logbook and certificates
• Yard Puzzles and a timetable editor
• Optional Shop extras: Station Kits (all of it can also be earned by playing), Samosa Stall, Thali Canteen, Heritage Locos & Voices, Crisis Desk, Yard Puzzles II, seasonal looks

GROW YOUR STATION: 7 STAGES
Start at Sabarpur Junction with four platforms. Earn stars and coins to add Platform 5, a branch line, a goods yard, electronic interlocking, automatic block signaling and finally a brand-new modern station, with up to 50 trains a shift.

RUN THE CONTROL PANEL
• Set routes and clear signals on a touch-friendly panel
• Give Line Clear on block instruments, work automatic block and token working on single lines
• Choose which train goes first when an express catches up with a goods train

REAL STATION-MASTER DUTIES
• Take charge with a handover checklist
• Close level crossing gates and exchange private numbers
• Handle signal, point and block failures with the right form
• Deal with chain pulling and medical emergencies

SAFETY ALWAYS COMES FIRST
The interlocking never allows an unsafe movement. If a route is refused, the game tells you why in plain words.

DEVGADH ROAD HILL STATION
A crossing station on a single line through the ghats, with tunnels and mist. Cross trains on the loop and attach banker engines for the climb.

NEW: LINDENQUELL, GERMANY
Run Lindenquell, a fictional German country station with German signals and a track-diagram panel. It is a free download inside the game, with nothing to buy.

WATCH YOUR STATION COME ALIVE
Switch to a 3D view and watch trains arrive and crowds fill the platforms, from morning light to night.

LEARN, THEN MASTER IT
• Academy lessons, career shifts, story chapters and scenarios
• Every shift is scored on safety, punctuality and flow: earn stars and rise in rank
• Difficulty from Assisted to Expert

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Plays fully offline
• Pause any shift, speed up time when it is quiet
• Color-blind modes, captions and a scalable UI
• Languages: English, हिन्दी, ગુજરાતી, বাংলা, मराठी, தமிழ், తెలుగు, Deutsch, Español, Français, Italiano, Português, Polski, Türkçe, Bahasa Indonesia, 日本語, 한국어

FAIR BY DESIGN
No energy, no timers, no ads during shifts. In fact, no ads at all. Optional one-time extras: station packs, cosmetic bundles and a chai tip for the team. No loot boxes and no coin sales: coins are earned by playing, and nothing can skip a safety check.

Stations, trains and characters in this game are fictional. A game inspired by railway operations. Not affiliated with Indian Railways. Not training material.

name: Dead Cells
summary: Kill. Die. Learn. Repeat.
description:
*Save up to 50%!*

Death is not the end.
Play as a failed alchemic experiment and explore the sprawling, ever-changing castle to find out what happened on this gloomy island…! 
That is, assuming you’re able to fight your way past its keepers.

Dead Cells is a roguevania action platformer that will require you to master frantic 2D combat with a wide variety of weapons and skills against merciless minions and boss.

Kill. Die. Learn. Repeat.

First available on PC and consoles, the indie hit Dead Cells is now slaying foes on mobile!

Main Features
• Roguevania: The progressive exploration of an interconnected world, with the replayability of a rogue-lite and the adrenaline pumping threat of permadeath

• Frantic and Dynamic 2D Action: Learn your enemies’ patterns to stay alive, or prepare to be sent back to your cell before you can say “baguette”

• Nonlinear Progression: Unlock new levels with every death, opt for the path that suits your current build, your playstyle or just your mood. 
Surely, the ramparts can’t be as bad the sewers, right?

• Play at your own pace: Will you explore every nook and cranny of the castle, or rush to the end?

*Latest updates are available: Clean Cut & The End is Near*

RETURN TO CASTLEVANIA DLC 
Time for some vampire slaying
• New storyline - overcome the Ruler of Darkness alongside Alucard and Richter Belmont,
• 2 new biomes - Explore Dracula's Castle and its outskirts
• 9 new monsters - Werewolves, haunted armors, and medusas are waiting for you
• 14 new weapons - wield the Vampire Killer or the Holy Water to defeat creatures of the night,
• 3 new bosses - go fangs to fangs against Death and Dracula himself
• 20 new outfits - dress as your favorite Castlevania characters such as Simon and Richter Belmont or Alucard
• Alternative soundtracks - play along 51 Castlevania original tracks and 12 tunes reimagined in the style of Dead Cells

THE BAD SEED DLC
You reap what you sow
• New levels to lose your head in: the not-so-peaceful Dilapidated Arboretum and the noxious Morass of the Banished
• New monsters to rip to pieces: get to know the locals, such as the Jerkshroom and the Yeeter
• New weapons to play with: trim sticking out heads with the Scythe Claw, or make them dance to the sound of the Rhythm n' Bouzouki
• New boss to fight against: Mama Tick is dying to meet you

FATAL FALLS DLC
Ready for a leap of faith?
• 3 new biomes - Get some fresh air at the Fractured Shrines, splash around at the Undying Shores and take a picture at the Mausoleum
• 8 new monsters - The Cold Blooded Guardians and their friends would love to teach you about their culture. ... Wait, aren't those relatives of yours in the Undying Shores...?
• 7 new weapons - lil' Serenade is perfect for breaking the ice with the locals, although the Snake Fangs would make for a perfect souvenir...
• 1 new boss - The Scarecrow is very proud of his gardening skills and won't hesitate to show off


QUEEN AND THE SEA  DLC
Take it to the sea!
• 2 new biomes - Battle your way through a rotten shipwreck, or scale a burning lighthouse and confront your deadliest foe yet.
• 9 new weapons, including a throwable shark, a trident and a pirate hook hand (eyepatch not included). 
• 2 new bosses - Don't lose your head before you meet the Queen!

This DLC also gives you the usual extras: 
- A not-so-cute pet. 
- Loads of new outfits. 
- New enemies to bash.

WARNING : Devices with less than 2gb of RAM may not be able to run this content correctly. We reccomend not to take this DLC if your device is under 2gb of RAM.


Carefully redesigned for mobile with a revamped interface

name: Space Rock Breaker
summary: Mine asteroids, process ore with Plinko, and unlock skill tree upgrades.
description:
Turn mined asteroids into your next upgrade in Space Rock Breaker, a short incremental space mining game that combines guns, ore processing and a massive skill tree.

MINE ASTEROIDS AND UNLOCK MATERIALS
Use guns to break apart space rocks and gather ore. Unlock new materials as you progress, with mining at the center of the experience.

PROCESS YOUR HAUL WITH PLINKO
Your collected ore goes into a Plinko machine for processing. This pairing of asteroid mining and Plinko gives your haul another stage before you spend credits on upgrades.

BUILD PROGRESS THROUGH UPGRADES
Put your credits into a large skill tree and choose your next upgrades. The core loop connects mining, ore processing and spending credits, taking you from breaking rocks to unlocking upgrades.

A SHORT INCREMENTAL EXPERIENCE
Space Rock Breaker focuses on a compact mining-and-upgrade experience. Discover its combination of space mining, Plinko processing and skill-tree progression.

Mine. Process. Upgrade.

name: Shadow of Death: Dark Knight
summary: Unite against the Shadow & Become an Legends Soul Knight in Offline ARPG Games
description:
🏆 Premium feature: Unlock all 4 characters including the fan-favourite Lunae - the beautiful Keeper of Time and Space with a powerful high-speed scythe attack!
🎯 Note: This is a stand-alone game. You cannot transfer your data from the free version to the paid version.

A Brand New Dark Fantasy Epic Game
Plunge into the darkness and experience the great pocket sized fantasy RPG of the ages. Whip out that shadow blade and select a customizable dark knight to go on a side scroller adventure anywhere at anytime. Freely experiment with multiple gameplay styles, wicked rare armor sets, and robust skill trees to create the powerful shadow knight possible. An offline fighting game with the soul of a console RPG is not what this generation of gamers deserves, but needs! The shadow of war is rising, will you accept the challenge?

Choice to the Players
Choose from a cast of four unique shadow knights each representing a vastly different play style. Whether players want to slash or force projectile their way to victory is in their hands, quite literally! Delve into a robust skill tree and deep inventory system that encourages endless combat experimentation and customization. We even have a young boy's soul in a hulking suit of armor.

Conquer the Darkness in Style
Inspired by classic fighting games and modern action RPGs, combat is a high-octane blend of magic and weapons based hack and slash gameplay. An intuitive touch screen interface provides different options to strategize combat and devastate enemies. The unique battle system is accessible for any player yet deep enough to satisfy the hardcore action RPG fans. What are you waiting for? Grab that mystical dark sword and plunge into darkness!

A Beautiful Ruined World
Driven by an all new animation system and graphics engine, players are going to be saying, "I can't believe it's not a console game." That's right, the game looks that good! Optimized for mobile gaming, the gothic fantasy world of Aurora is uniquely cel shaded to deliver jaw dropping magical effects and epic combat sequences to life.

Play Anywhere, Anytime
We put the “pocket” in pocket sized RPGs! Experience the thrill of combat anywhere, anytime as Shadow of Death is an offline game. No need to be online to defeat the shadows.

Challenge the Universe
When beating down shadow monsters just does not cut it anymore, take your game online! Vie for ultimate supremacy as you battle with other players in the Arena.

Unlock the Dream Team
Tired of grinding to unlock the next character? The paid version of Shadow of Death has all four shadow warriors unlocked from the start. Now players can conquer the darkness like never before and get to the good stuff way faster.

Story: A Dark Knight's Journey
Aurora, once a prosperous kingdom has fallen. An ancient darkness reborn savages the land with brute force. Crops decay, winds scream with rage, and the dead stir.
In his lust for power and forbidden knowledge, a king has forsaken his people to ruin. The people cry for hope.
A lone knight, cleansed of memory but driven by conviction is all that stands between utter annihilation. Marked by destiny, he walks alone towards the whispering shadows.

Take your game further and level up with us! Engage our team on social media for the latest events to get gift codes, rare armor sets, loads of crystals, and other juicy prizes.

VISIT US: Shadow of Death – Dark Knight – Stickman Fighting Game 
Discord: https://discord.gg/dQZHr7FdMf

name: Human Fall Flat
summary: Discover the funniest multiplayer physics puzzle platformer!
description:
Human Fall Flat is a hilarious, light-hearted physics platformer set in floating dreamscapes that can be played solo or with up to 4 players. Free new levels keep its vibrant community rewarded. Each dream level provides a new environment to navigate, from mansions, castles and Aztec adventures to snowy mountains, eerie nightscapes and industrial locations. Multiple routes through each level, and perfectly playful puzzles ensure exploration and ingenuity are rewarded. 

MORE HUMANS, MORE MAYHEM - Need a hand getting that boulder on to a catapult, or need someone to break that wall? Online multiplayer for up to 4 players transforms the way Human Fall Flat is played.

MIND BENDING PUZZLES - Explore open-ended levels full of challenging puzzles and hilarious distractions. Try new paths and discover all the secrets!

A BLANK CANVAS - Your Human is yours to customize. With outfits from builder to chef, skydiver, miner, astronaut and ninja. Choose your head, upper and lower body and get creative with the colors!

FREE GREAT CONTENT - Since launch more than four brand new levels have launched free of charge with even more on the horizon. What could the next dreamscape have in store?   

A VIBRANT COMMUNITY - Streamers and YouTubers flock to Human Fall Flat for its unique, hilarious gameplay. Fans have watched these videos more than 3 Billion times!

name: GRID™ Autosport
summary: Console-quality racing on Android.
description:
Ignite your high-speed career as a pro-racer in GRID Autosport, engineered to deliver an irresistible mix of simulation handling and arcade thrills.

BUY ONCE, RACE FOREVER
Get the complete AAA hit and all its DLC in one simple purchase.

100 CARS AND 100 CIRCUITS
Unleash a ton of high-performance rides across a ton of tracks, roads, laps and loops.

CUSTOMISABLE CONTROLS
Switch between intuitive customisable controls: Tilt, Wheel Touch, Arrow Touch or gamepad. 

SCALABLE DIFFICULTY
From nice ‘n easy to devilishly hard, you set the bar.

MASTER A RANGE OF DISCIPLINES
Compete across Open-Wheel, Tuner, Touring, Endurance, Demolition, Drift, Drag and Street Races.

---

name: Choo-Choo Charles
summary: Navigate the island, upgrade your train, and kill Charles.
description:
Charles is a bloodthirsty train, and you need to destroy him.

Navigate a massive play area in your trusty old engine: These winding tracks are treacherous, so you'll need to plan each mission carefully. Be wary when traveling on foot, or switching the track's direction; Charles might be waiting for you.

Upgrade your train to fit your needs: Go looting or complete missions to find "Scraps", which can be used to turn your train into a death machine on wheels.

Get help from the townspeople: Help out the settlers in return for high powered weapons, and other items vital to Charles' destruction.

Fight Charles to the death: Complete the main questline, and summon Charles to a mortal duel. If you’ve gained enough strength, firepower, and skill, Charles may finally meet his match.

name: Tower Defense Legend 5 Pro
summary: Defend the last base and protect humans against alien monsters !
description:
Defense Legend Version: Tower Defense 5 - premium is the advanced version of free one. At the same time, players will be awarded items as bellow:
- Premium forever
- No Ads all
 Unleash epic tower defense strategies in Defense Legend 5 Pro: Epic TD!  Searching for the ultimate tower defense experience? Look no further.  This premium version of the hit TD game throws you into a futuristic war where Earth's last defenses have crumbled against a relentless Dark force.  As a brilliant commander, you'll lead the charge to protect humanity's new home on a distant planet, deploying cunning tactics against alien monsters invading from the air, jungles, deserts, and even frozen wastelands.


▶ Follow us on:
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/groups/605531618854195

name: LIMBO
summary: Uncertain of his sister's fate, a boy enters LIMBO.
description:
What the press said: 

“Limbo is as close to perfect at what it does as a game can get.” 
10/10 – Destructoid 

“The game is a masterpiece.” 
5/5 – GiantBomb 

“Limbo is genius. Freaky, weird genius. Disturbing, uncomfortable genius.”

Winner of more than 100 awards, including:
