Limbo is an award-winning indie adventure, critically acclaimed for its captivating puzzle design and immersive sound and visuals. Its dark, misty spaces and haunting narrative will stay with you forever.

name: Farming Simulator 20
summary: Build your farm and use over 100 authentic farming vehicles and tools!
description:
Step into the exciting world of farming with Farming Simulator 20! Harvest many different crops, tend to your livestock of pigs, cows, and sheep, and now ride your own horses, letting you explore the vast land around your farm in a brand-new way. Sell your products in a dynamic market to earn money which you can invest in additional machinery and the expansion of your farm.

In Farming Simulator 20 you take control of over 100 vehicles and tools faithfully recreated from leading brands in the industry. For the first time on mobile platforms this includes John Deere, the largest agriculture machinery company in the world. Drive other famous farming brands such as Case IH, New Holland, Challenger, Fendt, Massey Ferguson, Valtra, Krone, Deutz-Fahr and many more.

Farming Simulator 20 features a new North American environment in which to develop and expand your farm. Enjoy many exciting farming activities, including new machinery and crops with cotton and oats. 


Features of Farming Simulator 20 include:

• Use over 100 realistic vehicles and tools from some of the biggest agriculture machine makers
• Plant and harvest different crops: Wheat, barley, oat, canola, sunflowers, soybean, corn, potatoes, sugar beet and cotton
• Feed your cows and sheep to produce and sell milk and wool
• Take care of horses and ride on them to freely explore the world around your farm
• New 3D graphics show even more detail on your machinery and the Northern American environment
• Cockpit view lets you drive in your vehicles in an even more realistic way than before

name: Getting Over It
summary: I made a game for a certain kind of person. To hurt them.
description:
A game I made
For a certain kind of person

To hurt them.

Getting Over It with Bennett Foddy is a punishing climbing game, a homage to Jazzuo's 2002 B-Game classic 'Sexy Hiking'. You move the hammer with the mouse, and that's all there is. With practice, you'll be able to jump, swing, climb and fly. Great mysteries and a wonderful reward await the master hikers who reach the top of the mountain.

To quote Jazzuo himself: "The hiking action is very similar to way you would do it in real life, remember that and you will do well".

• Climb up an enormous mountain with nothing but a hammer and a pot.
• Listen as I make philosophical observations about the problem at hand.
• Between 2 and ∞ hours of agonizing gameplay, depending. The median time to finish for my playtesters was 5 hours, but the mean was closer to ∞.
• Lose all your progress, over and over.
• Feel new types of frustration you didn't know you were capable of.

name: TABS Pocket Edition
summary: Be the leader of wobblers from ancient lands, spooky places, and fantasy worlds.
description:
Be the leader of red and blue wobblers from ancient lands, spooky places and fantasy worlds. Watch them fight in simulations made with the wobbliest physics system ever created. 

When you grow tired of the 100+ wobblers at your disposal you can make new ones in the unit creator.

You can also send your wobblers to fight your friends or strangers in online multiplayer!

Features:

    -Campaigns
    -Multiplayer
    -Sandbox mode
    -Unit Possession
    -A bunch of silly units

Please note that the game involves a significant amount of real-time 3D rendering, which can be demanding on device performance.

Minimum recommended Android devices:
Devices with more than 6 GB of RAM and a chipset equivalent to or better than the Snapdragon 778.

Recommended Android specs:
Devices with more than 8 GB of RAM and a chipset equivalent to or better than the Kirin 9000.

Additionally, the game uses an online server to sync and save progress, so a network connection is required.

name: Everything is Crab
summary: The Animal Evolution Roguelite
description:
Set in a living ecosystem, 'Everything is Crab' is a cute, challenging, highly replayable action roguelite. Make animal inspired evolutionary choices to concoct your own unique creature every run, both mechanically and visually.

BEAT CARCINIZATION
As everybody knows, eventually, every organism ends up evolving into a crab. Right?
Well, except for you. Choose your own evolutionary path and strategy to thrive and defeat convergent evolution. Take that, science!

EVOLVE. ADAPT. OVERCOME
Over 160 abilities combine to create a plethora of different builds and playstyles: Become a wily trickster, a ferocious predator, a gregarious leader, a nimble nomad, or take on any number of other survival strategies.
Legs! Claws! Pincers! Wings! More Legs! Fur! Tail! Scales! Tentacles! I SAID MORE LEGS!!! 
Build your formidable, visually awkward chimera or get Darwin'd in the process.

160+ evolution based abilities
Endless possibilities and visual combinations
Strategy-defining evolutions
Many viable survival strategies and playstyles

A living, thriving ecosystem
Many different critters with their own goals and strategies, each of them with several stages of evolution
Four distinct biomes with different rules, climate events, points of interest, flora and fauna
Night and day cycle

A variety of bosses that may (or may not) appear with each run

Huge meta-progression layer
Difficulties system (if you dare!)
Genetics (starting characters), which can be combined to create endless starting character combinations
Challenge Scenarios (Ice Age, Always Night, Hunted...), to push your adaptation skills to the limit

Endless runs
Prove your survival skills to unlock Endless runs, ditch the timer, and outlast the apocalypse!

Track your findings, meta-progression and achievements in the Codex

name: The Room
summary: The definitive puzzle experience
description:
Welcome to The Room, a physical puzzler, wrapped in a mystery game, inside a beautifully tactile 3D world.

*****************

How are you, old friend? If you’re reading this, then it worked. I only hope you can still forgive me. 

We’ve never seen eye to eye on my research, but you must put such things behind you. You are the only one to whom I can turn. You must come at once, for we are all in great peril. I trust you remember the house? My study is the highest room. 

Press forward with heart. There is no way back now. 

AS. 

****** 
Fireproof Games are very proud to bring you our greatest creation, a mind-bending journey filled with beauty, peril and mystery in equal measure. Be transported into a unique space that blends spellbinding visuals with intriguing problems to solve.

• Unsettlingly realistic graphics: Vibrant natural-looking visuals perfected for mobile displays.
• Spine-tingling single finger controls: touch controls so natural you can play with one digit, to fully navigate this mysteriously beautiful 3D world.
• Fantastical pick-up-and-play design: Easy to start, hard to put down, the secrets of The Room will immerse you before you even know you're playing.
• Compelling layers of mystery: think you know what you're looking at? Think again.

name: Scritchy Scratchy
summary: Buy stacks of scratch-offs, unlock auto-scratching, and chase massive jackpots.
description:
Scritchy Scratchy is a super-satisfying scratch card incremental game where luck is your weapon, and glittering riches are just a scratch away.

Dive into a growing collection of scratchers, each with its own quirks, surprises, and sometimes downsides. Rip through tickets, uncover rare symbols, tweak your own luck, and chase absurd payouts.

Unlock Scratch Bot, your tireless mechanical friend who scratches and reveals the rewards for you. Turn your run into a full-blown jackpot engine as your balance shoots through the roof while you sit back and relax.

As you prosper, you’ll unlock upgrades that twist luck in your favor:
• Boosted odds and payouts
• Faster and easier scratching 
• New scratch card variants with unique rules

But power always comes with risk. Some cards tempt you with monstrous payouts at the cost of nasty penalties. Some offer steady income… others threaten your entire run. Will you play like a sensible adult or gamble like a degenerate in a neon casino?

When you’re ready for even more madness, Prestige to reset your run, gather Jack Points, and spend them on permanent upgrades that reshape your strategy. Build your own luck engine: Slow and steady, wildly explosive, or pure chaos.

Scritchy Scratchy is a dangerously satisfying progression casino, where every scratch is a little dopamine hit, and every run is one lucky break away from the big jackpot!

name: Subnautica
summary: Survive in an underwater open-world
description:
Subnautica is an underwater adventure game set on an alien ocean planet.
A massive, open world full of wonder and peril awaits you!

Descend into the depths, craft equipment, pilot submarines and out-smart wildlife to explore lush coral reefs, volcanoes, cave systems, and more - all while trying to survive. Unravel the mystery of this world teeming with creatures, both friendly and hostile, scattered with clues from a previous time.

Play in Survival mode to experience the original challenge, or switch to Freedom or Creative mode to discover this oceanic planet without the pressures of thirst, hunger, or oxygen. 

FEATURES
• SURVIVE – After crash landing on a vast underwater planet, the clock is ticking to find water, food, and to develop the equipment you need to explore.
• EXPLORE – Manage your hunger, thirst, and oxygen supply as you dive into towering kelp forests, sunlit plateaus, bio-luminescent reefs, and winding cave systems.
• SCAVENGE – Collect resources from the ocean around you. Venture deeper and further to find rarer resources, allowing you to craft more advanced items.
• CRAFT – Build bases to shelter in, vehicles to pilot, tools for survival to aid you in navigating and adapting to this subaquatic landscape. 
• DISCOVER – What happened to this planet? What caused you to crash? Can you find a way to make it off the planet alive?
• CUSTOMIZE – Play in Survival mode to experience the original challenge, or switch to Freedom or Creative mode to discover this oceanic planet without the pressures of thirst, hunger, or oxygen. 

CAREFULLY REDESIGNED FOR MOBILE
• Revamped interface – exclusive mobile UI with complete touch control
• Google Play Games achievements
• Cloud Save – Share your progress between Android devices
• Compatible with controllers

name: Balatro
summary: When Poker Meets Solitaire
description:
Welcome to the official Balatro game!

Your goal is to beat Boss Blinds by making strong poker hands. 
Find new Jokers that change the game and create awesome and exciting combos! Take on challenging bosses, discover wild poker hands and unlock new decks as you play. 

You’ll need all the help you can get to beat the big boss, win the final challenge, and win the game.

Features:

* Remastered controls for touch screen devices; now even more satisfying!
* Each run is different: every pick-up, discard and joker can dramatically alter the course of your run.
* Multiple game items: discover over 150 Jokers, each with special powers. Use them with different decks,upgrade cards and vouchers to boost your scores.
* Different Game modes: Campaign mode and challenge mode for you to play.
* Beautiful Pixel Art: Immerse yourself in the CRT fuzz and enjoy detailed, hand-crafted pixel art.

name: Shadow Fight 2 Special Edition
summary: Thrilling mix of two game genres - Fighting & RPG. Prepare to fight with shadow!
description:
The best fighting series on mobile has returned and become even more SPECIAL - Shadow Fight 2 Special Edition!! 

Now it's your turn to meet Titan in person and put an end to his terror. Walk through the Gates of Shadows into the dangerous world full of memorable fights and brave heroes. These lands are waiting for a risky adventurer to appear and save them from the oppression of a sinister invader from another dimension! Discover a thrilling mix of two world's most popular game genres - Fighting & RPG. Gather a huge arsenal of lethal weapons, combine your gear and upgrade dozens of skills and moves!

- No Ads!
- No energy restoring. Jump into the fray anytime and anywhere you want!
- Unveil a truth behind Sensei's past in a whole new story chapter!
- Complete the story mode without grinding!
- Equip yourself with a huge amount of weapons and armor. Get a lot of gems through battles and make your arsenal even more larger!
- Travel across 7 distinct provinces and force to terrify Titan himself!
- Simple controls is designed for touch screen usage. Shadow Fight 2 is easy to play but hard to master!
- Astonishing animations and unique design!

Please note that this version does not include the "underworld" and "eclipse-mode" features from the free version of the game

name: Goat Simulator 3
summary: It’s not a bug, it’s a feature
description:
Pilgor is finally baack on the small screen. Now you can be even more unsocial during family dinners. Yay!

Goat Simulator 3 Mobile gives you the same open world to explore and destroy as the PC and console versions of the game. Headbutt civilians, drive without a license, or join a yoga class! It’s just like in real life.

You can invite a friend in multiplayer mode, cause mayhem together, or become enemies while playing any of the seven mini-games.
If you don’t have a friend, you could get the game on two devices and just pretend. We won’t tell a soul.

The giant sandbox island of San Angora is in the palm of your hoof!

KEY FEATURES:

– Goats! Tall goats, fishy goats, goats with hats, there's a goat for your every need
– An open world to explore, with an ‘ok amount’ of quests, challenges, and secrets to uncover
– Bring chaos together with a friend in multiplayer mode
– Break off that friendship for good with seven different mini-games
– Dress up your goat in a wide range of different gears to unleash its true powers
– Ragdoll physics that slap Newton in the face.

name: Absolum
summary: The Original Rogue'em Up
description:
A magical cataclysm left magic mistrusted by the common folk and Sun King Azra took advantage of this panic, enslaving wizards through his Crimson Order and conquering more and more lands. With the help of high enchantress Uchawi, a small group of rebels rises from the shadows.

Fight as the outcast heroes of Talamh in a fierce battle to retake magic from Sun King Azra’s grasp in Absolum, an original roguelite beat ‘em up by Dotemu.

FEATURES

​🌌 Join the rebellion! With the help of the high enchantress Uchawi, wield forbidden magic to free the lands of Talamh from the iron grip of Sun King Azra.

⚔️ Four heroes, each with their own fighting style: start playing as the calm but deadly Galandra or as Karl, the last free dwarf of Talamh, and discover the prodigious Brome and the enigmatic Cider as they join your journey.

💥 Craft new strategies and get more powerful every run to defeat Azra’s elite guard through a gameplay that blends the best of arcade beat’em up action with modern roguelite mechanics.

​🗺️ -From the majestic mines of Grandery to the lush forests of Jaroba, delve into an original fantasy world that comes alive through gorgeous art, masterful animation and a magnificent soundtrack by composer Gareth Coker (Ori, Halo Infinite, Prince of Persia), featuring collaborations with other legendary composers.

​🤝 Lead the uprising against Azra's regime as a lone hero, or team up with an ally through the two-player online coop mode. Combine your elemental powers and synchronize your attacks into incredible chained combos!

CAREFULLY REDESIGNED FOR MOBILE
- Revamped interface – exclusive mobile UI with complete touch control
- Google Play Games achievements
-Buy once, play anywhere: Enjoy cross-progression on mobile and PC with the same Google Play Games account
- Cloud Save – Share your progress between Android devices
-Compatible with controllers

name: Planet of Lana
summary: An off-earth odyssey
description:
Play as a young girl accompagnied by her loyal animal companion on a rescue mission accross beautiful landscapes filled of mysteries.
Solve puzzles, evade machines and navigate strange environments full of dangerous creatures, all in a beautiful sci-fi hand-painted universe.
A planet that used to be a place of undisturbed balance between human, nature, and animal has now become something else entirely.
The disharmony that had been in the making for hundreds of years has finally arrived in the form of a faceless army. But this is not a story about war. This is a story about a vibrant, beautiful planet –and the journey to keep it that way.

Play as Lana on an poetic journey across a breathtaking alien planet and use your wit and trusty animal companion, Mui, to uncover the secrets of this world and restore the balance between humans, nature and animals.

FEATURES
- Play as a young girl, Lana, and her trusty animal companion, Mui, on a rescue mission to find her sister through a colorful world full of machines and creatures
- Embark on an poetic journey across a breathtaking alien planet, where balance between humans, nature and animals is at stake, and uncover secrets that will help restore the entire planet lost harmony
- Solve intricate puzzles with the help of a responsive and endearing companion, and navigate through dangerous situations using quick thinking rather than brute force
- Stealth your way through tense sequences where survival depends on wit and timing, not combat

CAREFULLY REDESIGNED FOR MOBILE
- Revamped interface – exclusive mobile UI with complete touch control
- Google Play Games achievements
- Cloud Save – Share your progress between Android devices
- Compatible with MFi controllers

name: The Farmer Was Replaced
summary: Write Python-like code, automate your farm, then take your drone underground.
description:
Program a drone. Automate a farm. Watch your code do the work.

The Farmer Was Replaced is a programming game where your drone does the farming. Write short programs in a simple, Python-like language, press execute, and your drone tills, plants, waters and harvests, with results that depend on your code.

No levels, just continuous progression: farm resources, buy unlocks, solve the next problem. Harvest hay, wood and carrots, merge pumpkins into a giant one, sort cacti, find the best sunflower, feed a dinosaur and hunt for treasure in a hedge maze. Become the most efficient farmer in the world.

A CODE KEYBOARD MADE FOR TOUCH
Every symbol you need on one screen. Brackets and quotes come in pairs. Swipe on any key to move the cursor, hold Shift and swipe to select. Undo, redo, comment and paste have their own row. Choose QWERTY, QWERTZ or AZERTY, with key clicks or vibration. Prefer real keys? Connect a Bluetooth keyboard and mouse for more comfortable coding.

LEARN TO CODE
Loops, variables, functions, lists and more, introduced one at a time. The game gives you the tools, but solving the tasks is up to you, and that can be a real challenge. Already a programmer? Race through the basics, then run a fleet of drones.

THE MINER WAS REPLACED, INCLUDED
Take your drone underground and unlock eight new resources, including coal, quartz, mushrooms and dynamite. Dig up ancient ruins without damaging them, sort mushrooms, grow rice on clay and play Minesweeper without blowing up your drone.

TRY BEFORE YOU BUY
Try the game for free. After the trial, you’ll need to unlock the full game with a one-time purchase to keep playing. No ads, no subscriptions.

FEATURES
• A real programming language

• Portrait or landscape on phones and tablets

name: Gambonanza
summary: Chess reinvented! Roguelike strategy on a tiny board with wild Gambits.
description:
Gambonanza is a turn-based chess roguelike set on a tiny board with huge stakes. Master tactical twists, invest your winnings, and discover rule-bending Gambits plus wild tile and piece combinations. Face off against challenging bosses and get lost in all the ways you can break traditional chess!

But be careful, if you waste too many moves the board will crumble around you…


FEATURES

• Snackable, high-impact runs
Play fast, punchy chess battles on smaller starting boards where every decision counts.

• 150+ rule-bending Gambits
Combine your chess pieces with Gambits to unlock devastating combos and strategic surprises.

• Dynamic reserve system
Store extra pieces off-board and deploy them at the perfect moment to swing the game.

• Strategic board upgrades
Enhance your chessboard with golden squares, blessing tiles, protective surfaces, and more!

• Fight epic boss battles
Take on big encounters that reward smart builds and punish strategic mistakes.

• Retro aesthetic and quirky ambiance
Immerse yourself in vibrant pixel art and the playful excitement of a fairground.

• Mini-games for power boosts
Test your luck and skill in challenges inspired by pachinko, slot machines, and Gachapon.


WHY PLAY GAMBONANZA?

Gambonanza takes the tactical clarity of chess and turns it into a roguelike playground: stack Gambits, sculpt the board, manage your reserves, and discover ridiculous combos that “shouldn’t work”… until they do. If you love smart strategy, replayable runs, and the thrill of breaking the rules (legally), this one’s for you.


JOIN THE CHESS REVOLUTION!

Download Gambonanza and start rewriting chess.


ABOUT THE TEAM

Gambonanza is developed by Blukulélé and published by Sidekick Publishing and Stray Fawn Publishing.
Mobile Port by Ateo

name: Bridge Constructor Medieval
summary: Dive into the Middle Ages!
description:
Bridge Constructor Medieval turns back the clock a few centuries to the time of knights and castles. Build sturdy bridges to supply your city with provisions - or cunningly constructed bridges that collapse under the weight of attacking troops, sending the horde of enemies into the abyss below. You won’t even be safe from cannon fire in the 40 brand new levels. Protect your foot soldiers and your horse-drawn carriages with covered bridges and stable pillar structures. 

There are a total of five materials available to help you build the perfect bridge: wood, heavy wood, stone and ropes, along with the new addition of the bridge roof.
Throughout the exciting background story, you will familiarize yourself with the various materials on a step-by-step basis, and learn everything you need to know so that your bridges meet the requirements of the different levels. 
Innovative game modes in store for you!
Besides building stable bridges, there's also plenty on offer for veterans to discover in the new game modes. 
In the siege level, your bridge is bombarded by enemy catapults. Strengthen your bridge so that it doesn't collapse, and protect your own troops on the bridge with a bridge roof. 
In another new game mode, you build your bridges so that they collapse under the load of enemy units to send as many of them as possible into the abyss. 
In addition, the unique bonus challenges will leave even the most experienced players at their wit’s end. That way, both bridge-building professionals and novices will face a challenge in Bridge Constructor Medieval. 

FEATURES: 
-	For the first time: Build bridges in the Middle Ages!
-	Brand new levels and game modes for a completely new gaming experience
-	Design sturdy bridge roofs to protect yourself from enemy catapults
-	Construct cunning bridge traps to send advancing enemy troops into the abyss
-	Exciting and funny background story
-	Enjoy beautiful medieval landscapes
-	Google Play Game Services Achievements and rankings
-	Tablet support

Like the game? Then support us with 5 stars in the Google Play Store!

www.facebook.com/headupgames 
www.twitter.com/headupgames

name: Descenders
summary: Extreme Downhill Freeriding
description:
Descenders is extreme downhill freeriding for the modern era, with procedurally generated worlds, and where mistakes have real consequences. Will you lead your team to glory and become the next legendary Descender?

• Procedurally generated worlds: Take on different jumps, slopes and hillbombs every time you play
• Freestyle bike controls: Control every subtle movement of your rider, with an in-depth physics system made for slick whips and scrubs
• Risk vs reward: Push your rider for massive scores and combos -- but bail too many times and you might lose it all
• Build your Rep: A fully-featured online Rep system lets you show off your worth, and earn new bikes and threads
• Become the next Descender: Can you survive the game in a single run, and reach the ranks of the legendary Descenders?

Pick a Team, Become a Legend

In Descenders, your team is your life. When you pick a side -- Enemy, Arboreal or Kinetic -- you'll be bound together with other players who choose the same side as you.

Grab your bike, pick your team, and attempt to live up to the legend of your Descender. Will you join the die-hard, trick-frenzy ranks of Team Enemy, the proficient, off-road stylings of Team Arboreal, or the high-octane, speed-is-everything Team Kinetic?

• Wear your team's colors and apparel with pride, and receive exclusive team gear
• Your Rep points go towards your team's total Rep, and exclusive prizes are awarded to the top team
• Gain access to your team's exclusive channel on the Descenders Discord server

name: Northgard
summary: Settle. Survive. Conquer.
description:
Northgard is a strategy game based on Norse mythology in which you control a Clan of Vikings fighting for the control of a mysterious newfound continent.

After years of tireless explorations, brave Vikings have discovered a new land filled with mystery, danger and riches: NORTHGARD.

The boldest Northmen have set sail to explore and conquer these new shores, bring fame to their Clan and write history through conquest, trading, or devotion to the Gods.

That is, if they can survive the dire Wolves and Undead Warriors roaming the land, befriend or defeat the giants, and survive the harshest winters ever witnessed in the North.

FEATURES
• Build your settlement on the newly discovered continent of Northgard
• Assign your vikings to various jobs (Farmer, Warrior, Sailor, Loremaster...)
• Manage your resources carefully and survive harsh winters and vicious foes
• Expand and discover new territory with unique strategic opportunities
• Achieve different victory conditions (Conquest, Fame, Lore, Trading...)

STORY MODE: RIG’S SAGA
The Viking High King is murdered and his Regal Horn is stolen by a man named Hagen.
This event kickstarts a saga that will take Rig, his son and heir accompanied by his right-hand man Brand through the new continent of Northgard.
The continent where he will make new friends and foes and discover a much greater threat than Hagen, and the reasons behind his father’s assassination.

MULTIPLAYER
• Play with or against other Mobile players with up to 6 players
• Includes Duel, Free for All and Teamplay modes

CHOOSE YOUR CLAN
In order to complete the 11 campaign chapters, the player will have to master the specificities of the 6 first clans and tame the unforgiving wilderness of Northgard.

More clans are joining the fight for Northgard!
• Clan of the Snake: Act from the shadows and take the lead with cunning guerilla tactics
• Clan of the Dragon: Embrace the old ways and please the gods with sacrifices
• Clan of the Kraken: Harness the bounty of the sea and unleash its brutal might
You can unlock the clans of the Snake, Dragon and Kraken separately by buying the DLCs, or together with the Scale Bundle.

• Clan of the Horse: Devote yourself to the art of blacksmithing and craft powerful Relics
• Clan of the Ox: Equip ancestral equipment and prove the might of your forefathers
• Clan of the Lynx: Adopt Nature’s way and lure mythical preys into ambushes
You can unlock the Clans of the Horse, Ox and Lynx separately by buying the DLCs, or together with the Fur Bundle.

• Clan of the Squirrel: Gather ingredients to prepare special recipes and survive the harsh winters
• Clan of the Rat: Embrace the way of the Shamans and work for the clan
• Clan of the Eagle: Occupy a large territory, venture outside and gather resources
Unlock the clans of the Squirrel, Rat and Eagle separately by buying the DLCs, or together with the Winter Bundle.

Carefully redesigned for mobile
• Revamped interface
• Achievements
• Cloud Save - Share your progress between Android devices

If you run into a problem, please contact us at support@playdigious.mail.helpshift.com with as much information as possible on the issue, or check our FAQ at https://playdigious.helpshift.com/hc/en/4-northgard/

name: Lil' Guardsman
summary: Fantasy Border Control! Inspect, interrogate, and decide who enters the kingdom.
description:
Enjoy 10% off during the first two weeks after launch!

👋 Hi, I'm Lil! I'm 12 years old, and today I’m on gate guard duty. What’s that? You don’t think it’s appropriate for a kid to decide who should, and shouldn’t enter the kingdom? You don’t think a 12 year old should be able to send people to the dungeon!? You and me both! But my dad left me in charge, so I guess I don’t have a choice. 
Between shady goblins, haughty elves, and sketchiest of all… humans, I have to conduct interrogations, uncover plots, and survive my shift. Approve, deny, or jail, the fate of the city literally rests on my pre-teen shoulders!

⚖️ Lil’ Guardsman is a comedic, fantasy riff on the border control genre. Every visitor who shows up at the guard shed is a real puzzle that will put your deduction skills to the test. The player must choose to follow, or break, the kingdom’s rules to inspect travelers, identify deception, and make strategic choices.

🪄 As Lil, you must use your wits to outsmart the deceptions of a colorful cast of characters. Letting the wrong person in, or incorrectly sending someone straight to the dungeon, can radically change the course of history, unleashing chaos upon the city. Your individual decisions shape an epic story across twelve levels, a wedding, and a war (that you trigger!) 
 
⚙️ GAME FEATURES

• Full Premium Game: Pay once to unlock the entire adventure. No ads, no microtransactions, no virtual currency.

• Border Post Simulation: Over 100 unique characters to meet, interrogate, and decide the fate of, according to evolving security rules.

• Deduction Mechanics: Use an upgradeable arsenal of tools (Truth Spray, Whip, Metal Detector, and more) with limited uses per day (resource management).

• Interrogation System: Choose your dialogue carefully. Confiscate contraband items, call royal advisors to verify information, and make the final choice to Admit, Deny, or Jail.

• Branching Narrative: Your decisions at the castle gates have direct consequences for the main characters, the kingdom of the Sprawl, and the game's ultimate ending.

• Technical Compatibility: Solo experience optimized for touch screens, 100% playable offline (no internet connection required after the initial installation).

🏅 CRITICAL ACCLAIM AND AWARDS (PC VERSION)
Building on its PC success, Lil' Guardsman has been widely praised by critics and has shined in indie festivals:

🏆 IndieCade Festival: Winner of the Best Performance award for its excellent voice cast.

🏆 Game Development World Championship (GDWC): Winner of the prestigious Studio Award and finalist in the Best Adventure Game, Best Music, and Immersive Audio categories.

🏆 Indie Cup: Winner of the Critics' Choice Award.

⭐ Notable Nominations: Nominated for Best Debut Game at the Indie Games Awards, praised for its plot ("Outstanding Story-Rich Game") at the Steam Awards, and nominated in multiple categories at the Canadian Game Awards (including Game of the Year).

name: Clone Drone in the Danger Zone
summary: Slice apart voxel robots in arena combat, unless they cut you to pieces!
description:
Clone Drone in the Danger Zone is a robot voxel slice-em-up where any part of your body can be sliced off. With your mind downloaded into a robot gladiator, you must survive the sinister trials of the arena. You can finally play the indie action hit on the go. It's Clone Drone on your mobile phone!

Single Player Game Modes

• Story Mode - One part epic tale of human defiance, another part laser swords.
• Endless Mode - Challenge yourself to fight through 86 level variants spread across 7 difficulty tiers. Can you make it to TITANIUM?
• Challenge Mode - Bow-only, hammer-only, can you still survive the arena?

Multiplayer Game Modes

• Last Bot Standing - A Battle-Royale-like game mode with short, 5-10 minute play sessions and up to 15 players. Survive, and shower in the remains of your fellow robot competitors.
• Private Duels - Challenge your friend to a 1v1 duel!
• Online Co-op! - Use the power of human friendship (and laser swords!) to survive in the arena!

Features:

• Epic Voxel Dismemberment: In addition to looking cool, the ability to cut off body parts is central to the gameplay. Jumping on one leg is a common occurrence. Large enemies need to be cut down to size before a fatal blow can be delivered.
• Sharp Sword Combat: Combat is fast and intense, putting great emphasis on movement, timing and positioning. You are never safe, as any blow can instantly kill or dismember.
• Intuitive Controls: On-screen buttons allow you to smoothly jump, dash, and destroy any robot adversary.
• Spin Attack: Perform a deadly 360 spin in this mobile exclusive attack!
• Entertaining Commentary: Commentatron and Analysis-Bot provide a play-by-play of your performance and react to your activities.
• Upgrade Your Robot: Jetpack, bow, kicking, deflection, clones, armor, FIRE BREATH.
• Terrifying Robotic Enemies: They actually get pretty hard! Sword robots, bow robots, Spidertron 5000, Spidertron 6000, gigantic hammer bots. So many things to dismember.
• Achievements! Unlock upgrades, emotes and multiplayer skins by achieving a rich variety of things!
• Emotes! Do the Funky Pillar Dance, mock your foes, or flap your arms delightfully!

name: Wreckfest - Demolition Racing
summary: Break the rules and take full-contact racing to the limit with Wreckfest!
description:
🏁 Wreckfest is jam-packed with upgrade and customization options. Whether you are preparing for your next demolition derby with reinforced bumpers, roll cages, side protectors and much more, or setting your car up for a banger race with engine performance parts like air filters, camshafts, fuel systems, etc., Wreckfest is shaping up to be the best combative motorsport game out there. 💥

• Unique Racing Experience – Exhilarating no-rules racing action with defining, once-in-a-lifetime moments that can be achieved only with a true-to-life physics simulation. Witness insane neck-to-neck fighting on high-speed circuits, face total destruction madness on crazy courses with intersections and oncoming traffic, or go for demolition dominance in derby arenas.

• Awesome Cars – Our cars are old, banged up, patched together... They ooze style and character! From old American heavy-hitters to agile Europeans and fun Asians, you won’t find anything like this in other games. 

• Meaningful Customization – Change not only the look of your cars but also upgrade their body armor – Reinforce them with heavy iron that protects you from damage, but also adds weight, which impacts the cars handling. Modify your car to make a robust tank or a fragile but lightning-fast rocket, or anything in between!

• Multiplayer – Wreck your friends in local multiplayer and take racing to the limit while chasing for demolition dominance!

• Challenge modes – Have hilarious fun with crop harvesters, lawn mowers, school buses, three-wheelers and much more! 

• Career Mode – Battle for championships, earn experience, unlock new upgrades and cars, and become the all-time Wreckfest champion!

© THQ Nordic Mobile 2026

summary: Simple. Reliable. Private.
description:
WhatsApp from Meta is a FREE messaging and video calling app. It’s used by over 2B people in more than 180 countries. It’s simple, reliable, and private, so you can easily keep in touch with your friends and family. WhatsApp works across mobile and desktop even on slow connections, with no subscription fees*.
    
 
  Private messaging across the world
 
  Your personal messages and calls to friends and family are end-to-end encrypted. No one outside of your chats, not even WhatsApp, can read or listen to them.
 
 
  Simple and secure connections, right away 
 All you need is your phone number, no user names or logins. You can quickly view your contacts who are on WhatsApp and start messaging. 
 
 High quality voice and video calls 
 Make secure video and voice calls with up to 32 people for free*. Your calls work across mobile devices using your phone’s Internet service, even on slow connections. 
 
 Group chats to keep you in contact 
 Stay in touch with your friends and family. End-to-end encrypted group chats let you share messages, photos, videos and documents across mobile and desktop. 
 
 Stay connected in real time 
 Share your location with only those in your individual or group chat, and stop sharing at any time. Or record a voice message to connect quickly.
 
 
 Share daily moments through Status 
 Status allows you to share text, photos, video and GIF updates that disappear after 24 hours. You can choose to share status posts with all your contacts or just selected ones. 
 
 Use WhatsApp on your Wear OS watch to continue conversations, reply to messages, and take calls - all from your wrist. And, leverage tiles and complications to easily access your chats and send voice messages.   
 
 *In some regions, WhatsApp uses SMS verification to authenticate your phone number and secure transactions.

description:
From your morning commute to late-night deep dives, Google Gemini is your personal, proactive and powerful AI assistant.

WHY USERS LOVE GEMINI
• Our latest models, Gemini 4 Argon and Gemini Omni, unlock a new world of productivity and creativity.
• Solve complex workflows, write advanced code, and analyze data easily with Google’s newest frontier model.
• Talk things out with Gemini Live: Brainstorm in real time or share your screen/camera to discuss exactly what you see.

• Get more personalized help by connecting your favorite Google apps like Gmail, Calendar, Google Photos, YouTube, and Search.

BRING YOUR CREATIVE IDEAS TO LIFE
• Generate and edit photos with Nano Banana 2: Apply camera and lighting controls, create mockups by blending multiple images, design posters with sharp text, and effortlessly build diagrams. Then, resize as needed.
• Turn your ideas into cinematic videos with Gemini Omni for Google AI Plus, Pro, Ultra, and Workspace users.
• Create custom soundtracks for any moment with Lyria 3.

BOOST YOUR PRODUCTIVITY
• Research with NotebookLM: Get deeper, more relevant responses that are grounded in the sources in your notebook
• Study help and exam prep made easy: Upload your class notes to generate custom practice quizzes and interactive visuals.
• Turn a simple prompt into a prototype: Build web pages, games, or dashboards. You can even convert your files into a podcast-style overview to listen to while you're on the move.

UNLOCK MORE WHEN YOU UPGRADE
Level up your Gemini app experience by upgrading to the Google AI Plus, Pro, or Ultra plans, helping you tackle more complex tasks and projects. 

Review the Gemini Apps Privacy Notice: g.co/gemini/privacynotice.

If you opt in to the Gemini app, it will replace your Google Assistant as the primary assistant on the phone. Some Google Assistant voice features aren't available through the Gemini app yet. You can switch back to Google Assistant in settings.

name: AadhaarFaceRD
summary: UIDAI Face Authentication App
description:
This application is designed to function as a headless app, meaning it cannot be opened directly from the Play Store or your device's app drawer, nor will you find an application icon in your app drawer. It works in collaboration with the Aadhaar Authentication User Agency (AUA), the KYC User Agency (KUA), and other entities.

How the Application Works:
Since the application is headless, there is no option to open it directly from your device. Instead, it is invoked by an AUA or KUA that you are interacting with. When you need to authenticate your identity, the AUA/KUA will trigger the FaceRD application to perform the necessary operations. This design ensures that your interactions with the app are seamless and secure, without requiring you to manually open or interact with the app itself.

Security and Privacy:
This design choice prioritizes your security by minimizing the points of direct interaction and potential vulnerabilities. By being triggered only by authorized agencies, the application reduces the risk of unauthorized access.

name: Telegram
summary: Telegram is a messaging app with a focus on speed and security.
description:
Pure instant messaging — simple, fast, secure, and synced across all your devices. One of the top 5 most downloaded apps in the world with over 1 billion active users.

FAST: Telegram is the fastest messaging app on the market, connecting people via a unique, distributed network of data centers around the globe.

SYNCED: You can access your messages from all your phones, tablets and computers at once. Telegram apps are standalone, so you don’t need to keep your phone connected. Start typing on one device and finish the message from another. Never lose your data again.

UNLIMITED: You can send media and files, without any limits on their type and size. Your entire chat history will require no disk space on your device, and will be securely stored in the Telegram cloud for as long as you need it. 

SECURE: We made it our mission to provide the best security combined with ease of use. Everything on Telegram, including chats, groups, media, etc. is encrypted using a combination of 256-bit symmetric AES encryption, 2048-bit RSA encryption, and Diffie–Hellman secure key exchange. 

100% FREE & OPEN: Telegram has a fully documented and free API for developers, open source apps and verifiable builds to prove the app you download is built from the exact same source code that is published. 

POWERFUL: You can create group chats with up to 200,000 members, share large videos, documents of any type (.DOCX, .MP3, .ZIP, etc.) up to 2 GB each, and even set up bots for specific tasks. Telegram is the perfect tool for hosting online communities and coordinating teamwork.

RELIABLE: Built to deliver your messages using as little data as possible, Telegram is the most reliable messaging system ever made. It works even on the weakest mobile connections. 

FUN: Telegram has powerful photo and video editing tools, animated stickers and emoji, fully customizable themes to change the appearance of your app, and an open sticker/GIF platform to cater to all your expressive needs.

SIMPLE: While providing an unprecedented array of features, we take great care to keep the interface clean. Telegram is so simple you already know how to use it.

PRIVATE: We take your privacy seriously and will never give any third parties access to your data. You can delete any message you ever sent or received for both sides, at any time and without a trace. Telegram will never use your data to show you ads.

For those interested in maximum privacy, Telegram offers Secret Chats. Secret Chat messages can be programmed to self-destruct automatically from both participating devices. This way you can send all types of disappearing content — messages, photos, videos, and even files. Secret Chats use End-to-End Encryption to ensure that a message can only be read by its intended recipient.

We keep expanding the boundaries of what you can do with a messaging app. Don’t wait years for older messengers to catch up with Telegram — join the revolution today.

👉Are CRIF & Experian credit scores different from CIBIL?
CRIF, Experian & CIBIL are different platforms owned by different credit information companies. However, all 3 companies are approved by the Reserve Bank of India.

The parameters chosen by CIBIL TransUnion, Experian & CRIF High Mark are majorly similar. All 3 companies have a similar mechanism to calculate the credit score. They use repayment history, credit mix, new credit and outstanding debt to make the credit report. Having a good credit history in CIBIL will have somewhat similar results with CRIF High Mark and Experian as well.

name: Firefox Fast & Private Browser
summary: Private by default. Less tracking. Peace of mind built in.
description:
The internet. As it should be.

Firefox is a private web browser designed to protect your data, block trackers and make browsing fast, secure and simple. Whether you’re looking for an incognito browser, a private search experience or a reliable browser for everyday use, Firefox puts you first.

Why people choose Firefox

• More privacy, less tracking – Firefox automatically blocks social media trackers, cross-site cookies, crypto miners and fingerprinting scripts.
• Private browsing that protects you – Open private tabs that don’t save your history, searches or cookies. Lock them with your device security for extra protection.
• Fast, smooth performance – Load pages faster by blocking trackers and reducing unnecessary data usage.
• Search your way – Use your preferred private search engine or switch easily from the search bar.
• Passwords made simple – Generate, store and autofill passwords securely.
• Tabs that work for you – Easily organize and switch between tabs and sync them across devices to pick up where you left off.
• Focus without distractions – Reader View strips away clutter, while picture-in-picture lets you multitask with videos.
• Control your experience – Add extensions like ad blockers, customize settings and choose how you browse.
• Make it yours – Customize your home screen, layout and shortcuts for a more personal browsing experience.
• AI on your terms – Turn AI completely off or customize it feature by feature.
• Quick page summaries – Shake your phone to cut through long pages and get the key points.
• Sync across devices – Access your bookmarks, tabs and passwords anywhere you use Firefox.

Private by default
Firefox is built to protect you. Enhanced Tracking Protection automatically blocks common trackers, while Total Cookie Protection keeps cookies isolated to the sites where they belong. When you need more privacy, private browsing mode ensures your history, searches and cookies aren’t saved. Private tabs can also lock automatically, so your activity stays yours.

Your browser. Your rules.
Firefox puts you in charge of your internet. Add privacy or productivity extensions, including ad blockers, move your search bar, choose your default search engine and tailor your browser to how you use the web. Sync your data across devices for a seamless, consistent experience.

Focus with Firefox. Fast, secure and built around you 
Firefox is designed to help you stay focused with faster, more secure browsing. Reader Mode removes clutter from articles, Picture-in-Picture keeps videos accessible while you multitask and Tracker Blocking helps pages load faster. Built-in password management and private browsing keep everyday browsing simple and protected.

Built for people, not profit
Firefox was created in 2004 by Mozilla as a faster, more private and customizable browser designed to put people first. Today, Mozilla remains a nonprofit working to make the internet — and the time you spend on it — better.

Learn more about Mozilla: https://www.mozilla.org
Terms of Use: https://www.mozilla.org/about/legal/terms/firefox/

name: RailOne
summary: An All-in-one App by Indian Railways consolidating public-facing services.
description:
RailOne: Your All-in-One App by Indian Railways
RailOne is a comprehensive app developed by Indian Railways, designed to consolidate all public-facing services into a single, user-friendly platform. By integrating multiple functionalities into one app, RailOne simplifies the travel experience with a seamless single sign-on (SSO) system. Whether you’re planning a trip, booking tickets, or seeking additional services during your journey, RailOne is your ultimate travel companion.

Key Features:
Plan and Book Tickets: Effortlessly plan journeys, search for trains, and book reserved or unreserved tickets through the app. This consolidation reduces the need for multiple platforms, streamlining the booking process.
- My- Bookings: This functionality enables the users to check the details and history information of both booked and canceled tickets (unreserved and reserved) at the same platform. User interface presents the filtering  functionality as per user’s preference based on duration and transaction type.
-You: This functionality enables users to view profile details and edit if needed. Also shows status of profile completion. Gives access for changing password, enabling/disabling biometric. Users can also verify email, edit their name (can be done only once) and delete account. These options are available under My Account Tab. User can also Add money to his R-wallet.
Real-time Train Tracking: Track your train in real-time with live updates on delays, expected arrival times, and other critical information, keeping you informed and helping you adjust your plans.

Coach Position Finder: Locate your coach’s position on the platform easily, making the boarding process smoother and more convenient.

Order Food on the Go: Place food orders from partner vendors while on board, ensuring fresh and timely meals during your journey.

Rail Madad: Use the Rail Madad feature to raise and track complaints or feedback directly with Indian Railways for quick resolution.

Refund Requests: Simplify the process of requesting refunds for canceled or missed journeys through the app.

Multilingual Support: Access the app in multiple languages, catering to India’s diverse population and enhancing accessibility.

R-Wallet Integration: Utilize R-Wallet, a digital wallet integrated into the app, for secure and convenient payments for various services.

RailOne is available for download on both the Google Play Store and Apple App Store, ensuring accessibility for both Android and iOS users.

The app is developed by CRIS (Centre for Railway Information Systems), an organization under the Ministry of Railways. CRIS combines skilled IT professionals with experienced railway personnel to design, develop, and maintain critical software systems for Indian Railways. Key systems developed by CRIS include:

Reserved Ticketing System: Efficiently manages millions of long-distance seat bookings.
Unreserved Ticketing System: Facilitates easy ticketing for short-distance journeys.
Train Search and Tracking: Offers real-time train search and tracking features.
Coach Position Finder: Enhances the boarding process by helping passengers find their coach.
Rail Madad: Manages grievances and feedback effectively.
Food Ordering System: Allows passengers to order food from partner vendors.
Refund Systems: Processes refunds smoothly for booking errors and cancellations.
CRIS continues to lead in innovation, developing integrated solutions that make travel more efficient. The partnership between CRIS and Indian Railways has been instrumental in modernizing railway infrastructure and enhancing passenger services through advanced technology. RailOne embodies this digital evolution, making train travel smarter, more comfortable, and more accessible. With ongoing developments in RailOne and CRIS’s IT systems, Indian Railways aims to provide an exceptional travel experience, leveraging technology to simplify every aspect of your journey.

Ludo King is a cross platform multiplayer game that supports Desktop, Android, iOS, HTML5 and Windows mobile platform at same time. Ludo King is the modern version of the royal game of Pachisi. A Ludo game which was played between Indian kings and queens in ancient times. Roll the Ludo dice and move your tokens to reach the center of the Ludo board. Beat other players, become the Ludo King.

Ludo King follows the traditional rules and the old school look of the Ludo game. Just like the kings and queens of India's golden age, your fate depends on the roll of the Ludo's dice and your strategy of moving the tokens effectively. 

Features of Ludo King:
* No internet connection required! Play against the computer
* Play with your family and friends through Local and Online Multiplayer
* Play 2 to 6 Player Local Multiplayer Mode
* Invite and challenge your Facebook Friends in a private game room and beat them to become Ludo King

Ludo King is a friends and family game that was once played by kings and now it can be enjoyed by you and your family and friends. You'll be playing this Ludo for hours and its fun for the whole family.

Ludo King is a perfect time pass game of Ludo board game. You played Ludo in your childhood, now play on your phone and tablet.

Another nostalgic game similar in structure is Snakes and Ladders. Like Ludo, you may have played this board game when you were young. Ludo King now incorporates this classic Snakes and Ladders game as a whole new level. The objective of the game is simple: you have to be the first one to make it to 100. A game of ups and down, Snakes and Ladders has been a favorite for generations; and now you can play it too, with Ludo King. 

Ludo has different names in different regions and countries like Fia, Fia-spel (Fia the game), Le Jeu de Dada (The Game of Dada), Non t'arrabbiare, Fia med knuff (Fia with push), Cờ cá ngựa, Uckers, Griniaris, Petits Chevaux (Little Horses), Ki nevet a végén, برسي (Barjis/Barjees). name: Arrow Puzzle: Tap Puzzle Games
summary: Tap away arrows to escape the maze. Train your brain with smart puzzle games!
description:
Arrow Puzzle is a single-player logic game that turns simple taps into a rewarding challenge. Your goal is straightforward: find a free path, tap arrows in the right order, and enjoy as the maze slowly turns into a clear, empty board on every level. Follow the arrows to escape the puzzle and find a soothing flow that keeps your mind engaged and relaxed.

Looking for a gentle workout for your brain without any pressure attached? This comforting single-player arrow game lets you tap away the stress, gives you a focused break from the noise, and helps you train your logic and spatial thinking as you build a calming daily ritual. Inspired by abstract graphic games, each cleared board in the arrow game is a small mental reset—a satisfying win for your mind.

How to Play Arrow Puzzle:

• In this tap away puzzle game, your goal is to clear the grid—a maze of arrows all pointing in different directions.
• Escape the arrow puzzle grid by finding a free path. An arrow moves only when its way ahead is clear and no other arrows are blocking its path. Take a moment to think first.
• Tap arrows away one by one to help them leave the grid and open up more space for the others. Clean visuals inspired by abstract graphic games help you focus on every move.
• Avoid blocked arrows. If you tap an arrow whose path is blocked, you lose a life. Lives are limited on each level, but you can always rethink your plan and try again at your own pace.
• If you get stuck, use helpful hints to highlight an arrow that can safely escape the maze.
• Plan the order of your taps, help every arrow escape, and master this abstract graphic puzzle game one level at a time.

Why You'll Love Arrow Puzzle:

✔ A minimalist arrow game with simple rules and deep strategy—easy to start, satisfying to master.
✔ Hundreds of handcrafted tap away style puzzles that grow in challenge as you play.
✔ Daily Challenges—play every day, complete monthly challenges, and collect unique trophies.
✔ Helpful hints when you need a small nudge to release an arrow and keep the flow going.
✔ No timer, no pressure—a relaxing escape and a true delight for your mind.
✔ Clean, calming visuals and smooth animations that keep the focus on puzzle-solving in this single-player tap game.

Play Arrow Puzzle, clear the grid of arrows, and enjoy a rare balance of sharp focus and deep relaxation.

name: BGMI: FPS Battle Royale
summary: Step into the Arctic Chronicles update in BGMI, India's online multiplayer game
description:
Step into the Arctic Chronicles update in BGMI, India's free-to-play battle royale and online multiplayer shooting game. 


Arctic Chronicles Theme Mode 
A Norse-myth makeover comes to the classic maps Erangel, Livik and Vikendi, built around a giant Ancient Beast. Shoot down the two Seal Towers, then activate the altar to bind the Beast in rune chains and force its mouth open. Earn a Hero's Medal, walk inside the Beast, and explore its body across moving platforms, hidden caves, treasure scales and teleport points. Visit the new Uchisar Castle landmark added to Erangel. If you get eliminated, enter the Aurora Realm, chase the starlight, and Get a chance to skydive back into the game" for Aurora Realm. 

Collect random passive skills from Glyph Altars, loot crates and the Ancient Beast stage. Skills run from level 1 to 3, and chasing light spheres for Power Feathers raises your odds of a higher tier. Abilities include Aurora Blink for a double jump and dash, a Tactical Shield at low health, Faster Healing, Quick Reload, Supply Detection, Armor Repair and Air Drop Prediction. Summon the Aurora Pegasus to gallop on the ground or fly through the air. 


Erangel Subzero 
A frozen Erangel. Crashed satellites leak cold gas that spreads across the island and reshapes the blue zone. Stalber, Shelter, the Military Base and the Boatyard freeze over, the Sosnovka bridge partly collapses, and ice covers parts of the water. A four-part weather system brings random blizzards that cut visibility and slow you down. New gear includes the Cold-Proof Suit for blue-zone immunity, the BZ Grenade, a Liquid Nitrogen Tank in place of the Molotov and a Snowboard for fast movement on ice. Cast a line with the new Fishing System, and ride Snowmobiles and Snowbikes while classic vehicles get anti-slip tires. 


Snow Festival 
A festival playground built around an amusement-park theme. Jump into snow piles to trigger a golden gift box, ride the carousel, try ice fishing and the slides, and throw the Frost Festival Crystal Ball to grow a tree for cover. 


New WOW Maps: World of Wonder 
Brainrot Mode gets a Snow Festival makeover, with snowy environments, new Laser and Bell Brainrot, and a festival-themed base skin. In Avalanche Escape, dodge avalanches, upgrade your skates with Snow Coins, and buy shields in the Winter Shop. Weekend admin events bring limited-time activities. 

The Ferrari SF-25 racing car skin arrives in WOW Mode. Get event discounts or a free trial card, then use the skin on maps with Racing Vehicle Spawn Devices. It appears only on WOW maps. 

The new Deluxe WOW PASS unlocks all privileges, an instant 10-level upgrade, and exclusive items. It also adds room decorations, light curtains, smart suggestions, and more frequent update notifications 


What You Can Do in BGMI 
BGMI is a battle royale and multiplayer shooting game for players in India who want to play with friends and compete online. Drop into 100-player Classic battle royale, fast multiplayer modes like Arena and Team Deathmatch, or gear up and extract loot in Metro Royale. Build a squad of up to four friends, talk on real-time voice chat, and fight to be the last team standing. Master gunplay with rifles, snipers, SMGs and shotguns, switch between FPS and TPS views, and battle across maps like Erangel, Miramar, Sanhok and Livik. 


Why Players in India Choose BGMI 
BGMI is free to download and play, with optional purchases that are cosmetic only and do not affect gameplay. It runs on a wide range of Android phones with adjustable graphics and frame-rate settings, and offers India-based servers for low-latency matches and regular updates.

बेहतरीन ब्यूटी पार्लर और फैशन स्टूडियो में आपका स्वागत है!

ट्रेंडी आउटफिट डिज़ाइन करें, परफ़ेक्ट वर्चुअल मेकअप किट का उपयोग करें, और अपनी मॉडल्स को सबसे बड़े फैशन शो के लिए तैयार करें। ढेरों कपड़े, कॉस्मेटिक्स और गहनों के साथ, आपकी स्टाइलिंग जर्नी यहाँ से शुरू होती है!

👗 स्टाइल और ड्रेस अप

स्टाइलिश टॉप, पैंट, खूबसूरत ड्रेसेस और पार्टी गाउन को मिक्स और मैच करें।

हर इवेंट के लिए आउटफिट कस्टमाइज़ करें: फैशन शो, कॉलेज, पार्टी और शादियां।

फैंसी जूते, डिज़ाइनर बैग, धूप का चश्मा और चमकदार गहनों के साथ लुक को पूरा करें।

💄 मेकअप और ब्यूटी पार्लर

अपनी मेकअप किट का उपयोग करके परफेक्ट लुक बनाएं: लिपस्टिक, आईलाइनर, ग्लोइंग आईशैडो और ब्लश।

नेचुरल ब्यूटी, बोल्ड ग्लैमर, या क्यूट डॉल मेकअप स्टाइल में से चुनें।

परफेक्ट मेकओवर के लिए ग्लिटर, स्टिकर्स और स्पेशल इफेक्ट्स जोड़ें।

💇 हेयर सैलून स्टूडियो

अपनी मॉडल के बालों को स्टाइल करें, कर्ल करें, सीधा करें या कलर करें।

ट्रेंडी चोटी से लेकर पार्टी कर्ल तक खूबसूरत हेयर स्टाइल आज़माएं।

🌟 फैशन शो पर राज करें

अपनी मॉडल्स को ड्रेस अप करें और रोमांचक फैशन शो इवेंट्स में हिस्सा लें।

रेयर ड्रेसेस अनलॉक करें, अपनी क्रिएटिविटी दिखाएं और टॉप पर पहुँचें!

🎀 लड़कियां इसे क्यों पसंद करती हैं

फैशन और क्रिएटिविटी पसंद करने वाली लड़कियों के लिए परफेक्ट मेकअप और ड्रेस अप गेम।

इस शानदार ब्यूटी सैलून गेम में अनगिनत आउटफिट कॉम्बिनेशन।

शानदार ग्राफिक्स और खेलने में आसान कंट्रोल्स।

पूरी तरह से सुरक्षित, कोई विज्ञापन नहीं, कोई टाइम प्रेशर नहीं - बस ढेर सारा मज़ा!

क्या आप अगली Fashion Star बनने के लिए तैयार हैं? आपका ड्रीम ब्यूटी सैलून आपका इंतज़ार कर रहा है!

description:

Step into Teyvat, a vast world teeming with life and flowing with elemental energy.

You and your sibling arrived here from another world. Separated by an unknown god, stripped of your powers, and cast into a deep slumber, you now awake to a world very different from when you first arrived.

Thus begins your journey across Teyvat to seek answers from The Seven — the gods of each element. Along the way, prepare to explore every inch of this wondrous world, join forces with a diverse range of characters, and unravel the countless mysteries that Teyvat holds...

MASSIVE OPEN WORLD

Climb any mountain, swim across any river, and glide over the world below, taking in the jaw-dropping scenery each step of the way. And if you stop to investigate a wandering Seelie or strange mechanism, who knows what you might discover?

ELEMENTAL COMBAT SYSTEM

Harness the seven elements to unleash elemental reactions. Anemo, Electro, Hydro, Pyro, Cryo, Dendro, and Geo interact in all sorts of ways, and Vision wielders have the power to turn this to their advantage.

Will you vaporize Hydro with Pyro, electro-charge it with Electro, or freeze it with Cryo? Your mastery of the elements will give you the upper hand in battle and exploration.

BEAUTIFUL VISUALS

Feast your eyes on the world around you, with a stunning art style, real-time rendering, and finely tuned character animations delivering you a truly immersive visual experience. Lighting and weather all change naturally over time, bringing every detail of this world to life.

SOOTHING SOUNDTRACK

Let the beautiful sounds of Teyvat draw you in as you explore the expansive world around you. Performed by the world's top orchestras such as London Philharmonic Orchestra and Shanghai Symphony Orchestra, the soundtrack changes seamlessly with the time and gameplay to match the mood.

BUILD YOUR DREAM TEAM

Team up with a diverse cast of characters in Teyvat, each with their own unique personalities, stories, and abilities. Discover your favorite party combinations and level up your characters to help you conquer even the most daunting of enemies and domains.

JOURNEY WITH FRIENDS

Team up with friends across various platforms to trigger more elemental action, tackle tricky boss fights, and conquer challenging domains together to reap rich rewards.

As you stand atop the peaks of Jueyun Karst and take in the rolling clouds and vast terrain stretching out before you, you may wish to stay in Teyvat a little longer... But until you are reunited with your lost sibling, how can you rest? Go forth, Traveler, and begin your adventure!

WANDER THE THOUSAND STARS, SHAPE MYRIADS OF WONDERLANDS

Enter Miliastra Wonderland — a dreamlike realm of adventure, creation, and socializing. Customize your Manekins, meet friends in the Lobby, tackle challenges in various stages, or craft your own unique worlds in the Miliastra Sandbox!

name: Castle Busters
summary: 1v1 PvP strategy brawler! Build your crew, smash castles and rule the arena!
description:
Castle Busters is a PvP battle game where you build your castle, draft your units, and smash your opponent's castle to pieces. Blast through destructible walls and leave their plans in rubble!

Crush other players in fast 1v1 online multiplayer battles where turn-based strategy meets castle-smashing chaos.

Just you, your rival, and two castles that won't both survive the match intact. And you'd only just finished decorating!

⚔️ BREAK EVERY WALL. RULE EVERY ARENA.

In Castle Busters, the battlefield falls apart one shot at a time. Every wall you destroy opens a new angle. Every floor you collapse exposes a rival. Who needs a front door anyway?

WHY PLAYERS LOVE CASTLE BUSTERS

🏰 Fully destructible castles. Smash through walls and bring down their towers. 

⚡ Turn-based 1v1 PvP. Fast online multiplayer matches packed with tactical decisions. Make every shot count because your rival gets the next one.

🏗️ Your castle. Your design. Build a castle worth showing off, then put it to the test against other players. Building yours is almost as satisfying as watching theirs collapse. 

🛡️ Build your loadout. Draft your units: brave knights, sharp-eyed archers and bombers who brought more than enough explosives. Combine their strengths, find powerful synergies, and leave your opponent shaking more than their towers.

📈 Upgrades that make a difference. Level up your units and strengthen your castle with new gadgets. Give your crew a stronger home and your opponent a harder job.

🏆 Battle through the arenas. Earn trophies, progress along Trophy Road, and unlock Ranked mode. Battle real players and climb the leaderboards for rewards and bragging rights.

🔥 The Forge. Earn epic rewards as you upgrade your squad and stronghold. Who knew you could get rewarded for being such a destructive influence?

🎯 Play your way. Pick off exposed units with precision or lay siege to their castle. Change your strategy as the walls come down and decide where the next shot will hurt most.

CORE GAMEPLAY

Take aim and fire. Your crew brought the firepower. Your opponent kindly supplied the target. Destroy their defenses to open up your next shot, expose their units, and make their castle collapse. They can't hide behind a wall you've already demolished.

Win by wiping out all enemy units or turning their castle into rubble. Every turn brings a choice: take out a hero or give their castle a window they didn't ask for.

DRAFT YOUR CREW

Some heroes bring the damage. Others rally the crew to hit even harder. And some bring teammates back from the dead because nobody said they could leave yet.

Mix and match units to build a loadout where their abilities work together. Plan around your favorites, experiment with different combinations, and find a crew that suits your playstyle.

RAISE YOUR GAME

Level up your units, unlock new heroes, and discover fresh tactical options as your crew grows. Your castle evolves too. Strengthen your walls and towers, try new gadgets and strategies, and put your build to the test in multiplayer PvP.

Progress through the arenas on Trophy Road, then climb the ranked ladder and clash with the best. You'll need to outthink your rivals, not just outshoot them. The view from the top is lovely. Expect incoming fire.

WHO IT'S FOR

If you love turn-based strategy games, 1v1 PvP duels, or fast online multiplayer battles, Castle Busters is built for you. Got a few minutes? That's plenty of time to make a mess of someone's castle. With physics-based artillery and walls that won't stay where you left them, it's impossible to play the same way twice.

The arena is open. Go break something.

FREE TO PLAY

Castle Busters is free to download and play. Some in-game items are available for purchase. A network connection is required. Suitable for players 13+.

name: Jewel Popper - Play & Win
summary: Match 3 jewel puzzle: free trapped diamonds and hatch dragons.
description:
What is Jewel Popper - Play & Win?
Jewel Popper - Play & Win is a match 3 puzzle game where you swap rubies, sapphires, emeralds, topaz and amethysts to free trapped treasures, level by level. Each episode takes you to a new royal world, from a treasure vault full of diamonds to a crystal gem mine where dragon eggs wait to hatch.

Who is Jewel Popper - Play & Win for?
For anyone who likes a jewel puzzle game with clear goals instead of endless random boards. Play one short level on the bus or during a coffee break, or work through a whole episode on a quiet evening. If you enjoy gem matching games where every level has its own small mission, this one is made for you.

What does Jewel Popper - Play & Win do?
💎 Free trapped diamonds and dragon eggs
Break the glass cases and rock around them; a treasure is freed once every cell around it is clear.
🐉 Hatch baby dragons in the gem mine
In Crystal Caverns you crack boulders of up to 3 layers, ride mine carts down to the rails and hatch the Golden Dragon Egg in level 20.
💥 Match 3 specials and combos
Shooting Star, Gem Bomb, Golden Arrow and Rainbow Diamond each clear the board in their own way, and two specials swapped together make a bigger blast.
🔨 Boosters for tough levels
Use the Hammer on one cell, the Sceptre on a row, the Griffin on a column or the Star Lantern on every gem of one colour.
🗺️ Levels on a royal map
Every level shows its goals and moves before you start, with a boss level halfway and at the end of each episode.
🌍 Play in your own language
The game is translated into 56 languages.

How does Jewel Popper - Play & Win work?
1. Open the game and start level 1 right away; the first levels show you each new goal step by step.
2. Swap two neighbouring gems to make a line of 3 or more of the same colour.
3. Reach the goals shown at the top before you run out of moves.
4. Clear the level to unlock the next one on the map and earn up to 3 stars.
5. Out of moves? Try again with a life; lives refill one every 30 minutes, up to 5.

Tips to clear hard jewel levels
• Look at the goals first and match next to the rock or glass, not at the top of the board: a normal match only cracks rock or glass right next to it.
• Save specials for the cells a normal match can't reach, such as the centre of a large egg or a cell in a corner.
• Swap two specials together instead of using them one by one; the combo covers far more of the board.
• Matches low on the board make the gems fall and can set off extra chain reactions.
• Pick a start booster before a boss level instead of buying moves at the end.

Compatibility and requirements
Jewel Popper - Play & Win runs on Android phones and tablets; watching a video for coins needs an internet connection. Your progress is saved on your device. Coins and boosters are only used inside the game.
Jewel Popper - Play & Win contains ads and offers in-app purchases.

Free the jewels, hatch the dragons and enjoy every match 3 level of Jewel Popper - Play & Win.

summary: Candy match 3 puzzle: swap sweets, set off combos and rescue trapped treasures
description:
What is Candy Sweep Puzzle?
Candy Sweep Puzzle is a candy match 3 game in which you swap neighbouring candies to line up three or more, for anyone who likes short puzzle levels with a clear goal. Every level of this match 3 puzzle gives you a goal and a limited number of moves, from breaking toffee crates to rescuing candy, sea creatures and gifts trapped in rock candy.

Who is Candy Sweep Puzzle for?
For players who want a relaxing candy puzzle game during a coffee break or on the train, with levels you can finish in a few minutes. For match 3 fans who like to plan a move ahead and set up combos instead of swiping at random. And for anyone who enjoys a cheerful harbour world with a sea otter called Pip cheering you on.

What does Candy Sweep Puzzle do?
🍬 Swap and match candies
Five candies (Lemon Drop, Mint Cube, Cherry Heart, Blueberry Ball and Grape Gumdrop) fill the board; match three to clear them before your moves run out.
🚀 Special candies and combos
Match four to make a Rocket Pop that clears a row or column; other match shapes make the Candy Gull, Fizz Buoy and Rainbow Shell, and swapping two specials together sets off a combo.
🧱 Candy obstacles on every level
Obstacles such as Toffee Crates, Sugar Sand, Licorice Ropes and Rock Candy each break in their own way, so every level asks for a different plan.
🎁 Rescue everything trapped on the board
Break the rock candy, licorice nets and other obstacles around trapped candy, sea creatures and the Mystery Gift to set them loose and complete the level.
🔨 Candy boosters
Use the Candy Mallet to smash any tile, or the Tide Wave, Pelican and Lighthouse Lamp; before a level you can also start with a Candy Gull, Fizz Buoy or Rainbow Shell on the board.
🎡 Daily Spin and Lucky Shells
Spin the wheel once a day for coins, boosters, a life or the jackpot chest, and try your luck in the Lucky Shells mini game for extra coins.

How does Candy Sweep Puzzle work?
1. Open the game: the first level starts right away and shows you how to swap and how specials work.
2. Read the goal at the top of the level: the pieces to collect and the moves you have.
3. Swap two neighbouring candies to make a line of three or more.
4. Reach the goal before the moves run out to win the level and move on along the harbour map.
5. Out of moves? Use a booster, watch a short video for extra moves, or try again with one of your 5 lives (one comes back every 30 minutes).

Tips for clearing hard candy levels
• Look at the bottom of the board first: matches there make the candies above fall and often set off chain reactions on their own.
• Keep a Rocket Pop until it lines up with the row or column that holds your goal.
• Swap two specials into each other instead of using them one by one; the combo clears far more of the board.
• Rock Candy needs more than one hit: aim matches right next to it, not just near it.
• Save the Candy Mallet for the last one or two pieces of a goal, when a single tile decides the level.

Compatibility and requirements
Candy Sweep Puzzle runs on Android phones and tablets in 56 languages. New levels are added in regular updates. There is no time mode and no leaderboard. Progress is saved on your device.
Candy Sweep Puzzle contains ads and offers in-app purchases.

name: Forest Match - Earn rewards
summary: Relaxing match 3 puzzle: swap, blast combos and rescue cute forest animals
description:
What is Forest Match?
Forest Match is a match 3 puzzle game where you swap leaves, acorns, berries, dewdrops and bluebells to free cute forest animals trapped in thorny thickets. It's for anyone who likes a calm, colourful puzzle with a clear goal in every level.

Match pieces next to a thicket to break it, rescue the hedgehog, bunny or fox cub inside, and watch the grove bloom again on your home screen.

Who is Forest Match for?
For players who want a relaxing match 3 game for a coffee break, the commute or a few minutes before bed. Levels are short, you play at your own pace and there is no timer.

It also suits puzzle fans who like a bit of thinking: some boards are full of vines, webs, logs and moss, and the right first swap makes all the difference.

What does Forest Match do?
🦔 Rescue cute forest animals
Free a hedgehog, bunny and fox cub in the woods, a duckling, beaver and otter by the brook, and a squirrel, badger and red panda in the orchard.

🌲 Three forest areas to explore
Play through Whispering Woods, Sunny Brook Meadow and Amber Orchard: lots of puzzle levels, with a chest to open when an area is fully in bloom.

💥 Combos and special pieces
Match 4 or 5 to make pinecone bombs, line blasts and the Forest Wisp, then swap two specials together for a bigger blast.

🪓 Boosters for tricky levels
Chop one tile with the Axe, clear a column with the Owl, a row with the Gust, or every piece of one kind with the Firefly Jar.

🍂 New obstacles in every area
Spiders' webs, creeping brambles, mossy floors, flower buds, beaver dams and apple crates keep each level different.

🎰 Daily Spin and Lucky Acorns
Spin once a day for a reward, and unlock the Lucky Acorns bonus game after level 3 to win coins and boosters.

How does Forest Match work?
1. Open a level on the forest map and check its goals: pieces to collect and animals to free.
2. Pick start boosters if you like, then swap two neighbouring pieces to make a row of three or more.
3. Match next to the thickets until every animal is free, before you run out of moves.
4. Win up to three stars, collect coins and move on to the next level.
5. You have 5 lives; a new one fills up every 30 minutes, and friends can send you extra help.

Tips to free trapped animals faster
• Look at the goal panel first: a match next to a thicket counts more than a big combo on the other side of the board
• Make your matches low on the board; falling pieces often set off free cascades
• Save a line blast for a thicket in the same row or column instead of firing it straight away
• A web only breaks when you match right next to it, so plan your swaps around it
• Bramble spreads after every turn you don't cut it, so deal with it early
• Keep the Axe for the last layer of thicket when you're one move short

Compatibility and requirements
Forest Match runs on Android phones and tablets. Ads, rewarded videos and help from friends need a connection. The game is available in 56 languages.
Forest Match contains ads and offers in-app purchases.

Forest Match is a cosy match 3 puzzle game for anyone who wants to rescue forest animals one level at a time.
