name: Oxide: Survival Island
summary: Multiplayer survival simulator on abandoned island: survival action with friends
description:
Oxide: Survival Island is a hard online survival simulator. It is a sandbox world with real players. You wake up on a dangerous shore with nothing. This is island survival. Cold, hunger, animals, and enemies can kill you fast. Every server is a shared world. It keeps running even when you leave.

Play on your own servers. Your progress is saved. You can return later and continue. One server can host many players. That makes the world feel alive. You will meet builders, raiders, and clans. You can fight them or work with them. This is a true massively multiplayer survival experience. Many players look for rust survival vibes on mobile. This game gives that tense loop: gather, craft, build, defend, repeat.

Explore a big island of survival. Go through woods and coastal areas. Travel along the ocean and shore. Visit the gas station and enemy bases. Search loot barrels for supplies. The map is larger and more open. It gives you space to hide, scout, and attack. It also gives enemies more places to ambush you. Each run can feel like a lost island story.

You can play solo. You can also play with others. Try multiplayer survival games with friends. Invite them to the same server. Add them to your friends list. See when they are online. This makes teamwork simple. Build together and protect each other. That is co-op survival. If you like coop survival games, you can share roles. One player farms resources. One crafts weapons. One scouts and guards the base. These are coop survival games built by real players. For many fans, it feels like rust survival multiplayer, but designed for phones.

Collect wood, stone, and metal. Craft tools and gear. Craft weapons and ammo. The game has many weapon types. The crafting system is improved. The building system is improved too. Start with a small shelter. Turn it into a strong base. Place walls, doors, and storage. Create a safe area and defend it.

Use the cupboard system to protect your base. Craft a cupboard and place it inside. Put logs in it often. This slows down decay. It also helps you keep control of your home area. Without it, your house will weaken over time.

Survive in three biomes. Some zones are cold. Some are temperate. Some are hot. Craft attire for protection. Clothing helps against damage. It also helps against cold. Watch your food and water. Hunt animals for meat. Cook and store supplies. Manage your inventory and plan long trips.

Travel by land and by sea. The ocean is not only scenery. It is part of the danger and the route. Fans of sea adventure games will enjoy moving along the coast. You can scout bases from the water. You can move loot between points. The sea can also hide enemies. Storms and long routes add pressure. This is where island survival feels the most tense.

Fight for resources. Defend your base. Raid other bases. Make allies if you want. Betrayal is possible too. Each server becomes a contest for control. This is last survival. Only the strongest teams last. Master land survival, learn the map, and get better gear. Build smart, craft fast, and stay alert.

If you search for rust mobile, you want a tough survival sandbox on your phone. If you search for rust in mobile, you want raids, bases, and real players. Oxide brings that style with persistent servers, crafting, and open-world fights. It is a mobile answer for rust survival, with the freedom of a sandbox and the pressure of multiplayer survival.

Enjoy improved sky graphics and day-night changes. Watch the horizon, track threats, and survive the island.

• Limit background data usage of other apps while you game.
• Uses Android's local VpnService to restrict internet access exclusively for unlisted background apps, helping protect your gaming bandwidth.

💡 Real Utility, No False Promises
Tired of generic "game booster" apps that make unrealistic promises about magic RAM cleaners or instant FPS acceleration? Game Launcher VIP Ping-GFX HUD takes a realistic, transparent approach. We value your privacy and only request permissions required for core utility features:

• VpnService: Used exclusively to run a local loopback firewall that restricts internet access to unselected background apps. No external VPN server is connected, and no network traffic is logged or sent off your device.

• Special Use Foreground Service: Used solely to monitor active network ping and keep the in-game HUD overlay responsive while playing.
• Internet: Used for measuring network latency (ping checks) and serving in-app features.

⚠️ Disclaimer

MobileSheets is the ultimate sheet music viewer for Android tablets. It frees you from having to lug around books and binders, and gives you the ability to access any score in your library in seconds. It also comes with a number of powerful features for musicians including:
    - Multiple modes of operation including two pages side-by-side, half page turns, and vertically scrolling pages.
    - Hands-free page turns using any bluetooth or usb devices (including two and four pedal models), through the automatic scrolling feature, or through face gestures such as an open mouth or smile.
    - Annotations for marking up music including support for freeform drawing, basic shapes, text and stamps
    - A custom audio player for playing audio tracks with your scores. Audio player supports a-b looping and multiple sizes.
    - Custom page ordering, making it easy to cut out unnecessary pages, repeat pages or change the sequence of pages without affecting the original document.
    - A metronome with multiple display modes and sound effects
    - Bookmarks for quick and easy access to sections in scores
    - Link points for handling repeats and quickly jumping between pages
    - Smart buttons that can be placed on a score to activate configurable actions when pressed
    - Support for multiple file types including images, PDFs, text files and chord pro files. 
    - Support for importing CSV index files to break up large PDF songbooks
    - Support for communicating with MIDI devices over USB to load songs or trigger actions.
    - The ability to transpose chords in text and chord pro files.
    - Manual and automatic cropping to completely eliminate unnecessary margins
    - Support for setlists and collections to efficiently group songs for playback. 
    - Powerful library management features with a huge list of supported metadata fields, giving you complete control over the data in your library

name: Game Mode Pro: Launcher & HUD
summary: Launch your games, watch live device readings, get a report after every session.
description:
Game Mode Pro is the paid edition of Game Mode: the same launcher and device-reading tools, its own interface, and no ads of any kind.

GAME LAUNCHER
Your games in one place: games are picked up automatically, anything else you add by hand. A game's home screen shortcut opens it through the app, HUD included, and a widget shows your most played game and the minute it usually dips.

LIVE HUD OVER YOUR GAME
With your permission, a small floating panel shows what Android reports while you play: free RAM, battery level and temperature, latency to a public DNS server, screen refresh rate. It does not show in-game FPS - no app can measure another app's frame rate - and it does not change how your game runs. Games started from the app or its shortcut get the panel; Auto HUD (VIP) opens it however a game starts.

A REPORT AFTER EVERY SESSION
Ping stability, free memory and battery temperature, with the raw numbers beside each score, plus playing time. It also shows what the network did: Wi-Fi signal and band, and the minute the signal went weak, the network changed or dropped, or the phone was moving a lot of data. Every session is kept.

AI GAME COACH - LEARNED FROM YOUR OWN SESSIONS
A model that runs entirely on your phone reads your recorded sessions: the minute your sessions with a game usually start to wobble, how long the battery lasts at that game's drain, and the time of day and network they held up best on. Two sessions of one game are enough to start. Nothing leaves your phone. These are predictions from your own history, not guarantees.

NETWORK CHECK
Measure: twenty round trips to a public DNS server, with the average, lowest, variation and unanswered samples. Wi-Fi · 4G/5G: both connections measured at the same time, side by side (uses a little mobile data). Regions: time to connect to cloud data centers in 13 regions, to pick a server region in a game's settings. It measures; it cannot change or switch your connection, and never reaches a game's server.

REMINDERS WHILE YOU PLAY
Optional, once per session each: your usual wobble minute, a hot or low battery, a phone already hot on the charger.

GAME MODE
Silences notifications while you play and, if you choose, calls too. It can also hold screen brightness, set media volume, keep the screen awake while Game HUD is on, and remind you to take a break. Give a game its own Game Mode, or skip it for that game. Everything it changes is restored when Game Mode ends; the brightness lock asks for "Modify system settings" first.

TEST KIT
Touch: how often the screen reports your finger, how many fingers it tracks, and a grid showing any spot that never registers. Display: the refresh rate now, the rates the screen supports, and a dead-pixel check. Controller: every button and both sticks, plus a stick-drift check. It only reads what the hardware reports.

REFLEX TRAINER - ROBOT RANGE
Robots pop up at three distances for 30 seconds; tap each before its ring closes. Three ranges open as you rank up, and the lobby replays the best 10 seconds of your record run. Timed from the frame a robot appears to your touch - it measures you, not the device.

GFX GUIDE
From your device's RAM, CPU, resolution and refresh rate, it suggests graphics, frame rate, resolution and shadows to set in the game yourself. It cannot change a game's settings or make it run faster.

VIP (optional subscription)
Auto HUD and Auto Game Mode for games opened from anywhere, plus six things your sessions make possible: a forecast of the next session, battery time left for this game, alerts that learn what is normal for your phone, change since your first sessions, a backup of your session log, and your records with a weekly report. Everything else above is in the purchase price.

10 languages, switchable in the app. "Display over other apps" and "Usage access" are only for the HUD and are asked for on the HUD screen; notification policy access is only for Do Not Disturb.

Sensi Pro is a sensitivity toolkit for mobile shooter players, with a live Game HUD and on-device AI. No root, no extra apps, no ads.

SENSITIVITY FINDER
• Reads your screen size and refresh rate from the phone itself
• Asks how you hold it (2, 3 or 4 fingers) and how you play

TEST & CALIBRATE

• Shows what changed and why before you apply it

PROFILES & TEMPLATES

GAME HUD
A floating panel over the games you open from Sensi Pro, with four tabs:
• LIVE: ping, refresh rate (Hz) and battery temperature as gauges with their thresholds
• CHART: your last 60 real ping samples, jitter and the AI's next-ping estimate
• PHONE: Focus, keep awake, dim, screenshot, plus network, thermal status, battery and free RAM
• GAMES: your games one tap away
Outside a game it shrinks to a ping bubble. Hold it still or tap ✕ for the command wheel (finish the session, hide until your next game, switch off), or drag it to the bottom and drop it on a command. Each command has a 3-second undo.

AUTO (VIP)
• Auto HUD: games from your list bring up the HUD however you start them, and it keeps each game's spot. Needs Usage Access, which only tells the app which app is in front. Without VIP, start games from Sensi Pro, its widget or a home-screen shortcut (3 free tries of Auto HUD)
• Auto setup for games started from Sensi Pro: Focus, keep screen on and dim, undone when the HUD closes
• AI alerts when ping or jitter runs above your usual for that game

PRE-GAME
• Device Scan: one tap measures ping, jitter, battery temperature, free RAM and refresh rate. It changes no setting
• Focus Mode: Do Not Disturb for the match, lifted when you return

ON-DEVICE AI
• Network forecast: a small model learns from your real ping history to estimate your next ping
• AI Game Coach: add your games, start them from Sensi Pro and see sessions, play time this week, typical ping and tips per game. Free plan: one game at a time; VIP: every game
Both run entirely on your phone; your ping and play history never leave it.

MORE TOOLS
• GFX Guide: graphics values suggested from your phone's RAM, cores and refresh rates, for you to set in the game
• Home-screen widget and a shortcut per game: one tap starts the game with the HUD
• Session report, weekly play time, break reminder
• English, Tiếng Việt, Bahasa Indonesia, ไทย, Bahasa Melayu, हिन्दी, Português, Español

IMPORTANT
Sensi Pro is a configuration and measurement utility. It does NOT read, modify or interact with any game or its files, draws nothing over other apps except the optional Game HUD, injects no code and provides no automatic aiming. Accessibility Service API Usage

MINIMAA includes optional features—Focus & Gestures (App & Web Blocking,
navigation shortcuts, and Double Tap to Lock)—that utilize Android's
Accessibility Service API.

When enabled, this service performs the following functions:
• Web Detox & App Blocking: Reads the active application package name and
  browser URL address bar in real-time to detect when a user-defined
  distracting app or website is opened and displays a focus prompt to block
  access.
• Navigation & System Actions: Receives gesture triggers (like double-tapping
  on the home screen or executing motion shortcuts) to perform corresponding
  system actions, such as locking your screen or going Back/Home.

Privacy and Data Safety:
• No Data Collection: The service only reads the active app package name and
  the browser's address bar to determine if a block is triggered. It does not
  record keystrokes, personal details, or other screen content.
• No Data Transmission: No accessed data is stored, collected, or
  transmitted. All processing happens locally on your device.
• Fully Optional: These features are completely optional. The Accessibility
  Service is not enabled by default and can be turned off at any time in
  Android system settings.

MINIMAA is not an accessibility tool for users with disabilities.

description:
AlfaOBD software for diagnostics of the vehicles produced by Stellantis (former FCA): Alfa-Romeo, Fiat, Lancia, Dodge, RAM, Chrysler, Jeep. Peugeot Boxer and Citroen Jumper are also supported. Although the software is primarily targeted for the car owners, it provides the features of professional scanners. Many dealer-level diagnostic and configuration procedures are available.

NOTE: FCA vehicles since MY2018 have security gateway module (SGW) installed. It blocks the third-party diagnostics. To have full access to the diagnostic features, please use an SGW bypass. Owners of Fiat 500X/JEEP Renegade/Compass (MP), please make sure that the bypass supports the second high-speed CAN bus, the one that is connected to the pins 12&13 of the car OBD plug.

NOTE: if your Android device is not in the list of compatible devices on Google Play and you cannot install or upgrade your installation please contact info@alfaobd.com.

Make sure you have a compatible OBD interface. For the list of supported OBD interfaces see www.alfaobd.com. 

NOTE: If AlfaOBD can not connect to a car ECU with the message "Interface reports NO DATA" or "Interface reports CAN ERROR" it most probably means your interface is not compatible or defective. 

For the details of configuration of connection to interface and car see application help available on http://www.alfaobd.com/AlfaOBD_Android_Help.pdf

AlfaOBD features include:
- native support of Electronic control units used in Fiat group cars. Native support differs AlfaOBD from many other diagnostic applications providing only limited generic OBDII support of Fiat group cars
- monitoring various dynamic parameters of engine, gearbox, ABS, climate control ECUs and graphical presentation as plots
- reading of static data: ECU identification, system status, fault codes with probable causes and environment information where applicable
- clearing of fault codes
- active diagnostics and configuration procedures for various equipment controlled by engine, gearbox, body computer, climate control, ABS, airbag, code control and other ECUs
- electronic key and RF remote control programming

For the full list of supported control units visit http://www.alfaobd.com

Application available in Czech, English, French, German, Hungarian, Italian, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, and Spanish. Languages are selectable via application Settings menu.

NOTE: If plots are not updated, make sure that "Force GPU rendering" is off in "Settings"->"Developer Option".

Torque also features:

* Dyno / Dynomometer and Horsepower/HP & Torque
* Can read Transmission Temperatures (vehicle dependant)

* Theme support (choose from different themes to change the look of your dashboard)

* Alarms and warnings (for example if your coolant temperature goes over 120C whilst driving) with voice/speech overlay
* Car dock support
* Graph data
* MPG
* Able to share screenshots to Facebook, Twitter, Google+, Email, etc
* AIDL API for third party apps, A simple Telnet interface for developers to talk to the adapter, and an OBD scanner.
* Works on tablet devices like the Motorola Xoom, Dell Streak, Samsung Galaxy Tab and Nook

Works on any vehicle that uses the OBD 2 standard (most vehicles built after 2000, but can work for vehicles as far back as 1996) if in doubt check with your manufacturer first or look for 'OBD2' on written on a big white label in your engine bay

Works on vehicles made by Ford, VW, GM/Vauxhall/Opel, Chrysler, Mercedes, Volkswagen, Audi, Jaguar, Citroen, Peugoet, Skoda, Kia, Mazda, Lexus, Subaru, Renault, Mitsubishi, Nissan, Honda, Hyundai, BMW, Toyota, Seat, Dodge, Jeep, Pontiac and many more vehicle makes, European, US, Far East, etc. Some vehicle ECUs may support more/less features than others

The app needs a Bluetooth OBD2 adapter to work. The adapter is small and plugs into the diagnostics socket on the car which gives your phone access. You can find a list of adapters on: http://torque-bhp.com/wiki/Bluetooth_Adapters (Garmin EcoRoute HD adapters not supported)

If you buy one of the cheap china OBD2 ELM327 bluetooth adapters from ebay / amazon, then make sure you have a good returns policy with the seller 

Some of the best reliable OBD2 / OBD adapters are the Scantool.net adapter, the OBDKey, and PLX Devices, OBDLink, Bluetooth, ELM327 and other adapters are supported - search on google for them

More features added every release - there are forums at http://torque-bhp.com/forums/ - if you want something added then let me know and I'll try to add it if it is possible! Vehicle ECUs vary in the amount of sensors supported

*PLEASE NOTE* Any reports of hanging or reboots after quitting the app is due to a bug in HTC devices and Galaxy Tab,this can be triggered by using the Pandora/Vlingo/Other BT apps. Disabling Pandoras new bluetooth settings fixes the problem, but HTC/Samsung need to release a fix.Please contact their support and request a fix,Thanks!

name: DiskDigger Pro file recovery
summary: Undelete and recover your lost or deleted files with DiskDigger!
description:
DiskDigger Pro (for rooted devices!) can undelete and recover lost photos, documents, videos, music, and more from your memory card or internal memory (see supported file types below). Whether you accidentally deleted a file, or even reformatted your memory card, DiskDigger's powerful data recovery features can find your lost files and let you restore them.

Note: if your device is not rooted, the app can only perform a "limited" scan for for deleted photos and videos. To be able to search for other types of files, and to search your device's entire internal memory, the device needs to be rooted. On a non-rooted device, the app can only recover lower-resolution versions of your photos that it finds in your device's cache and thumbnail directories.

After the scan is complete, tap the "Clean up" button to permanently delete any items that you no longer need (currently an experimental feature, available only in the Basic Scan).

You can also use the "Wipe free space" option to erase the remaining free space on your device, so that any deleted files can no longer be recoverable.

For complete instructions, please see http://diskdigger.org/android

You can upload your recovered files directly to Google Drive, Dropbox, or send them via email. The app also allows you to upload the files to an FTP server, or save them to a different local folder on your device.

DiskDigger can recover the following file types: JPG, PNG, MP4 / 3GP / MOV, M4A, HEIF, GIF, MP3, AMR, WAV, TIF, CR2, SR2, NEF, DCR, PEF, DNG, ORF, DOC / DOCX, XLS / XLSX, PPT / PPTX, PDF, XPS, ODT / ODS / ODP / ODG, ZIP, APK, EPUB, SNB, VCF, RAR, OBML16, OGG, OGA, OGV, OPUS.

description:
Blueprint is a four-track for recording songs on your phone, inspired by 4-track cassette recorders.

Great for demos, first takes, and fresh ideas: voice and guitar at the kitchen table, or a band passing one phone around the room.

The sound of the machine is built in. Each track has its own set of knobs and there is no undo.

- Four tracks, recorded one at a time, from the built-in mic, a headset mic, or a USB audio interface.
- Loops any section of a song so you can record a part over it.
- Sends any track through a space echo with spring reverb.
- Bends pitch and tempo together with a varispeed knob in the master panel.
- Has track merging/clearing, punch-in recording, and a metronome with pre-roll.
- Your recordings are WAV files saved on your phone, and show up in the Files app under Blueprint. Share the mix, every track as its own WAV, or the whole session.
- Works entirely offline and collects nothing.
- Pay once. No subscription, no ads, no account.
- Works on Android phones and tablets.

TIPS

- The first time you record with wired or USB-C headphones, Blueprint plays a few clicks through them to learn their delay, so your takes line up. Hold one earbud up to the mic. Redo it anytime in Settings.
- Overdub with wired headphones, so the mic doesn't pick up the other tracks.
- Don't use Bluetooth headphones while recording: they add delay, and only play in mono.
- Tap record while playing to punch in over a part you want to redo.
- Hold the |‹ button to loop a section.
- Tap the ? at the top left for a guide to the controls.

Blueprint is made by one person. If something feels confusing or missing, email max@blueprintdaw.com and I will answer. Follow along on instagram at @blueprintdaw.

description:
Wagotabi is your daily companion for learning Japanese from scratch, at your own pace, and with maximum immersion. Learn to read, write, and understand Japanese in context, while retaining Hiragana, Katakana, and Kanji. Use your Japanese skills to progress in the adventure offered by this educational game.

Designed in close collaboration with +300 Japanese language experts, official Japanese prefecture tourist associations and thousands of early testers, Wagotabi provides you with an immersive approach to language learning following a graded reader approach. Words and grammar points are introduced according to the JLPT standard, beginning with N5.

—

◆ START from zero: the game is beginner friendly: no initial Japanese knowledge needed. Concepts are introduced step by step and used right away in-game. Non-beginners will progress faster and equally enjoy the game.
◆ JOURNEY in Japan: Explore real cities, learn to introduce yourself, order food, ask your way to the locals and unravel hidden secrets!
◆ COLLECT new words, Kana, Kanji and get detailed explanations on grammar patterns and conjugation step-by-step. No more overwhelming Kana / Kanji / vocabulary lists.
◆ CHALLENGE Japanese Grand Masters in their castle to earn their respect!
◆ COMPETE with fellow learners on Kana and Kanji minigames and post your top scores to the leaderboard!
◆ PERSONALIZE your learning experience: benefit from our SRS tool pin-pointing your weaknesses, create your own avatar, set the game difficulty. This is your Japanese journey.
◆ ENJOY a fully ad-free experience without in-app purchase, the game can be entirely played offline!

—

(Non-exhaustive) list of features :
Interactive dictionary (with illustrations, tags etc.), clear grammar explanation, interactive tooltips, fully voiced in Japanese, SRS powered smart tests, interactions with environment, quests, 2 minigames (Kana and Kanji), boss fights, Hiragana / Katakana / Kanji stroke order and calligraphy, Kanjidex, resembling Kanji, conjugation, cloud save, advanced progress tracking tools …

—

The game is in constant development, with regular updates adding new content.
Currently available content:
+440 carefully selected words and grammar points   
+210 Kanji  
+680 example sentences  
+3000 voiced Japanese dialogues  
+400 unique NPCs in game  
All words / grammar are used extensively and in context for better retention

name: WiFi Pro FTP Server
summary: Carry a FTP server in your pocket and avoid USB cables for file transfer
description:
Convert your android phone/tablet into a FTP Server! Use this cool app to host your own FTP Server on your phone/tablet. Use the FTP Server to transfer files, photos, movies, songs etc...to/from your android device using a FTP client like FileZilla.

Key features:
★Complete FTP server with configurable port number
★Supports FTP over TLS/SSL (FTPS)
★Configurable anonymous access
★Configurable home folder (mount point)
★Configurable user-name/password
★Avoid using USB cables for file transfer and copy/backup files over Wifi
★Works over Wifi and Wifi tethering mode (hotspot mode)

★Try before you buy!!!. Try the free ad-supported version of the same FTP Server at https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.medhaapps.wififtpserver 
before buying

Please email feedback/bugs to the support email-id. If you want to use FTPS (FTP over TLS/SSL), please note that the server URL would be ftps:// and not ftp://

Please note that FTPS and SFTP are not the same. SFTP support will be added soon.

Port number should be greater than 1024 as binding to ports like 21 will not be possible on non-rooted phones. The default port number is configured to 2221 and can be changed from settings screen. For security reasons, anonymous access is not enabled by default. It can be enabled from settings screen.

If you dont have a FTP client, you could download Filezilla from https://filezilla-project.org/download.php?type=client You can also access the ftp server from windows file explorer.

name: FF Sensi Max
summary: Explore control settings, sensitivity values and HUD layouts in one simple app.
description:
FF Sensi MAX is a simple, clean reference app for mobile shooter players who like to explore their game settings before applying them. Browse every control option with a plain-language explanation, plan your sensitivity values and compare HUD layouts, all in one place.

What you can do

Controls guide
Go through categories such as In-Match, Display, Sound and more. Every option comes with a short explanation, so you understand what it does before you change it in your game. Explanations are available in English and Hinglish, and you can switch anytime.

Sensitivity planner
Adjust separate sliders for General, Red Dot, 2x Scope, 4x Scope, Sniper Scope and Free Look. Each tile shows a large live value so you can see your numbers at a glance. Not sure where to start? Tap Shuffle Sensitivity to get a fresh set of values to try.

HUD gallery
Browse a collection of HUD layout screenshots and filter them by two-finger, three-finger and four-finger styles, or by preset layouts. Tap any screenshot to open it full screen and pinch to zoom in on the details.

Phone information
See your phone's name, RAM and free storage, plus a live ping reading, on the home screen. Refresh the details anytime with one tap.

Simple by design
- No ads
- No in-app purchases
- No account or sign-in needed
- No personal data collected

Good to know
This app is a reference and planning tool. It does not change, modify or connect to any game, and it does not give any in-game advantage. Use the values and layouts you like as a guide and apply them manually in your game's own settings menu.

Internet access is used only for the live ping reading and to load the app's font. See our privacy policy for details.

FF Sensi MAX is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Garena or the makers of Free Fire. All game names, trademarks and images belong to their respective owners.

description:

Tip: 
Supports following devices:
* Supports HDR video capture with ASUS 4KPRO, GC553, GC553Pro and GC553G2 capture cards. The video format is P010/Y210, and the color space is HDR PQ
* UVC WebCam with microphone or external USB Audio input (Supports H.264, H.265, HEVC, MJPG, YUY2, P010, Y210, NV12 and so on)
* UVC video grabber with audio input or external USB Audio input (Up to 4K, Supports H.264, H.265, HEVC, MJPG, YUY2, P010, Y210, NV12 and so on, Supports HDR10/HLG video)
* Windows Hello Camera and IR Camera
* Geek szitman supercamera(2ce3:3828)non-UVC devices, e.g. USB Endoscope
* EasyCap including audio with UTV007 / HTV600 / HTV800 chipsets (VID_1B71&PID_3002)
* EasyCap including audio with STK1160 + SAA7113/GM7113 + AC97 chipsets (Audio 48kHz stereo version VID_05E1&PID_0408)
* EasyCap including audio with STK1160 + SAA7113/GM7113  (Audio 8kHz mono version VID_05E1&PID_0408)
* EasyCap including audio with EM2860 + SAA7113/GM7113 + AC97 chipsets (VID_EB1A&PID_2861)
* EasyCap including audio with SMI2021 + SAA7113/GM7113 + ES7240/CS5340 chipsets (VID_1C88&PID_0007, PID_003C, PID_003D, PID_003E, PID_003F, PID_1001)

Please use a good quality OTG cable and ensure power supply. Some devices may need to bridge HUB to enhanced USB signals to work properly, e.g. Elgato Cam link, ezcap Video Grabber.

"USB Camera" can let your android device connect to USB WebCam or video capture card via USB-OTG. You can record video or capture snapshot, OR turn your phone into a wireless IP Camera via build-in RTSP/RTSPS and HTTP/HTTPS Server for security monitoring WITH Bi-directional audio support, you can use your browser to view, of course, include "IP Camera" App.

"USB Camera" can mix USB Audio with a built-in microphone or system audio and output, or overlay the built-in camera/screen video onto the external camera video.

"USB Camera" can capture HDR PQ/HLG video with supported capture device. And encoding in HDR PQ/HLG video for recording or tranmission, or capture snapshot in Ultra HDR format. 

"USB Camera" can push the video and audio to RTMP/SRT live media server and use for network live broadcast. It supports the rtmps security protocol and SRT protocol and it can also push the media to multiple media server at the same time. It also supports HEVC/AV1 over RTMP and can be used for YouTube Live currently.

"USB Camera" supports Side by Side(SBS) view and it can work with FPV goggle

"USB Camera" can add timestamp, GPS, speed and other info on the video frames while recording and can use your headset or Bluetooth headset to capture snapshot and record video. It also supports WebCam's snapshot button.

"USB Camera" supports loop-recording. Can set auto-segment when recording and auto-delete old video archives when no enough storage. "USB Camera" can be used as "Dash Cam"

USB Camera can seamless switching between foreground and background. Just press 'Enter background' from menu. The recording will not interrupted during switching!

It support auto video recording which based on Motion Detection and the video record can be uploaded to FTP server automatically and notify you via Email!

Bi-directional audio requires IP Camera App, you can get it from https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.shenyaocn.android.WebCamPro 

IMPORTANT! On Android 9 and above, Camera permission is required to get fully USB Video device access.

This is userspace driver so it used for the app only. Android does not allow to install kernel driver so it unable to use for third-party apps.

name: Groundwire: VoIP SIP Softphone
summary: A softphone app with seamless SIP calling and an intuitive VoIP dialer
description:
Groundwire: the SIP softphone for your PBX or VoIP provider

Groundwire is a SIP softphone app from Acrobits, a leader in VoIP and communication software since 2009. It delivers clear voice and video calls for personal and professional use, with an interface built for daily calling and none of the clutter.

IMPORTANT, PLEASE READ

Groundwire is a SIP client, not a VoIP service. You need service from a VoIP provider or PBX that supports standard SIP clients.

Business calling features

Groundwire carries the call handling you expect from a desk phone:

- Group calls, for conferencing several people into one conversation.
- Attended transfers, so you can announce a caller before handing the call over.
- Unattended transfers, when the caller just needs the right extension.
- Voicemail with notifications, so a missed call still reaches you.
- Instant messaging, for the things that do not need a call.
- Per-account settings, so one device carries several SIP identities cleanly.

Works with your PBX or VoIP provider

Groundwire is a universal client and true VoIP for PBX users. Teams run it as an Asterisk softphone, a FreePBX extension, or a 3CX endpoint, and it connects just as readily to hosted PBX systems and business phone providers. It also comes preconfigured for major providers, so setup takes minutes. Because it is a standard client, there is no lock-in: bring the account you already have, and Groundwire becomes the mobile extension of your PBX, with encrypted SIP calling on every network.

On a team it is the business softphone dialer sitting on top of the PBX you already pay for. On your own it keeps a work line separate, or carries a desk extension in your pocket.

Key features of the softphone

- Audio on widely used codecs, Opus, G.729 and G.711 among them.
- Video calls at 720p HD, carried by H.264 and VP8.
- Private conversations with military-grade encryption, including TLS, SRTP, and ZRTP.
- Low battery use thanks to efficient push notifications.
- The VoIP dialer hands calls over between WiFi and mobile data without dropping them.
- Custom call settings and ringtones per account.
- 5G ready and compatible with most mobile operating systems.

Enjoy calls that feel like a natural part of your Android phone. Groundwire works with Android's built-in calling features for a smooth, familiar experience, and routes audio intelligently between your phone, speaker, wired headset and connected Bluetooth devices. With your permission, it can also add Groundwire calls to the Phone app's Recents list, so your call history stays easy to find in one place.

A softphone app without the fees

Groundwire is a softphone for calling over WiFi and mobile data, with the business dialer features that usually cost a monthly fee. One payment, no subscription, nothing hidden: buy it once and it stays yours. Encryption sits inside that price rather than on top of it.

Run a call center, manage a fleet of extensions, or keep a dependable sip phone for a home office. The same app covers all of it, without extra tiers.

Download Groundwire and put a dependable SIP dialer on your phone, with Acrobits engineering and responsive support behind it.

name: Brams Keyboard
summary: 3D keyboard, mechanical sound, RGB and autocorrect in 72 languages. No tracking.
description:
A keyboard that makes you want to type.

Brams is an Android keyboard inspired by 1960s German industrial design: few colors, simple shapes and every detail in service of function. The keys have depth, sink when you tap them and sound like a real mechanical keyboard.

And one rule always holds: what you type never leaves your phone. Brams only uses the internet when you tap Download on a language or Check for language updates, and only to download.

KEYS YOU CAN FEEL
• 3D keys with shadows, side walls and a matte texture that sink with every tap
• 17 keycap shapes, including mechanical keyboard profiles like OEM, SA, DSA, XDA, KAT and MT3
• 22 color themes, each in light, dark and AMOLED
• More than 50 Signature themes you unlock by typing, with Brams Points
• Adjustable backlight and 12 gaming RGB effects: wave, waterfall, breathing, reactive, ripple, starlight, rain, fire and more, in 24 colors
• Caps Lock light, animated key entrance and rounded top corners
• Adjustable height and spacing, one-handed mode and a floating keyboard on tablets

MECHANICAL KEYBOARD SOUNDS
14 sounds, many recorded from real keyboards: Mechanical, Magnetic, Aluminum, Cushioned, Springy and more. Space, Enter and Delete have their own sound. Adjustable vibration, with its own strength for the space bar.

72 LANGUAGES, AUTOCORRECT AND SUGGESTIONS ON YOUR PHONE
From Portuguese, English and Spanish to Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Arabic, Hindi, Greek, Hebrew and Thai.
• Your phone's languages come with the app; download the others in Settings (up to 20 MB each). Once downloaded, they work offline, even in airplane mode
• Several languages at once, no switching
• Dedicated Cyrillic, Greek, Hebrew, Thai, Arabic-script and Indian (InScript) keyboards; Telex for Vietnamese
• Japanese with kanji conversion, Simplified (pinyin) and Traditional (zhuyin) Chinese, and Korean, all on your phone. The language list is updated when you tap Check for language updates
• Fixes typos and missing accents, and never learns its own mistakes
• Completes the word, predicts the next one from the sentence and remembers the emails you use
• Swipe across the letters to type
• QWERTY, AZERTY, QWERTZ, Turkish Q, Nordic, Dvorak, Colemak and BÉPO

TRANSLATION WITHOUT LEAVING THE KEYBOARD
Translate what you write into and from 57 languages. Translation happens right on your phone. Each translation language is downloaded in Settings when you want it (about 50 MB); after that, it works offline.

VOICE TYPING, OFFLINE
Tap the microphone and talk. Your speech becomes text right on your phone. Brams only listens while the voice panel is open, and the audio is never saved or sent anywhere.

EVERYDAY TOOLS
• Emoji with search by word or phrase, your choice of size and suggestions as you type
• Clipboard with text and images, pinned items and your choice of how long to keep them
• Hold the space bar to move the cursor like a trackpad
• A toolbar your way, including Switch keyboard
• Text shortcuts and typing statistics with a weekly summary
• Back up your settings and words to a file you keep, password-protected if you want, saved wherever you choose (even Google Drive)

REAL PRIVACY
• No tracking and no data collection: no ads, no analytics, no account
• Brams never sends anything you type, say or copy. The keyboard has no internet code
• Internet only to download: language files come from the Brams server when you tap Download in Settings, each one verified, with no account, cookies or identifiers
• Incognito mode, and no suggestions or learning in password fields
• Optional Brams Blueprint app: on your phone, Brams gives it only your total key count and Brams Points balance when you deposit, and your keyboard layout when you create a theme.

PAY ONCE
No subscription, no in-app purchases and no ads.
